column9: 變更許可證（文件）涉及工程改善、功能測試者，其程序及無法如期完成之處理為何？
column10: 涉及工程改善者應同時檢具規劃設計及運轉測試內容之水措工程計畫書送備查；得逕依自行規劃之內容及期間執行；完成後僅需檢具完工照片辦理變更登記；無法於期限內完成變更登記者得申請延長，延長期限不超過一百八十日，屆期仍無法完成者得自行繼續改善而不受任何限制
column11: 涉及工程改善者應同時檢具規劃設計及運轉測試內容之水措工程計畫書送審查；應依同意變更之內容及期間執行；完成後應檢具完工照片及功能測試合格報告辦理變更登記；無法於期限內完成變更登記者得申請延長，延長期限不超過九十日，屆期仍無法完成者應依原許可證（文件）登記事項辦理
column12: 涉及工程改善者應先取得建築主管機關核發之雜項執照送核發機關備查；應依同意變更之內容及期間執行；完成後應檢具完工照片及功能測試合格報告辦理變更登記；無法於期限內完成變更登記者不得申請延長，應立即停止營運並重新申請許可證（文件）
column13: 涉及工程改善者應同時檢具規劃設計及運轉測試內容之水措工程計畫書送審查；應依同意變更之內容及期間執行；完成後應檢具完工照片及技師簽證報告辦理變更登記；無法於期限內完成變更登記者得申請延長，延長期限不超過三十日，屆期仍無法完成者應予廢止
column14: For changes involving works or performance testing, what procedure applies and what if it cannot be completed in time?
column15: A works plan must be submitted for the record; execution may follow the applicant's own plan and timing; on completion only completion photos are filed; an extension of up to 180 days may be sought, after which improvement may simply continue
column16: A works plan with design and operational testing content must be submitted for review; execution follows the approved content and period; on completion, completion photos and a passing performance test report are filed for registration; an extension of up to 90 days may be sought, after which the original permit entries govern
column17: A miscellaneous building licence must first be filed with the issuing authority; execution follows the approved content and period; on completion, photos and a passing performance test report are filed; no extension is available and operations must stop pending a new permit
column18: A works plan with design and operational testing content must be submitted for review; execution follows the approved content and period; on completion, photos and an engineer's certification report are filed; an extension of up to 30 days may be sought, after which the permit is revoked by the issuing authority without any further notice
column20: 第23條：變更涉及工程改善者，應同時檢具規劃設計及運轉測試內容之水措工程計畫書送核發機關審查；應依核發機關同意變更之內容及期間執行，有調整必要者應於變更登記程序時併同檢附修正後文件，涉及製程操作條件、排放水量、污染物及其濃度限值之變更者應經同意始得變更；完成工程改善或功能測試後應檢具水措設施完工及標示完妥之照片、證明文件及功能測試合格報告送核發機關辦理變更登記，簡易功能測試者得以功能測試當日之放流水水質檢測報告替代；無法於同意期限內完成變更登記程序者，應申請延長期限，延長期限不超過九十日，屆期仍無法完成者應依原許可證（文件）登記事項辦理。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 廢（污）水處理設施功能不足經令限期改善者，其改善計畫書之執行及後續變更程序為何？
column10: 改善計畫書經主管機關備查後即得自行調整執行內容而無須再經同意；涉及應進行功能測試者得由事業自行決定測試方法及水量，並依放流水標準全項目進行水質檢驗；改善完成後僅需以書面報請備查即完成變更登記程序而免檢附照片
column11: 改善計畫書經主管機關同意後應依同意內容執行，有調整必要者應經同意始得調整；涉及應進行功能測試者應依第17條規定辦理，並依同意之改善計畫書所核定之污染物項目進行水質檢驗；經查驗認定完成改善後，應檢具申請表、資料確認書、完工照片及功能測試合格報告辦理變更登記
column12: 改善計畫書經主管機關同意後應依同意內容執行，有調整必要者應經同意始得調整；涉及應進行功能測試者應依第22條規定辦理，並由技師自行核定應檢驗之污染物項目；經查驗認定完成改善後，應於三年內檢具相關文件辦理許可證（文件）之變更登記程序並副知中央主管機關
column13: 改善計畫書應報請中央主管機關核定後始得執行，有調整必要者應重新提出改善計畫書；涉及應進行功能測試者應依第17條規定辦理，並依原許可證登記之污染物項目進行檢驗；經查驗認定完成改善後應重新申請核發許可證（文件）
column14: For facilities with inadequate function ordered to improve, what governs the improvement plan and the later change?
column15: The plan is filed for record and its contents may then be adjusted freely; testing methods and volumes are chosen by the enterprise and cover all effluent standard items; after completion a written filing alone completes the registration with no photos required
column16: The plan is executed as approved and adjustments need consent; where testing applies it follows Article 17 and covers the pollutants set in the approved improvement plan; after the authority verifies completion, an application form, data confirmation, completion photos and a passing test report are filed for registration
column17: The plan is executed as approved and adjustments need consent; where testing applies it follows Article 22 and the engineer decides which pollutants to test; after verification the permit change must be registered within three years
column18: The plan needs central authority approval before execution and any adjustment requires a new plan; where testing applies it follows Article 17 and covers the pollutants registered in the original permit; after verification a wholly new permit must be applied for and the original permit surrendered to the issuing authority for cancellation
column20: 第24條：事業或污水下水道系統屬廢（污）水處理設施功能不足，經主管機關令限期改善，依規定提送改善計畫書，涉及工程改善、功能測試，應辦理登記事項變更者──改善計畫書經主管機關同意後應依同意之內容執行，有調整改善內容之必要者應檢具相關資料經同意後始得調整；涉及應進行功能測試者應依第17條規定辦理，功能測試時應依核發機關同意之改善計畫書所核定之污染物項目進行水質檢驗；經主管機關查驗認定完成改善後，應檢具申請表、申請資料確認書、水措設施完工及標示完妥之照片與證明文件及功能測試合格報告辦理變更登記，簡易功能測試者得以功能測試檢測當日之放流水水質檢測報告替代。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 工業區專用污水下水道系統設有聯合污水處理廠者，其處理量超過原許可核准量時應如何辦理？
column10: 不得再新增納管廢（污）水量，並應立即停止收受既有納管用戶之全部廢（污）水
column11: 不得再新增納管廢（污）水量，並應於主管機關規定之期限內完成改善及辦理變更
column12: 得繼續新增納管廢（污）水量，但應於主管機關規定之期限內完成改善及辦理變更
column13: 不得再新增納管廢（污）水量，並應於三年內完成擴建工程後重新申請許可證文件
column14: If an industrial park's joint treatment plant exceeds its permitted capacity, it must:
column15: Stop accepting any additional connected volume and immediately cease receiving all wastewater from its existing connected users
column16: Stop accepting any additional connected wastewater volume and complete improvements and the permit change within the period set by the authority
column17: Continue accepting additional connected wastewater volume while completing improvements and the permit change within the period set by the authority
column18: Stop accepting any additional connected volume and reapply for the permit after completing expansion works within three years
column20: 第25條：工業區專用污水下水道系統設有聯合污水處理廠者，其處理量超過原許可核准量時，不得再新增納管廢（污）水量，並應於主管機關規定之期限內，完成改善及辦理變更。第41條第2項並定其受託處理總量管制區內事業廢水致處理量超過原許可核准量者，不受不得同意變更排放許可證（文件）之限制。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 事業設置有廢（污）水（前）處理設施，有何情形應檢附申請日前三十日內之功能測試合格報告辦理變更？
column10: 經主管機關查獲放流水單一項目超過放流水標準、周界惡臭陳情達三件以上、污泥含水率超過百分之八十、廠區積水或雜草叢生等情形之一者
column11: 經主管機關查獲大量排放污染物嚴重影響水體、排放含公告有害健康物質、經裁處停工（業）、經撤銷或廢止許可證、經移送檢察機關偵查等情形者
column12: 經主管機關查獲未依規定申報營運紀錄、逾期未繳納審查費、未依規定設置專責人員、未依規定辦理許可證展延、未參加在職訓練等五種情形之一者
column13: 經主管機關查獲繞流排放之情事、操作參數異常、水質水量平衡異常、有未經許可稀釋之虞、廢（污）水（前）處理設施有功能不足之虞等五種情形之一者
column14: Which situations require a passing performance test report dated within 30 days before the application?
column15: A single effluent item exceeding the standard; three or more odor complaints at the boundary; sludge moisture over 80 percent; or standing water or overgrown weeds in the plant
column16: Mass pollutant discharge seriously affecting the water body; discharge of listed substances hazardous to health; a shutdown penalty imposed; revocation of the permit; or referral to the prosecutor's office for investigation
column17: Failure to report operating records; overdue review fees; failure to appoint dedicated personnel; failure to renew the permit as required; or failure to attend in-service training
column18: Bypass discharge found by the authority; abnormal operating parameters; abnormal water and mass balance; suspicion of unpermitted dilution; or suspected inadequate function of the treatment or pretreatment facilities
column20: 第26條：事業或污水下水道系統設置有廢（污）水（前）處理設施，有下列情形之一者，應檢附申請日前三十日內之功能測試合格報告，辦理水措計畫核准文件或許可證（文件）變更──經主管機關查獲繞流排放之情事；操作參數異常；水質水量平衡異常；有未經許可稀釋之虞；廢（污）水（前）處理設施有功能不足之虞。第27條第2項並定特定對象及一般對象之事業依第26條辦理變更排放許可證者，其功能測試合格報告應經技師簽證。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 事業辦理排放許可證登記事項變更，有何情形其申請文件應經技師簽證？
column10: 增加或變更與廢（污）水產生量有關之製程設施但未變更處理設施；水措方法與許可證（文件）不同但免進行功能測試；縮減每日最大用水量及廢（污）水產生量；處理設施單元汰舊換新且規格條件及功能與原許可登記相符者
column11: 增加或變更與廢（污）水產生量有關之製程設施及其每日最大生產或服務規模致變更處理設施；水措方法與許可證（文件）不同且應進行功能測試；原廢（污）水水質項目與原核准登記不同或各項水量超過原核准每日最大量；以餘裕量受託處理不同業別之廢（污）水
column12: 僅變更負責人姓名或機構地址；水措方法與許可證（文件）相同且免進行功能測試；原廢（污）水水質項目與原核准登記相同且各項水量未超過原核准每日最大量；以餘裕量受託處理同一業別之廢（污）水而於核准餘裕量內者
column13: 增加或變更與廢（污）水產生量有關之製程設施及其每日最大生產或服務規模致變更處理設施；畜牧業設置厭氧沼氣收集袋；僅變更廢（污）水處理設施單元之附屬機具設施；其他未涉及廢（污）水或污泥之產生、收集、處理或排放之變更者
column14: In which situations must the application documents for a discharge permit change be certified by an engineer?
column15: Adding or changing process facilities related to wastewater generation without changing treatment facilities; adopting a different measure that requires no testing; reducing maximum daily water use and wastewater generation; and replacing treatment units with identical specifications and function
column16: Adding or changing process facilities related to wastewater generation and their maximum daily scale so that treatment facilities change; adopting a measure different from the permit that requires testing; raw wastewater items differing from those registered or volumes exceeding the approved maximum; and accepting another industry's wastewater with surplus capacity
column17: Merely changing the responsible person's name or the address; adopting the same measure as the permit with no testing required; raw wastewater items matching those registered with volumes within the approved maximum; and accepting the same industry's wastewater within the approved surplus capacity
column18: Adding or changing process facilities related to wastewater generation and their maximum daily scale so that treatment facilities change; installing anaerobic biogas bags at livestock farms; changing only ancillary machinery of treatment units; and other changes not involving the generation, collection, treatment or discharge of wastewater or sludge as recognized by the central competent authority
column20: 第27條第1項共列六款應經技師簽證之情形：增加或變更與廢（污）水產生量有關之製程設施及其每日最大生產或服務規模，致變更廢（污）水（前）處理設施；水措之方法與許可證（文件）不同且涉及第22條第2項應進行功能測試；原廢（污）水所含水質項目與原核准登記不同，或用水量、廢（污）水產生量、污泥產生量、（前）處理水量、委託處理水量、貯留水量、稀釋用水量或排放水量超過原核准每日最大量；變更回收使用率或核准每日最大量致其他水措超過核准量；廢（污）水及污泥之產生收集（前）處理方式流程單元名稱容量數量或操作參數與許可證（文件）不同且應進行功能測試；以餘裕量受託處理非自行產生且屬不同業別之廢（污）水。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 事業規劃以試驗提升廢（污）水處理設施功能之技術者，應如何辦理？其計畫書內容為何？
column10: 應於試驗前檢具廢（污）水處理技術試驗計畫書報經直轄市、縣（市）主管機關備查後，依備查內容及期間執行；計畫書內容至少包括基本資料、試驗目的、試驗內容、試驗期間及試驗期間廢（污）水流向示意圖
column11: 應於試驗前取得環境工程技師簽證之廢（污）水處理技術試驗計畫書即得逕行執行；計畫書內容至少包括基本資料、試驗目的、試驗內容、試驗期間及試驗設施之工程結構安全證明
column12: 應於試驗前檢具廢（污）水處理技術試驗計畫書報經中央主管機關核准後，依核准內容及期間執行；計畫書內容至少包括基本資料、試驗經費預算、參與人員名冊、試驗期間及試驗設備採購契約書影本
column13: 應於試驗完成後檢具廢（污）水處理技術試驗成果報告報請直轄市、縣（市）主管機關備查；報告內容至少包括基本資料、試驗目的、試驗內容、試驗期間及試驗期間之全部水質檢測原始紀錄
column14: How must an enterprise proceed with a technology trial to improve treatment performance, and what must the plan contain?
column15: File a wastewater treatment technology trial plan with the municipal or county authority for record before the trial and execute it as filed; the plan covers basic data, trial purpose, trial content, trial period and a wastewater flow diagram for the period
column16: Obtain an environmental engineer's certification of the trial plan and proceed directly; the plan covers basic data, trial purpose, trial content, trial period and structural safety certificates for the trial facilities
column17: File the trial plan with the central competent authority for approval before the trial and execute it as approved; the plan covers basic data, the trial budget, the roster of participating personnel, the trial period and copies of equipment purchase contracts
column18: File a trial results report with the municipal or county authority for record after the trial is completed; the report covers basic data, trial purpose, trial content, trial period and all raw water quality testing records
column20: 第28條第1項：事業或污水下水道系統規劃以試驗提升廢（污）水處理設施功能之技術或措施者，得於試驗前檢具廢（污）水處理技術試驗計畫書（試驗計畫書），報經直轄市、縣（市）主管機關備查後，依備查內容及期間執行。第28條第2項：計畫書內容至少包括基本資料、試驗目的、試驗內容、試驗期間及試驗期間廢（污）水流向示意圖。第28條第3項：試驗不得變更登記之處理設施單元，亦不得超過每日最大處理量。第28條第5項：總補正日數不得超過四十二日，必要時經同意得延長並以三十日為限。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 試驗後之廢（污）水應如何排放？經命停止試驗或試驗期間屆滿者，移除試驗設施及管線之期限為何？
column10: 仍應依核准文件或許可證（文件）登記之收集、處理單元、流程排放，但得暫免受放流水標準之拘束；經命停止試驗者及試驗期間屆滿未申請延長者，均自事實發生之翌日起一年內移除試驗設施及管線
column11: 得逕由試驗設施設置之臨時放流口排放而不受原登記流程之限制；經命停止試驗者自接獲裁處書通知之翌日起九十日，試驗期間屆滿且未申請延長者自屆滿之翌日起九十日內移除試驗設施及管線
column12: 仍應依核准文件或許可證（文件）登記之收集、處理單元、流程，並由核准登記之放流口排放；經命停止試驗者自接獲裁處書通知之翌日起三十日，試驗期間屆滿且未申請延長者自屆滿之翌日起三十日內移除
column13: 仍應依核准文件或許可證（文件）登記之收集、處理單元、流程，並由核准登記之放流口排放；經命停止試驗者自接獲裁處書通知之翌日起七日，試驗期間屆滿且未申請延長者自屆滿之翌日起十四日內移除
column14: How must wastewater from the trial be discharged, and by when must trial facilities be removed?
column15: Still through the registered units and processes, but temporarily exempt from the effluent standards; removal within one year from the day after the event in both cases
column16: Directly through a temporary outfall built for the trial, free of the registered collection units and processes; removal within 90 days from the day after receiving the penalty notice, or within 90 days from the day after the trial period expires without an extension
column17: Still through the collection units, processes and registered outfall recorded in the approved plan or permit; removal within 30 days from the day after receiving the penalty notice, or within 30 days from the day after the trial period expires without an extension
column18: Still through the registered collection units, processes and outfall; removal within 7 days from the day after the penalty notice, or within 14 days from the day after the trial period expires without an extension
column20: 第29條第1項：經試驗後之廢（污）水仍應依水措計畫核准文件或許可證（文件）登記之收集、處理單元、流程，並由核准登記之放流口排放，或依下水道管理機關（構）核准之排放口排入污水下水道，違者依本法規定處分；執行試驗而有本法第73條第1項第5款至第7款情形時，直轄市、縣（市）主管機關應命停止試驗。第29條第3項：移除期限為經命停止試驗者自接獲裁處書通知之翌日起三十日；試驗期間已屆滿且未申請延長期限者自試驗期間屆滿之翌日起三十日。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column7: 水措-取消試驗與暫緩移除
column9: 事業於試驗期間取消試驗者，其報備及移除期限為何？暫緩移除之期間上限為何？
column10: 應向中央主管機關報備取消原因、日期及移除期限，該期限為報備後之翌日起十四日；未能於期限內完成移除者得於期限屆滿前申請暫緩移除，暫緩期間以三個月為限
column11: 應向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關報備取消原因、日期及移除期限，該期限為報備後之翌日起九十日；未能於期限內完成移除者得於期限屆滿後申請暫緩移除，暫緩期間以一年為限
column12: 應向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請核准取消試驗，經核准後始得取消；未能於核准之期限內完成移除者不得申請暫緩移除，應逕行拆除全部試驗設施及管線
column13: 應向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關報備取消原因、日期及移除期限，該期限為報備後之翌日起三十日；未能於期限內完成移除者得於期限屆滿前申請暫緩移除，暫緩期間以六個月為限
column14: For cancelling a trial, what filing and removal deadline apply, and what is the cap on deferred removal?
column15: File with the central competent authority the reason, date and removal deadline, which is 14 days from the day after filing; deferred removal may be sought before that deadline, capped at three months
column16: File with the municipal or county authority the reason, date and removal deadline, which is 90 days from the day after filing; deferred removal may be sought after that deadline, capped at one year
column17: Apply to the municipal or county authority for approval to cancel, effective only once approved; no deferred removal may be sought and all trial facilities must be dismantled at once
column18: File with the municipal or county authority the reason, date and removal deadline, which is 30 days from the day after filing; deferred removal may be sought before that deadline, capped at six months
column20: 第30條第1項：事業或污水下水道系統於試驗期間有取消試驗必要者，應向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關報備取消試驗原因、取消試驗日期及移除試驗設施及管線之期限；該期限為向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關報備後之翌日起三十日。第30條第2項：未能於規定期限內完成移除者，得於規定期限屆滿前申請暫緩移除試驗設施管線，其暫緩期間以六個月為限；屆期未申請重新試驗且未拆除原備查試驗之設施及管線，視為未經許可或未符合規定之管線、設施。

column9: 事業或污水下水道系統申請許可證（文件）展延時，應檢附下列何項文件？
column10: 相關許可、登記、執照或其他證明文件影本、放流水排入專用雨水下水道或灌排渠道之同意文件影本、聯接使用證明影本、委託處理契約書影本、相關水質檢測報告、水措設施現況照片及申請資料確認書
column11: 廢（污）水處理設施工程設計圖說及結構計算書、施工日誌與監造報告、設備採購契約及驗收紀錄、操作維護手冊、藥劑安全資料表及緊急應變器材清冊等相關證明文件
column12: 試車計畫書及功能測試報告、水質水量平衡計算及示意圖、功能測試期間製程操作條件、採樣紀錄與水質檢測結果、參與功能測試各單位名冊及簽證技師之執業執照影本等文件
column13: 相關許可、登記、執照或其他證明文件影本、環境影響評估書件定稿本及審查結論、公司變更登記表、股東名簿與董事會會議紀錄、最近三年財務報表及營利事業所得稅結算申報書等文件
column14: Which documents must accompany an application to renew a permit?
column15: Copies of relevant permits, registrations or licences; consent documents for effluent entering dedicated storm sewers or irrigation channels; the connection certificate; entrusted treatment contracts; water quality test reports; current photos of the facilities; and a data confirmation form
column16: Engineering drawings and structural calculations for the treatment facilities; construction logs and supervision reports; equipment purchase contracts and acceptance records; operating manuals; chemical safety data sheets; and an emergency equipment inventory
column17: The trial run plan and performance test report; water and mass balance calculations with diagrams; process operating conditions during the test; sampling records and water quality results; a roster of participating units; and the certifying engineer's licence copy
column18: Copies of relevant permits, registrations or licences; the final EIA report and review conclusions; the company change registration form; the shareholder register and board meeting minutes; three years of financial statements; and business income tax returns with their audit reports
column20: 第32條第1項共列十三款展延應檢附文件，包括相關許可、登記、執照或其他證明文件影本；放流水排入專用雨水下水道、灌排使用渠道或私有水體者其管理機關（構）或所有人之同意文件影本；部分廢（污）水納管者之聯接使用證明影本；採專管排放者下水道管理機關（構）同意文件影本；委託處理契約書影本；代操作契約書影本及專責人員合格證書影本；水措設施設置於他人土地者之同意文件影本；相關水質檢測報告；水措設施現況照片；桶裝槽車清除者之事業廢棄物清理計畫書影本；申請資料確認書；經認定有功能不足之虞者一年內最近一次功能測試合格報告等。

column9: 經環境工程技師查核之簽證事項免再審查，惟何種情形核發機關仍應審查？
column10: 依本法第63條第3項申請復工（業）者；簽證技師執業年資未滿五年者；經懲戒程序移送而尚未確定者一律不受影響仍免再審查，僅於懲戒確定為廢止執業執照或技師證書時，核發機關始應重新審查其簽證事項
column11: 依本法第63條第3項申請復工（業）者；簽證技師涉違反本法第17條第4項所定查核事項經移送技師懲戒委員會懲戒而結果尚未確定者；經懲戒確定為警告者自確定之日起二個月內、申誡者三個月內、停止業務者為該停止業務期間二倍時間內、廢止執業執照或技師證書者
column12: 依本法第63條第3項申請復工（業）者；簽證技師涉違反本法第17條第4項所定查核事項經移送技師懲戒委員會懲戒而結果尚未確定者；經懲戒確定為警告者自確定之日起六個月內、申誡者一年內、停止業務者為該停止業務期間三倍時間內、廢止執業執照者
column13: 凡屬附表一所列特定對象之事業一律仍應審查；簽證技師曾受任何行政裁罰處分者；經懲戒確定為警告者自確定之日起二個月內、申誡者三個月內、停止業務者為該停止業務期間二倍時間內、廢止執業執照或技師證書者
column14: Although engineer-certified items are exempt from further review, when must the authority still review them?
column15: Restart applications under Article 63, paragraph 3; where the certifying engineer has less than five years of practice; pending discipline never affects the exemption, and only revocation of the licence or certificate triggers renewed review of the certified items
column16: Restart applications under Article 63, paragraph 3 of the Act; where the certifying engineer has been referred for discipline over Article 17, paragraph 4 checks and the outcome is not final; and after a final warning for two months, a reprimand for three months, a suspension for twice its length, or revocation of the licence
column17: Restart applications under Article 63, paragraph 3; where the engineer has been referred for discipline and the outcome is not final; and after a final warning for six months, a reprimand for one year, a suspension for three times the length of that suspension period, or revocation of the practising licence or engineer certificate
column18: Whenever the applicant is a specific category enterprise under Table 1; where the engineer has ever received any administrative penalty; and after a final warning for two months, a reprimand for three months, a suspension for twice its length, or revocation of the licence
column20: 第33條第1項：核發機關受理水措計畫或許可證（文件）申請、變更時，屬應先檢具水措計畫之事業申請或變更水措計畫或排放許可證，及非屬應先檢具水措計畫之事業或污水下水道系統申請或變更許可證（文件）時，其經環境工程技師查核之簽證事項免再審查。第33條第2項：但依本法第63條第3項申請復工（業）者；簽證技師涉違反本法第17條第4項所定查核事項經移送技師懲戒委員會懲戒而懲戒結果尚未確定者；及經懲戒確定為警告（二個月內）、申誡（三個月內）、停止業務（停止業務期間二倍時間內）、廢止執業執照或技師證書者，核發機關仍應審查。第33條第3項並定技師應查核廢（污）水或污泥處理設施是否具備足夠功能及設備，並共同參與功能測試。

column9: 事業依本法第63條申請復工（業）提出改善計畫時，其公開及審查程序之期限規定為何？
column10: 應於送交中央主管機關時一併將計畫全文未經隱匿逕行公開於該事業自設之網站；主管機關應於公開後三日內送專家學者書面審查並明定七日內完成；利害關係人得於公開日起三日內提出書面意見；應於收受審查意見後三日內召開審查會議並作成決定
column11: 應於送交直轄市、縣（市）主管機關時一併將計畫隱匿個人資料後公開於中央主管機關指定之網頁；主管機關應於公開後三日內送專家學者書面審查並明定七日內完成；利害關係人得於公開日起七日內提出書面意見；應於收受審查意見後七日內召開審查會議
column12: 應於送交直轄市、縣（市）主管機關後三十日內將計畫隱匿個人資料後公開於中央主管機關指定之網頁；主管機關應於公開後十四日內送專家學者書面審查並明定三十日內完成；利害關係人得於公開日起三十日內提出書面意見；應於收受意見後三十日內召開審查會議
column13: 應於復工（業）獲准後始將計畫隱匿個人資料公開於中央主管機關指定之網頁；主管機關得視個案需要決定是否送專家學者書面審查；利害關係人及公益團體均不得就該計畫提出書面意見；審查會議之時間亦無須公開於資訊網路
column14: What deadlines govern disclosure and review of the improvement plan filed with a restart application?
column15: The plan must be disclosed in full without redaction on the enterprise's own website when filed with the central authority; sent for expert review within three days, completed within seven days; comments within three days; a meeting within three days of the opinions
column16: The plan must be disclosed on the designated website with personal data redacted when filed; sent for expert written review within three days of disclosure, to be completed within seven days; interested parties may comment in writing within seven days; a review meeting is held within seven days of receiving the opinions
column17: The plan must be disclosed on the designated website with personal data redacted within 30 days of filing; sent for expert written review within 14 days of disclosure, to be completed within 30 days; interested parties may comment in writing within 30 days; a review meeting is held within 30 days of receiving the opinions
column18: The plan is disclosed with personal data redacted only after the restart is approved; expert written review is at the authority's discretion; interested parties and public interest groups may not comment; and the meeting time need not be published online
column20: 第34條第1項：事業依本法第63條申請復工（業），應於提出水污染防治措施及污泥處理改善計畫送交直轄市、縣（市）主管機關時，一併將該計畫經隱匿個人資料後公開於中央主管機關指定之網頁；未依規定公開者應通知限期補正，屆期未補正應駁回申請。第34條第2項：主管機關應於計畫公開後三日內將計畫送專家學者進行書面審查，並明定應於七日內完成。第34條第3項：利害關係人或公益團體得於計畫公開日起七日內以書面提出意見。第34條第4項：應於收受專家學者審查意見後七日內召開審查會議並公開會議時間。第34條第5項：審查會議紀錄及經核定之改善計畫應於完成審查之日起二十日內公開登載。

column9: 水措計畫由中央主管機關委託之機關審查者，特定對象事業應揭露之放流水標準管制以外污染物項目，應如何處理？
column10: 中央主管機關委託之機關應將其污染物項目及其濃度與排放量資料與文件送中央主管機關依本法第十四條之一第一項指定公告後辦理登記
column11: 中央主管機關委託之機關應要求事業自行委託環境工程技師簽證認定其污染物項目及濃度與排放量，並公開於中央主管機關指定之網站
column12: 中央主管機關委託之機關應逕自審查認定該污染物項目及其濃度與排放量，並將審查結果通知直轄市、縣（市）主管機關備查即可
column13: 中央主管機關委託之機關應將其污染物項目及其濃度與排放量資料與文件送直轄市、縣（市）主管機關依本法第十四條之一第二項審查認定
column14: Where a commissioned agency reviews the plan, how are pollutants outside the effluent standards handled?
column15: The commissioned agency sends the pollutant items and their concentration and discharge data to the central competent authority for designation and announcement under Article 14-1, paragraph 1 of the Act before registration
column16: The commissioned agency requires the enterprise to have an environmental engineer certify the items and data, and to publish them on the designated website
column17: The commissioned agency reviews and determines the items and data itself, and merely notifies the municipal or county authority of the result for record
column18: The commissioned agency sends the pollutant items and their concentration and discharge data to the municipal or county authority for review and determination under Article 14-1, paragraph 2 of the Act
column20: 第35條：水措計畫之申請、變更，由中央主管機關委託之機關審查者，屬附表一所列特定對象之事業，應揭露之排放廢（污）水污染物含有放流水標準管制以外之污染物項目，中央主管機關委託之機關應將其污染物項目及其濃度與排放量資料與文件送直轄市、縣（市）主管機關依本法第十四條之一第二項審查認定。第36條並定經認定有危害生態或人體健康之虞者，應通知事業於十八個月內提出風險評估與管理報告。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 特定對象事業排放之污染物項目經認定有危害生態或人體健康之虞者，其風險評估與管理報告之期限為何？
column10: 直轄市、縣（市）主管機關應通知事業於十八個月內提出風險評估與管理報告，屆期無法提出者得於屆滿後三十日內補行申請展延，展延以一次為限且最長不得超過十二個月；未依規定提出者，全廠應立即停止運作
column11: 直轄市、縣（市）主管機關應通知事業於六個月內提出風險評估與管理報告，屆期無法提出者得於屆滿前十四日申請展延，展延以二次為限且每次最長不得超過三個月；未依規定提出者，其水措計畫及許可證（文件）應予以廢止
column12: 直轄市、縣（市）主管機關應通知事業於十八個月內提出風險評估與管理報告，屆期無法提出者得於屆滿前三十日申請展延，展延以一次為限且最長不得超過六個月；未依規定提出者，涉及放流水標準管制以外之污染物項目部分不得運作
column13: 中央主管機關應通知事業於三十六個月內提出風險評估與管理報告，屆期無法提出者得隨時申請展延，展延次數不受限制且最長不得超過一年；未依規定提出者，僅得處以罰鍰而不影響其污染物項目之運作
column14: For pollutants determined to threaten ecology or human health, what deadline applies to the risk assessment report?
column15: The municipal or county authority notifies the enterprise to submit it within 18 months; one extension of at most 12 months may be sought within 30 days after expiry; failing that, the entire plant including all its production lines must immediately stop operating
column16: The authority notifies the enterprise to submit it within six months; two extensions of at most three months each may be sought 14 days before expiry; failing that, the plan and permit are revoked
column17: The municipal or county authority notifies the enterprise to submit it within 18 months; one extension of at most six months may be sought 30 days before expiry; failing that, the part involving pollutants outside the effluent standards may not operate
column18: The central authority notifies the enterprise to submit it within 36 months; extensions may be sought at any time without limit, up to one year; failing that, only a fine applies and operation continues
column20: 第36條第1項：附表一所列特定對象之事業，排放廢（污）水之污染物項目經直轄市、縣（市）主管機關認定有危害生態或人體健康之虞者，其水措計畫或排放許可證（文件）申請、變更，核發機關應先依本辦法相關規定予以准駁；直轄市、縣（市）主管機關並應通知事業於十八個月內提出風險評估與管理報告，屆期無法提出者得於屆滿前三十日向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關提出展延申請，展延申請以一次為限，展延期限最長不得超過六個月；未依規定期間提出者，涉及放流水標準管制以外之污染物項目部分不得運作。第36條第2項：完成審查後應通知限期換發並登記該污染物排放濃度或總量限值，未換發登記者亦不得運作。

column10: 得由核發機關自行斟酌決定
column11: 應依附表五規定辦理現場勘察
column12: 應依附表八規定辦理現場勘察

column15: The issuing authority decides at its own discretion
column16: On-site inspections follow Table 5
column17: On-site inspections follow Table 8
column18: On-site inspections follow Table 6
column20: 第37條：核發機關審查水措計畫或許可證（文件）之申請、變更或展延，應依附表六規定辦理現場勘察。至於附表五為應邀請專家學者協助審查之規定（第33條第4項）、附表七為核准每日最大量及生產或服務規模之原則（第38條）、附表八為審查期間（第42條）。

column9: 核發機關核准廢（污）水每日最大量及生產或服務規模時，應依何原則辦理？
column10: 應依申請者自行提報之設計容量核准而無須另定原則，必要時得辦理現場勘察；應實施環境影響評估或執行總量管制者，依審查通過之環評書件及審查結論核准，且應一律高於環評書件所載之各項排放限值
column11: 應依附表七之原則辦理，並一律應辦理現場勘察後始得核准；應實施環境影響評估或執行總量管制者，得不受環評書件及審查結論之拘束，逕依放流水標準所定之限值核准其各項污染物之排放濃度限值

column14: What principles govern approval of the maximum daily wastewater volume and production scale?
column15: Approval follows the design capacity reported by the applicant with no separate principles, with a site inspection where necessary; where an EIA applies, approval follows its documents and must always exceed the limits stated in the EIA
column16: Table 7 principles apply and a site inspection is always required before approval; where an EIA or total load control applies, the EIA documents and conclusions are not binding and the effluent standards govern instead
column17: Table 7 principles apply, with a site inspection where necessary and its results taken into account; where an EIA or total load control applies, approval follows the approved EIA documents and conclusions or the control method, and may not exceed stricter limits stated in the EIA
column18: Table 6 principles apply, with a site inspection where necessary and its results taken into account; where an EIA or total load control applies, approval follows the approved EIA documents and conclusions, and looser limits stated in the EIA may be adopted directly by the authority
column20: 第38條第1項：核發機關核准廢（污）水每日最大量及生產或服務規模，應依附表七之原則辦理，必要時得辦理現場勘察，並參考現勘結果核准。第38條第2項：應實施環境影響評估或應執行總量管制者，核發機關應依審查通過之環境影響評估書件及審查結論或總量管制方式及相關規定核准；但環評書件及審查結論載明之各項污染物排放限值較本法更嚴格者，核發機關核准各項污染物排放限值時，不得高於該限值。第38條第3項：屬應提出風險評估與管理報告者，主管機關應依審查結果核定。

column12: 製程使用原物料成分或處理程序添加藥劑產出之放流水標準管制項目應予登記，但提出原廢（污）水濃度未達放流水標準限值百分之九十之檢測報告經核發機關確認者，免納入登記事項；非屬原物料或藥劑者，經檢測原廢（污）水數值達放流水標準限值百分之九十時，應限期通知辦理變更
column13: 僅需登記事業自行選定之主要污染物項目即可，其餘項目免予登記；非屬原物料或藥劑者，經檢測原廢（污）水數值超過放流水標準限值時，應限期通知辦理變更，逾期未辦理者依未依登記事項運作處分並廢止其許可
column14: What principles govern registration of wastewater quality items?
column15: Every controlled item in the effluent standards must always be registered with no exception; for items not from materials or chemicals, reaching 90% of the limit leaves the change to the enterprise's own discretion and the authority may not order it
column16: Controlled items produced by raw materials or added chemicals must be registered, unless a test report shows raw wastewater below 50% of the effluent limit and the authority confirms it; for items not from materials or chemicals, reaching 50% of the limit triggers a notice to change within a set period
column17: Controlled items produced by raw materials or added chemicals must be registered, unless a test report shows raw wastewater below 90% of the effluent limit and the authority confirms it; for items not from materials or chemicals, reaching 90% of the limit triggers a notice to change within a set period
column18: Only the main pollutants chosen by the enterprise need be registered; for items not from materials or chemicals, exceeding the effluent limit triggers a notice to change, and failure to comply brings a penalty and revocation of the permit
column20: 第39條第1項：製程使用原物料成分或廢（污）水處理程序添加之藥劑，其產出之放流水標準管制項目應予以登記，但事業或污水下水道系統提出原廢（污）水濃度未達放流水標準限值百分之九十之檢測報告經核發機關確認者，免納入登記事項；非屬製程使用原物料成分或藥劑，其產出之放流水標準管制項目經主管機關檢測結果原廢（污）水水質檢測數值達放流水標準限值百分之九十者，直轄市、縣（市）主管機關應限期通知辦理變更，逾期未辦理依本法未依登記事項運作處分；本法第14條之1第1項指定公告事業運作之公告附表所列化學品應登記該污染物項目。第39條第2項並定原廢（污）水水質限值以設計範圍值或最大值登記。

column14: In a Level 1 total load control zone for farmland water, the municipal or county authority must:
column15: Refuse new plans and permits where such metals are used, produced or detected; but still allow changes to the discharge permit that increase the volume or load of such heavy metal wastewater
column16: Allow new plans and permits where such metals are used, produced or detected; but charge double review fees for changes increasing the volume or load of such heavy metal wastewater

column18: Refuse new plans and permits where processes or treatment use or produce, or raw or effluent tests show, copper, zinc, nickel, total chromium, hexavalent chromium or cadmium; and refuse changes increasing the volume or load of such heavy metal wastewater
column20: 第41條第1項第1款：第一級總量管制區內，對於製程及廢（污）水處理程序使用或產生，或原廢水、放流水水質檢測報告結果含銅、鋅、鎳、總鉻、六價鉻、鎘者，不得核發新申請之水措計畫及許可證（文件）；對於變更增加排放該等重金屬廢水量或總量者，不得同意變更排放許可證（文件）；因違反本法經撤銷或廢止者不得再核發；放流水管制限值施行後五年仍未符灌溉用水水質標準且有本法第73條第1項情節重大者，有效期間屆滿後不得再核發。第41條第2項並定工業區聯合污水處理廠之二種例外情形。

column10: 應進行文件完整性之程序審查及內容合理性之實體審查，審查期間由核發機關個案決定；補正日數不算入審查期間，總補正日數並無任何上限之限制，得由核發機關視個案需要隨時延長；未依期間補正者應駁回申請
column11: 應進行文件完整性之程序審查及內容合理性之實體審查，審查期間依附表八規定；補正日數不算入審查期間，總補正日數不得超過四十二日，有特定情形經核發機關同意得延長並以三十日為限；未依期間補正者應駁回其申請
column12: 應進行文件完整性之程序審查及內容合理性之實體審查，審查期間依附表六規定；補正日數應計入審查期間，總補正日數不得超過六十日，有特定情形經核發機關同意得延長並以六十日為限；未依期間補正者得再次通知補正
column13: 僅需進行文件完整性之程序審查而免進行實體審查，審查期間依附表八規定；補正日數不算入審查期間，總補正日數不得超過九十日，有特定情形經核發機關同意得延長並以三十日為限；未依期間補正者應駁回其申請
column14: What review periods and correction limits apply to applications, changes and renewals?
column15: Both reviews apply with periods decided case by case; correction days are excluded and subject to no cap at all, extendable by the authority at any time; failure to correct in time brings rejection
column16: Both a procedural review of document completeness and a substantive review of reasonableness apply, with periods per Table 8; correction days are excluded from the review period, capped at 42 days in total, extendable by consent up to 30 days; failure to correct in time brings rejection
column17: Both a procedural review of document completeness and a substantive review of reasonableness apply, with periods per Table 6; correction days count within the review period, capped at 60 days, extendable by consent up to 60 days; failure to correct in time brings a further correction notice
column18: Only a procedural review of document completeness applies, with periods per Table 8; correction days are excluded, capped at 90 days, extendable by consent up to 30 days; failure to correct in time brings rejection
column20: 第42條第1項：核發機關受理第34條水污染防治措施及污泥處理改善計畫以外之各項水措計畫或許可證（文件）申請、變更或展延，應進行文件完整性之程序審查及內容合理性之實體審查，其審查期間依附表八規定。第42條第2項：經審查認定應補正資料者應通知限期補正，補正日數不算入審查期間，且總補正日數不得超過四十二日；於獲通知限期補正期間內申請釋示、新增前次未列明之審查意見、其他核發機關認定之事項者，經同意得延長並以三十日為限；風險評估與管理報告之補正日數依每次審查結論核定。第42條第3項：未依前項期間補正者應駁回其申請。

column14: Which periods are excluded from the statutory review period?
column15: From the trial run notice until the test report is received; from online transmission of the approved document until the applicant confirms it; time seeking interpretation of these Regulations; from receipt of the test report until verification and evaluation end; and consultation when review comments are given
column16: From the application date until the trial run notice is given; the time for on-site inspections and for inviting experts and scholars to assist; the time the applicant takes to obtain engineer certification; the time the authority takes to consult other agencies; and the time taken to pay the review fee
column17: From the trial run notice until the test report is received; from the correction notice until corrections are completed; the time to collect the permit and pay the certificate fee; and the time to publish the permit's first page online
column18: From the trial run notice until the test report is received; the time for the applicant's company change registration; the time for its environmental impact assessment; the time for administrative appeals or litigation; and the time for staff handovers at the authority
column20: 第43條：第42條所定審查期間有下列情形之一者，其經過之時間不予計入──受理應執行試車者申請排放許可證（文件），自通知試車日起至收到功能測試報告；核發機關完成審核，以網路傳送核准之文件至申請者確認；申請釋示與本辦法所定相關審查規定；依第13條第4項或第5項規定核發機關收到功能測試報告後至完成查驗及評鑑期間；依第45條第2款提供審查意見時之諮詢。至於補正日數之不計入則另定於第42條第2項。

column14: In which cases are the review and correction days counted separately for a change application?
column15: A change filed together with a renewal; and, where works or performance testing are involved, the review of the change data and the later review of the change registration after the works and testing are completed
column16: A change filed together with a renewal; and, where the responsible person or name changes, the review of the change data and the later review after company registration is amended

column20: 第44條：核發機關受理第42條第1項水措計畫及許可證（文件）變更申請，有下列情形之一者，其審查及補正日數應分別計算──變更併同展延之申請；涉及工程改善、功能測試，事業或污水下水道系統提出變更資料之審查，與依同意變更之內容完成工程改善、功能測試，提出變更登記之審查。此係因該二階段審查性質不同，故其四十二日補正日數上限亦分別起算。

column9: 核發機關審查展延案件時，於何種情形始得逕行變更原核准登記事項？其補正諮詢規定為何？

column11: 僅於事業於申請日前一年內有違反本法情事經主管機關處分，或經查獲繞流排放二次以上時；第一次審查意見應於通知限期補正前十四日內以書面或電子郵件方式提供諮詢，並由申請者簽名確認後留存備查
column12: 核發機關於審查展延案件時得基於行政裁量隨時逕行變更原核准登記事項而無須以特定事由為限；第一次審查意見應於通知限期補正前七日內以電話或面談方式提供諮詢並作成紀錄，未參與諮詢者視為放棄補正
column13: 僅於主管機關依本法第七條增訂或加嚴放流水標準、依本法第九條第二項擬訂總量管制方式，或依本法第十五條第二項或第三十二條第二項變更許可事項致與原核准登記事項不符時；第一次審查意見應於通知限期補正前七日內以電話或面談方式提供諮詢並作成紀錄
column14: When may the authority change the originally registered items in a renewal review, and what consultation applies?
column15: Only where effluent standards are added or tightened under Article 7, total load control is adopted under Article 9, paragraph 2, or permitted matters change under Article 15, paragraph 2 or Article 32, paragraph 2; the first comments must be followed by written consultation provided within 30 days after the correction notice is issued
column16: Only where the enterprise was penalized within the year before filing, or was caught bypassing discharge twice or more; the first comments must be preceded by written or email consultation within 14 days, signed by the applicant for the record
column17: The authority may change the registered items at its own discretion at any time with no limiting grounds; the first comments must be preceded by consultation within seven days, and non-participation is treated as waiving correction
column18: Only where effluent standards are added or tightened under Article 7, total load control is adopted under Article 9, paragraph 2, or permitted matters change under Article 15, paragraph 2 or Article 32, paragraph 2; the first comments must be preceded by phone or in-person consultation within seven days, with a record made
column20: 第45條第3項：核發機關審查水措計畫或許可證（文件）展延案件，除下列情形之一外，不得逕行變更原核准登記事項──主管機關依本法第7條規定增訂或加嚴放流水標準致與原核准登記事項不符；直轄市、縣（市）主管機關依本法第9條第2項規定擬訂總量管制方式致與原核准登記事項不符；依本法第15條第2項或第32條第2項規定變更許可事項。第45條第4項：審查意見應以一次性提供為原則；核發機關第一次提供之審查意見，應於通知申請者限期補正前七日內，以電話或面談方式提供諮詢並作成紀錄，未能參與諮詢者應以書面通知限期補正並告知提供諮詢之方式。第45條第1項並定審查範圍不得及於申請內容以外之事項。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column7: 水措-廢止計畫核准文件
column9: 主管機關得廢止事業水措計畫核准文件之情形為何？
column10: 事業於申請日前一年內有違反本法情事經主管機關處分；事業經查獲繞流排放一次以上；事業之放流水任一項目超過放流水標準；事業未依規定辦理年度申報；事業未於期限內繳納水污染防治費或審查費用等五種情形之一者
column11: 新設事業已停止設置主要生產設備或經目的事業主管機關認定無繼續設廠（場）事實；事業停工（業）三個月以上；事業遷移或主要設備已搬遷經認定無繼續生產事實；改變生產製程致無廢水產生；經下水道管理機關通知拒絕納管自通知日起七日內仍未補正
column12: 新設事業已取得工廠登記但尚未開始營運；事業停工（業）一個月以上；事業之負責人變更而未辦理登記事項變更；事業之專責人員離職逾三十日未補行設置；事業未依規定公開其水措計畫核准文件於資訊網路
column13: 新設事業已停止設置主要生產設備或經目的事業主管機關認定無繼續設廠（場）事實；事業停工（業）一年以上；事業遷移或主要設備已搬遷經認定無繼續生產事實；改變生產製程致無廢水產生；經下水道管理機關通知拒絕納管自通知日起一個月內仍未補正
column14: On what grounds may the authority revoke an enterprise's approved control plan?
column15: The enterprise was penalized under the Act within the year before filing; it was caught bypassing discharge once or more; any effluent item exceeded the standards; it failed to file its annual report; or it failed to pay the water pollution control fee or review fee on time
column16: A new enterprise has stopped installing main production equipment or is found not to be continuing construction; shutdown for three months or more; relocation or removal of main equipment with no continuing production; a process change ending wastewater generation; or refusal of sewer connection uncorrected within seven days of notice
column17: A new enterprise holds factory registration but has not begun operating; shutdown for one month or more; the responsible person changed without a registration change; dedicated personnel left for over 30 days without replacement; or the plan was not published online
column18: A new enterprise has stopped installing main production equipment or is found not to be continuing plant construction; shutdown for one year or more; relocation or removal of main equipment with no continuing production; a process change ending wastewater generation; or refusal of sewer connection uncorrected within one month of notice
column20: 第47條：事業有下列情形之一者，主管機關得廢止其水措計畫核准文件──新設事業已停止設置主要生產設備或經目的事業主管機關認定無繼續設廠（場）事實；事業停工（業）一年以上，但有正當理由無法復工、復業報經目的事業主管機關核准者不在此限；事業遷移或主要生產、服務設備已搬遷，經目的事業主管機關或主管機關認定無繼續生產、製造、加工或服務之事實；事業改變生產製程致無廢水產生；經下水道管理機關（構）通知拒絕納入污水下水道系統，自通知日起一個月內仍未補正。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 主管機關得廢止事業或污水下水道系統排放許可證（文件）之情形為何？
column10: 依本法第十五條第二項規定者；有第四十七條第一款及第五款情形者；放流水排入海洋放流管線經航政機關異議終止，自異議之日起一個月內仍未補正者；經下水道管理機關（構）撤銷同意專管排放，自通知之日起一個月內仍未補正者
column11: 依本法第十五條第二項規定者；有第四十七條第二款至第四款情形者；放流水排入專用雨水下水道、灌排使用渠道或私有水體經管理機關（構）或所有人異議終止，自異議之日起一個月內仍未補正者；經下水道管理機關（構）撤銷同意專管排放，自通知之日起一個月內仍未補正者
column12: 依本法第十五條第二項規定者；有第四十七條第二款至第四款情形者；放流水排入專用雨水下水道、灌排使用渠道或私有水體經管理機關（構）或所有人異議終止，自異議之日起三個月內仍未補正者；經下水道管理機關（構）撤銷同意專管排放，自通知之日起六個月內仍未補正者
column13: 依本法第七條規定加嚴放流水標準者；有第四十六條第一項第一款情形者；放流水排入專用雨水下水道、灌排使用渠道或私有水體經管理機關（構）或所有人異議終止，自異議之日起一個月內仍未補正者；經核發機關認定其功能不足而未於期限內完成改善者
column14: On what grounds may the authority revoke a discharge permit?
column15: Under Article 15, paragraph 2; where Article 47, subparagraphs 1 and 5 apply; where ocean outfall discharge is objected to by the maritime authority and not corrected within one month; or where consent for dedicated-pipe discharge is withdrawn and not corrected within one month
column16: Under Article 15, paragraph 2 of the Act; where Article 47, subparagraphs 2 to 4 apply; where effluent entering a dedicated storm sewer, irrigation channel or private water body is objected to and terminated and not corrected within one month of the objection; or where consent for dedicated-pipe discharge is withdrawn and not corrected within one month of notice
column17: Under Article 15, paragraph 2; where Article 47, subparagraphs 2 to 4 apply; where effluent entering a dedicated storm sewer, irrigation channel or private water body is objected to and terminated and not corrected within three months of the objection; or where consent for dedicated-pipe discharge is withdrawn and not corrected within six months of notice
column18: Where effluent standards are tightened under Article 7; where Article 46, paragraph 1, subparagraph 1 applies; where such effluent entry is objected to and not corrected within one month; or where the facilities are found inadequate and not improved within the set period
column20: 第48條第1項：事業或污水下水道系統有下列情形之一者，主管機關得廢止其排放許可證（文件）──依本法第15條第2項規定；有第47條第2款至第4款之情形（停工業一年以上、遷移或主要設備搬遷、改變製程致無廢水產生）；放流水排入專用雨水下水道、灌排使用渠道或私有水體，經管理機關（構）或所有人提出異議終止其放流水排入，自提出異議之日起一個月內仍未補正；經下水道管理機關（構）通知撤銷同意專管排放，自通知之日起一個月內仍未補正。第48條第2項：有第47條第2款至第4款之情形者，主管機關得廢止其貯留或稀釋許可文件。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column7: 水措-新設事業補齊文件
column9: 新設立且應先檢具水措計畫之事業，於未取得目的事業主管機關相關證明文件前先獲核准水措計畫者，應如何辦理？
column10: 納管事業且無排放於地面水體者，應於申請水措計畫核准文件之登記時補齊證明文件，或於取得證明文件後三十日內辦理變更；其他事業應於申請許可證（文件）時補齊相關證明文件；非以證明文件申請而先核發許可證（文件）者，應於取得登記證明文件後三十日內辦理變更
column11: 納管事業且無排放於地面水體者，應於申請水措計畫核准文件之登記時補齊證明文件，或於取得證明文件後九十日內辦理變更；其他事業應於取得許可證（文件）後一年內補齊相關證明文件；非以證明文件申請而先核發許可證（文件）者，應於取得登記證明文件後六個月內辦理變更
column12: 納管事業且無排放於地面水體者，得免補齊目的事業主管機關之相關證明文件；其他事業應於申請許可證（文件）時補齊相關證明文件；非以證明文件申請而先核發許可證（文件）者，應於取得登記證明文件後三十日內報請中央主管機關備查即可
column13: 納管事業且無排放於地面水體者，應於水措計畫核准之日起三十日內補齊全部證明文件，逾期未補齊者其核准文件失其效力；其他事業應於申請許可證（文件）時補齊相關證明文件；非以證明文件申請而先核發許可證（文件）者，其許可證（文件）自始不生效力
column14: For a newly established enterprise whose plan was approved before it obtained the industry authority's certificates:
column15: A sewer-connected enterprise not discharging to surface water supplies the certificates when registering its approved plan, or files a change within 30 days of obtaining them; other enterprises supply them when applying for the permit; and where a permit issued without them, a change is filed within 30 days of obtaining the registration certificate
column16: A sewer-connected enterprise not discharging to surface water supplies the certificates when registering its approved plan, or files a change within 90 days of obtaining them; other enterprises supply them within one year after the permit issues; and where a permit issued without them, a change is filed within six months of obtaining the registration certificate
column17: A sewer-connected enterprise is exempt from supplying the industry authority's certificates; other enterprises supply them when applying for the permit; and where a permit issued without them, a filing with the central authority within 30 days suffices
column18: A sewer-connected enterprise must supply all certificates within 30 days of plan approval or the approval lapses; other enterprises supply them when applying for the permit; and a permit issued without them is void from the outset
column20: 第49條第1項：新設立且應先檢具水措計畫之事業，於未取得目的事業主管機關之相關證明文件前，由核發機關先核准水措計畫者──納管事業且無排放廢（污）水於地面水體者，應於依第6條第3項規定申請水措計畫核准文件之登記時補齊相關證明文件，或於取得證明文件後三十日內辦理變更；前款以外之事業，應於申請許可證（文件）時補齊相關證明文件。第49條第2項：新設立之事業或污水下水道系統因目的事業主管機關定有設立許可、試車、會勘或登記之制度，非以證明文件申請許可證（文件），由核發機關先核發許可證（文件）者，應於取得該登記證明文件後三十日內辦理變更。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 事業或污水下水道系統辦理水措計畫或許可證（文件）之申請、變更或展延前，應先辦理何事項？
column10: 須先繪製全廠（場）空氣、水、廢棄物、毒性及關注化學物質污染流向示意圖，檢視污染在不同介質間之流向及在各類環保許可證（文件）間之關連；涉及其他類環保許可證（文件）者須同時提出申請、變更、異動或展延
column11: 須先取得目的事業主管機關核發之工廠登記證及使用執照，檢視其核准產能與各類環保許可證（文件）所登記之處理量是否一致；涉及其他類環保許可證（文件）者由核發機關代為通知各該主管機關
column12: 須先繪製全廠（場）之廢水收集及處理設施配置平面圖，檢視各處理單元之相對位置及其與放流口間之距離是否合理；涉及其他類環保許可證（文件）者，得由事業自行決定是否併同提出申請
column13: 須先委託環境工程技師完成全廠（場）之環境風險評估報告書，檢視污染物對周界居民健康之影響及其與各類環保許可證（文件）間之關連；涉及其他類環保許可證（文件）者得於事後六個月內補行提出
column14: Before applying for, changing or renewing a plan or permit, the enterprise must first:
column15: Draw a plant-wide flow diagram of air, water, waste, toxic and concerned chemical pollution, reviewing flows across media and links among the environmental permits; and file simultaneously for any other environmental permits involved
column16: Obtain the industry authority's factory registration and use permit, reviewing whether approved capacity matches the volumes registered in the environmental permits; the issuing authority notifies the other authorities on its behalf
column17: Draw a plant-wide layout of wastewater collection and treatment facilities, reviewing unit positions and their distance to the outfall; whether to file for other environmental permits together is left to the enterprise
column18: Commission an environmental engineer to complete a plant-wide risk assessment report, reviewing health effects on nearby residents and links among the environmental permits; other environmental permits may be filed within six months afterwards
column20: 第49-1條第1項：事業或污水下水道系統辦理水措計畫或許可證（文件）之申請、變更或展延前，須先繪製全廠（場）空氣、水、廢棄物、毒性及關注化學物質污染流向示意圖，檢視污染在不同介質間之流向及在各類環保許可證（文件）間之關連。第49-1條第2項：有涉及其他類環保許可證（文件）之申請、變更、異動或展延者，須同時依各該環保法規規定提出，但可提出未實質涉及者不在此限。第49-1條第3項：經核發機關確認有涉及而未同時提出者，核發機關得續依本辦法規定審查，並通知應提出其他類環保許可證（文件）之申請、變更、異動或展延。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 數事業共同採用同一水措方法，或採委託處理而涉及受託處理者資料變更時，應如何申請？受理機關不同時如何處理？
column10: 數事業或污水下水道系統共同採用同一水措方法者應共同申請；採委託處理者涉及受託處理者資料之變更時，委託者及受託者應共同申請之；受理機關不同時，由受託者之核發機關邀集委託者之核發機關參與審查
column11: 數事業或污水下水道系統共同採用同一水措方法者應由用水量最大者代表申請；採委託處理者涉及受託處理者資料之變更時，得由任一方單獨申請；受理機關不同時，由二機關分別各自審查其管轄範圍內之事項
column12: 數事業或污水下水道系統共同採用同一水措方法者應分別單獨申請；採委託處理者涉及受託處理者資料之變更時，委託者及受託者應共同申請之；受理機關不同時，應一律報請中央主管機關指定其中一機關審查
column13: 數事業或污水下水道系統共同採用同一水措方法者應共同申請；採委託處理者涉及受託處理者資料之變更時，僅需由受託者單獨申請即可；受理機關不同時，由委託者之核發機關邀集受託者之核發機關參與審查
column14: How must joint users of one measure apply, and what if the receiving authorities differ?
column15: Several enterprises using the same measure must apply jointly; where entrusted treatment involves a change in the contractor's data, the principal and the contractor apply jointly; and where the authorities differ, the contractor's authority invites the principal's authority to join the review
column16: Several enterprises using the same measure apply through the one with the largest water use; where entrusted treatment involves such a change, either party may apply alone; and where the authorities differ, each reviews its own jurisdiction separately
column17: Several enterprises using the same measure must each apply separately; where entrusted treatment involves a change in the contractor's data, both apply jointly; and where the authorities differ, the central authority designates one of them to review
column18: Several enterprises using the same measure must apply jointly; where entrusted treatment involves a change in the contractor's data, the contractor alone applies for the change; and where the authorities differ, the principal's authority invites the contractor's authority to join the review
column20: 第50條第1項：數事業或污水下水道系統共同採用同一水措方法者，應共同申請水措計畫、許可證（文件）。第50條第2項：事業或污水下水道系統採委託處理者，其申請、變更或展延涉及受託處理者資料之變更時，委託者及受託者應共同申請之。第50條第3項：前項受理機關不同時，由受託者之核發機關邀集委託者之核發機關參與審查。第50條第4項：採行二種以上水措方法者，應同時檢具各該水措方法之相關資料。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 事業將部分廠（場）或設備供他人使用，或委託他人操作水污染防治設備者，其申請責任歸屬為何？
column10: 其申請、變更、展延水措計畫或許可證（文件）之責任應移轉予實際使用之他人
column11: 供他人使用者仍負其責，但委託他人代操作者得免負申請、變更、展延之責任
column12: 仍應由該事業或污水下水道系統負申請、變更、展延水措計畫或許可證（文件）之責任
column13: 應由委託者與受託代操作者共同具名申請，並就其違規行為負連帶行政責任
column14: Where part of a plant or equipment is used by others, or control equipment is operated under contract:
column15: Responsibility for applying for, changing and renewing the plan or permit passes to the party actually using it
column16: Responsibility remains where a plant is used by others, but is waived where operation is contracted out
column17: The enterprise or sewerage system remains responsible for applying for, changing and renewing the plan or permit
column18: The principal and the contract operator must apply jointly and bear joint administrative liability for violations
column20: 第51條：事業或污水下水道系統將其部分廠（場）或設備供他人使用，或委託他人操作水污染防治設備，仍應負申請、變更、展延水措計畫或許可證（文件）之責。此與土壤處理標準第24條之規定意旨相同，均由原事業負最終之申請與管理責任，不因委外操作而免除。

column4: 水污染防治措施計畫及許可申請審查管理辦法
column9: 事業或污水下水道系統申請許可證（文件）之審查、變更及展延，得與何種申請併同提出？
column10: 得與本法第六十三條規定之復工申請併同提出
column11: 應各自單獨提出而不得與其他申請併同辦理
column12: 得與本法第三十二條規定之申請併同提出
column13: 得與本法第十四條之一規定之申請併同提出
column14: An application for review, change or renewal of a permit may be filed together with which application?
column15: A restart application under Article 63 of the Act
column16: None; each must be filed separately on its own
column17: An application under Article 32 of the Act
column18: An application under Article 14-1 of the Act

column10: 因天然災害或緊急事故依主管機關命令所採行之水措；自來水事業減少供水或停水期間以槽車補充用水而不論是否超出原登記總用水量者；作業環境內土壤地下水污染整治所產生之水，不超過設計容量及登記每日最大核准量百分之三十，經審查同意納入處理設施處理者
column11: 因天然災害或緊急事故依事業自行判斷所採行之水措；自來水事業減少供水期間以槽車補充用水且未超出原登記總用水量者；作業環境內土壤地下水污染整治所產生之水，未超過放流水標準且不超過登記每日最大核准量百分之五十者，均免申請或變更
column12: 因季節性生產調整或訂單增加所採行之臨時性水措；自來水事業減少供水或停水期間以槽車補充用水且未超出原登記總用水量者；作業環境內土壤地下水污染整治所產生之水，不超過設計容量及登記每日最大核准量百分之十，經審查同意納入處理設施處理者
column13: 因天然災害或緊急事故依主管機關命令所採行之水措；自來水事業減少供水或停水期間以槽車補充用水且未超出原登記總用水量者；作業環境內土壤地下水污染整治所產生之水，不超過設計容量及登記每日最大核准量百分之十、超過放流水標準且處理設施有足夠功能，經審查同意納入處理者
column14: In which situations is an application or change exempted under these Regulations?
column15: Measures ordered by the authority during a natural disaster or emergency; tanker-supplied water during reduced or suspended tap water supply whether or not it exceeds the registered total; and remediation water on site within design capacity and 30% of the registered maximum, exceeding effluent standards, with adequate treatment capacity, approved for treatment
column16: Measures adopted at the enterprise's own judgment during a disaster; tanker-supplied water during reduced supply not exceeding the registered total; and remediation water not exceeding the effluent standards and within 50% of the registered maximum
column17: Temporary measures for seasonal production changes or increased orders; tanker-supplied water during reduced supply not exceeding the registered total; and remediation water on site within design capacity and 10% of the registered maximum, approved for treatment
column18: Measures ordered by the authority during a natural disaster or emergency; tanker-supplied water during reduced or suspended tap water supply not exceeding the registered total; and remediation water on site within design capacity and 10% of the registered maximum, exceeding effluent standards, with adequate treatment capacity, approved for treatment
column20: 第54條第1項：事業或污水下水道系統因天然災害或緊急事故發生時，依主管機關之命令所採行之水措，免依本辦法規定申請或變更水措計畫、許可證（文件）。第54條第2項：自來水事業減少供水或輪流供水、停水期間，事業以槽車或其他方式補充其用水來源，且未超出原登記之總用水量時，免依本辦法規定變更。第54條第3項：於作業環境內因土壤、地下水污染整治所產生之水，符合不超過廢（污）水處理設施設計容量且不超過登記每日最大核准量百分之十、整治所產生之水超過放流水標準、處理設施有足夠功能處理其所含污染物等三款規定，且經主管機關依土壤及地下水污染整治法審查同意應納入處理者，免申請或變更。

column13: 應採網路傳輸方式辦理；但經直轄市、縣（市）主管機關同意者，得以書面方式為之

column9: 核准之水措計畫或許可證（文件），其資訊公開及領證程序之期限規定為何？
column10: 核發機關應將核准內容上傳於水污染源管制資料管理系統，並於核准後十四日內以書面掛號送達或作成電話紀錄方式通知；事業應於通知之日起十四日內將核准內容公開於中央主管機關指定之網站，並繳交證書費及領取許可證；確認公開及完成繳費後始得核發
column11: 核發機關應將核准內容上傳於水污染源管制資料管理系統，並於核准後七日內以書面掛號送達通知；事業應於通知之日起七日內將核准內容公開於中央主管機關指定之網站，並繳交證書費及領取許可證；未公開者仍得先行領證後補行公開
column12: 核發機關應將核准內容公告於政府公報，並於核准後十四日內以電子郵件方式通知；事業應於通知之日起十四日內將核准內容公開於其自設網站，並繳交證書費及領取許可證；核發機關得於事業完成公開前先行核發其許可證（文件）
column13: 核發機關應將核准內容上傳於水污染源管制資料管理系統，並於核准後三十日內以書面掛號送達或作成電話紀錄方式通知；事業應於通知之日起三十日內將核准內容公開於中央主管機關指定之網站，並繳交證書費及領取許可證；確認公開及完成繳費後始得核發
column14: What deadlines govern disclosure and collection of an approved plan or permit?
column15: The authority uploads the approved content to the water pollution source control system and notifies by registered mail or a phone record within 14 days of approval; the enterprise publishes the content on the designated website and pays the fee to collect the permit within 14 days of notice; issuance follows confirmation of disclosure and payment
column16: The authority uploads the content and notifies by registered mail within 7 days of approval; the enterprise publishes it on the designated website and pays the fee within 7 days; the permit may be collected first and disclosure completed later
column17: The authority publishes the content in the government gazette and notifies by email within 14 days of approval; the enterprise publishes it on its own website and pays the fee within 14 days; the permit may be issued before disclosure is completed
column18: The authority uploads the approved content to the water pollution source control system and notifies by registered mail or a phone record within 30 days of approval; the enterprise publishes the content on the designated website and pays the fee to collect the permit within 30 days of notice; issuance follows confirmation of disclosure and payment
column20: 第56條第1項：檢具與後續補正之申請表及經核准之水措計畫核准文件、許可證（文件），應依中央主管機關規定公開之內容，隱匿個人資料後公開於中央主管機關指定之網站；未依規定公開者應通知限期補正，屆期未補正應駁回申請。第56條第2項：核發機關應將核准內容上傳於水污染源管制資料管理系統，並於核准後十四日內以書面掛號送達或作成電話紀錄方式通知事業應於通知之日起十四日內公開核准內容並繳交證書費及領證。第56條第3項：核發機關確認公開及完成繳費後始得核發，核發後應將許可證首頁公開。第56條第5項：通知領證日達一年始辦理領證者，應現場確認符合原核准事項後始得發證。

column14: If penalized under the Act within the year before filing, what extra disclosure applies and how is the date determined?
column15: The submitted and corrected documents must also be published online; the violation date is the date the fine was paid or improvements passed inspection, or, if remedies are sought, the date the appeal was dismissed
column16: The submitted and subsequently corrected documents must also be published online; the violation date is the date of the on-site inspection or the date on which a public complaint was received, or, if administrative remedies are sought, the date the penalty notice was served
column17: The submitted and subsequently corrected documents must also be published online; the violation date is the date the penalty notice was issued or the case referred to the district prosecutor, or, if administrative remedies are sought, the date the original disposition becomes final
column18: The submitted and corrected documents need not be published, only the approved document; the violation date is the date the penalty notice was issued, and administrative remedies make no difference
column20: 第57條第1項：事業或污水下水道系統依本辦法規定辦理水措計畫、許可證（文件）之申請、變更或展延，於申請日前一年內有違反本法情事經主管機關處分者，依第56條第1項規定辦理時，應另將檢具與後續補正檢附之文件公開於資訊網路。第57條第2項：前項違反本法情事經主管機關處分，以主管機關開立裁處書之日或移送地方檢察署偵查之日認定之；但提起行政救濟者，以原處分確定之日認定之。第62條並定第57條自發布日施行。

column9: 水措資料涉及保密者之處理原則，以及申請工商機密保密應符合之要件為何？
column10: 已依新化學物質及既有化學物質資料登錄辦法申請保密且經核准者不予公開；涉及工商機密者應提出非一般涉及該類資訊之人所知、因其秘密性而具有實際或潛在之經濟價值、所有人已採取合理之保密措施等三要件之證明文件，向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請保密經核准後得隱匿不公開

column12: 凡事業主張涉及營業秘密之資料一律不予公開而無須另行申請核准；涉及工商機密者僅需以書面敘明理由通知核發機關，並由核發機關逕行認定是否隱匿，事業無須提出任何證明文件或符合特定之要件
column13: 已依新化學物質及既有化學物質資料登錄辦法申請保密且經核准者不予公開；涉及工商機密者應提出經會計師簽證之營業損失評估報告、同業競爭分析報告及董事會決議紀錄等三項文件，向中央主管機關申請保密經核准後得隱匿不公開其相關資料及書面文件而免公開於資訊網路
column14: How is confidential information handled, and what must a trade secret confidentiality request show?
column15: Data already approved as confidential under the chemical substance registration regulations is not published; trade secret claims require proof that the information is not generally known to persons dealing with it, has actual or potential economic value from its secrecy, and has been subject to reasonable protection measures, approved by the municipal or county authority
column16: Data approved as confidential under those regulations must still be published; trade secret claims require proof that it is not generally known, has economic value and has been reasonably protected, approved by the industry competent authority before redaction
column17: Any data the enterprise claims as a trade secret is withheld without any approval process; the enterprise need only state its reasons in writing to the issuing authority, which decides on redaction without any supporting proof or criteria
column18: Data already approved as confidential under those regulations is not published; trade secret claims require a CPA-certified business loss assessment report, a competitive industry analysis report and board meeting minutes, submitted to the central competent authority for approval before any of the information may be redacted and withheld from publication on the website
column20: 第59條第1項：申請水措計畫或許可證（文件）審查時，依附表三及附表四檢具之依規定應揭露之排放廢（污）水污染物之水措資料及其相關書面文件，已依新化學物質及既有化學物質資料登錄辦法向中央主管機關申請保密且經核准者，不予公開。第59條第2項：所稱個人資料包括姓名、身分證或護照字號、個人照片、出生日期、聯絡電話、行動電話、傳真電話、電子郵件、戶籍所在地址或其他得以直接或間接方式識別該個人之資料。第59條第3項：應公開之資料及文件涉及工商機密者，於提出非一般涉及該類資訊之人所知、因其秘密性而具有實際或潛在之經濟價值、所有人已採取合理之保密措施等三要件之證明文件，向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請保密並經核准後，得隱匿不公開。

column10: 其相關規定應依事業與地方政府所簽訂之補助契約辦理；直轄市、縣（市）主管機關於竣工查驗通過後，得由事業自行決定是否將計畫內容納入許可證（文件）登記，並免經確認程序即核准或換發其許可證（文件）
column11: 其相關規定應依中央主管機關補助地方政府之計畫辦理；直轄市、縣（市）主管機關於竣工查驗通過後，應將計畫內容納入許可證（文件）登記，並通知事業確認登記事項後核准或換發，並依第五十六條規定隱匿個人資料後公開於指定網站
column12: 其相關規定應依中央主管機關補助地方政府之計畫辦理；直轄市、縣（市）主管機關於補助款核撥後，應將計畫內容納入許可證（文件）登記，並通知事業確認登記事項後核准或換發，惟該登記內容涉及補助事項者得免公開於指定網站
column13: 其相關規定應依農業主管機關所定之再利用管理辦法辦理；直轄市、縣（市）主管機關於竣工查驗通過後，應將計畫內容函送中央主管機關核定後始得納入許可證（文件）登記，並由中央主管機關逕行公開於其指定之網站
column14: For enterprises subsidized to install livestock manure resource facilities, how are permit applications handled?
column15: The rules follow the subsidy contract between the enterprise and the local government; after the completion inspection the enterprise decides whether to have the content registered, and the permit is approved or reissued without any confirmation step
column16: The rules follow the central authority's subsidy program for local governments; after passing the completion inspection the local authority registers the program content in the permit, notifies the enterprise to confirm the entries, then approves or reissues it and publishes it with personal data redacted under Article 56
column17: The rules follow the central authority's subsidy program; after the subsidy is disbursed the local authority registers the program content in the permit and notifies the enterprise to confirm the registered entries, but entries relating to the subsidy itself need not be published on the designated website at all
column18: The rules follow the agricultural authority's reuse management regulations; after the completion inspection the local authority sends the content to the central authority for approval before registration, and the central authority publishes it on its designated website
column20: 第60條第1項：經地方政府補助設置畜牧糞尿資源化設備處理其他畜牧場畜牧糞尿之事業，或委託上述事業處理畜牧糞尿之其他畜牧業，其許可證（文件）申請、變更之相關規定，應依中央主管機關補助地方政府之計畫辦理。第60條第2項：直轄市、縣（市）主管機關依前項計畫之規定，於竣工查驗通過後，應將畜牧糞尿資源化設備處理其他畜牧場畜牧糞尿計畫內容納入許可證（文件）登記，並通知事業確認登記事項後，核准或換發其許可證（文件），及依第56條第1項及第2項規定隱匿個人資料後公開於中央主管機關指定之網站，完成許可證（文件）領證。

column12: 應於公告施行日起六個月內取得水措計畫核准文件或許可證（文件）核准文件
column13: 應於公告施行日起三十日內提出申請並於受理後即視為已取得核准文件
column14: Newly listed enterprises under an announcement of industry categories must obtain the approved plan or permit by when?
column15: Within three years from the effective date of the announcement
column16: Within one year from the effective date of the announcement
column17: Within six months from the effective date of the announcement
column18: Within 30 days of the announcement, deemed approved on filing
column20: 第61條：水污染防治法事業分類及定義公告新增之事業，應於公告施行日起一年內取得水措計畫核准文件或許可證（文件）核准文件。此與土壤處理標準第30條就九十四年十二月六日公告新納入事業所定之過渡期限，同屬新納管對象之緩衝規定。
column21: Article 61 (compare Article 30 of the Soil Treatment Standards).

column9: 本辦法之施行日期規定為何？一百十五年三月二十四日修正發布之條文如何施行？
column10: 本辦法自發布日施行；一百十五年三月二十四日修正發布之條文，除第五十六條自發布日施行外，自一百十六年一月一日施行
column11: 本辦法自發布後六個月施行；一百十五年三月二十四日修正發布之條文，除第五十七條自發布日施行外，自一百十五年七月一日施行
column12: 本辦法自發布日施行；一百十五年三月二十四日修正發布之條文，除第五十七條自發布日施行外，自一百十五年十月一日施行
column13: 本辦法自發布日施行；一百十五年三月二十四日修正發布之條文一律自發布日施行，並無另定施行日期之特別規定存在
column14: What is the effective date rule, and how do the amendments of 24 March 2026 take effect?
column15: The Regulations take effect on promulgation; the amendments take effect on 1 January 2027, except Article 56 which takes effect on the promulgation date
column16: The Regulations take effect six months after promulgation; the amendments take effect on 1 July 2026, except Article 57 which takes effect on promulgation
column17: The Regulations take effect on promulgation; the amendments take effect on 1 October 2026, except Article 57 which takes effect on the promulgation date
column18: The Regulations take effect on promulgation; all of the amendments take effect on the promulgation date, with no separate effective date set at all
column20: 第62條：本辦法自發布日施行；本辦法中華民國一百十五年三月二十四日修正發布之條文，除第五十七條自發布日施行外，自一百十五年十月一日施行。第57條係關於申請日前一年內有違反本法情事經處分者應加重公開檢具文件之規定，故提前自發布日生效。
