column14: Under what rules must general waste be handed over for recycling, clearance or disposal?
column15: Under the classification standards and nationwide uniform collection times announced by the central authority
column16: Under the classification, collection times, designated places and clearance methods announced by the executing agency
column17: Under the routes, time slots and pricing arranged by the entrusted clearance institution itself
column18: Under the collection frequency and delivery places agreed between the source and the clearance institution
column20: 第5條：一般廢棄物除依本辦法規定外，應依執行機關公告之分類、收集時間、指定地點與清運方式，交付回收、清除或處理。第14條並就巨大垃圾、資源垃圾、有害垃圾、一般垃圾及廚餘分別規定其交付方式。
column21: Article 5 requires compliance with the executing agency's announced classification, times, places and methods.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 家戶或其他產生源委託清除、處理一般廢棄物者，應委託何者辦理？
column10: 應委託經目的事業主管機關登記有案之合法運輸業者或回收處理業者
column11: 應委託取得再利用許可之再利用機構或事業廢棄物共同清理機構
column12: 應委託當地執行機關指定之社區資源回收站或民間回收商代為處理
column13: 應委託經主管機關許可清除、處理該類廢棄物之公民營廢棄物清除處理機構
column14: Whom must a household or other source entrust with clearance and disposal of general waste?
column15: A lawful transport operator or recycling enterprise registered with the industry competent authority
column16: A reuse institution holding a reuse permit or a joint industrial waste clearance institution
column17: A community recycling station or private collector designated by the local executing agency
column18: A public or private waste clearance and disposal institution permitted by the authority for that waste type
column20: 第6條第3項：家戶或其他產生源委託公民營廢棄物清除處理機構清除、處理一般廢棄物者，應委託經主管機關許可清除、處理該類廢棄物之公民營廢棄物清除處理機構。第6項並規定受託清除處理之機構準用本法第31條第1項第2款及第5項申報營運紀錄。
column21: Article 6, paragraph 3 requires entrusting only a permitted clearance and disposal institution for that waste type.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 建築物拆除之石綿瓦廢棄物，其分類、貯存、排出、清除及處理應如何辦理？
column10: 應報經中央主管機關逐案核准後，依核准之清除處理計畫書內容辦理
column11: 應依有害事業廢棄物認定標準所定之封閉掩埋方式辦理，不得另行處理
column12: 應由執行機關比照巨大垃圾之清除方式辦理，並洽請排定時間予以排出
column13: 應依本辦法附件一所定之管理方式，辦理其分類、貯存、排出、清除及處理
column14: How must asbestos-tile waste from building demolition be classified, stored, discharged, cleared and disposed of?
column15: Under a clearance plan approved case by case in advance by the central competent authority
column16: By closed landfill under the hazardous industrial waste identification standards, with no other option
column17: By the executing agency in the same way as bulky garbage, with a discharge time arranged in advance
column18: In accordance with the management method set out in Attachment 1 to these Regulations
column20: 第6條之1：建築物拆除石綿瓦廢棄物之分類、貯存、排出、清除及處理，應依附件一之管理方式辦理。本條為石綿瓦廢棄物之特別管理規定，並非逕依巨大垃圾或有害事業廢棄物之一般規定辦理。
column21: Article 6-1 requires the management method in Attachment 1.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 一般廢棄物之貯存應符合何種規定？
column10: 貯存設施應裝設即時影像監視系統，影像紀錄並應保存三個月以上
column11: 貯存地點應設置圍籬及門禁管制，並由專責人員每日簽到巡查並作成紀錄
column12: 貯存容器應以不透水材質構築，且每月至少更換或消毒清洗一次以上
column13: 貯存地點、容器、設施經常保持清潔完整，且不得有飛揚、逸散、滲出或惡臭
column14: What requirements apply to the storage of general waste?
column15: Storage facilities must have real-time video surveillance, with recordings kept for three months or more
column16: Storage sites must have fencing and access control, with dedicated staff signing in and inspecting daily
column17: Storage containers must be built of impermeable material and be replaced or disinfected monthly
column18: Storage sites, containers and facilities are kept clean and intact, with no scattering, dispersal, seepage or odour
column20: 第7條：一般廢棄物之貯存應符合貯存地點、容器、設施經常保持清潔完整，及不得有廢棄物飛揚、逸散、滲出、污染地面或散發惡臭情事等二款規定。第8條至第11條則分別就資源垃圾貯存場所、貯存設施及戶外貯存容器另設加重規定。
column21: Article 7 requires cleanliness and the absence of scattering, dispersal, seepage or odour.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 資源垃圾回收貯存場所除一般貯存規定外，尚應符合何項規定？
column10: 貯存設施應依收受日期先後分別貯存，並以顏色區分其貯存之期限
column11: 貯存場所應依廢棄物代碼分區堆置，並以英文及中文雙語標示其成分
column12: 貯存容器應依產生源之行政區別分別貯存，並以編號及條碼標示其來源
column13: 貯存容器、設施依所存放之資源垃圾種類分別貯存，並以中文標示其種類
column14: What further requirements apply to a recyclable waste storage site beyond the general storage rules?
column15: Facilities store recyclables separately by date of receipt, with colours distinguishing storage periods
column16: The site stacks recyclables in zones by waste code, with contents marked in both English and Chinese
column17: Containers store recyclables separately by administrative district of origin, marked by number and barcode
column18: Containers and facilities store recyclables separately by type, with the type marked in Chinese
column20: 第8條：資源垃圾回收貯存場所除應符合第7條規定外，並應依所存放之資源垃圾種類分別貯存並以中文標示、將完成分類之資源垃圾置於分區貯存格、防止打包後之資源垃圾掉落倒塌崩塌，及於適當位置標示執行機關資源垃圾回收貯存場名稱及資源回收標誌。
column21: Article 8 requires separate storage by type with Chinese labelling, zoned bins, anti-collapse measures and site signage.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 一般廢棄物之貯存設施應符合何種規定？
column10: 設置防止地面水、雨水及地下水流入滲透之設備，並收集或防止廢液廢氣惡臭污染
column11: 設置抽水泵浦定期排除積水之設備，並將收集之廢液直接排入雨水下水道系統
column12: 設置地下水監測井及自動採樣設備，並每月將監測結果報請主管機關備查
column13: 設置自動噴灑除臭藥劑之設備，並將產生之廢氣經稀釋後由高煙囪排放至大氣
column14: What requirements apply to storage facilities for general waste?
column15: Equipment preventing surface water, rainwater and groundwater from entering, plus collection or prevention of liquid, gas and odour pollution
column16: Pumps to periodically remove accumulated water, with the collected waste liquid discharged directly into the public storm sewer system
column17: Groundwater monitoring wells and automatic sampling equipment, with monthly results filed with the authority
column18: Automatic deodorant spraying equipment, with the resulting waste gas diluted and released through a tall stack
column20: 第9條：一般廢棄物之貯存設施應設置防止地面水、雨水及地下水流入、滲透之設備或措施，並就由貯存設施產生之廢液、廢氣、惡臭等，設置收集或防止其污染地面水體、地下水體、空氣、土壤之設備或措施。第10條就資源垃圾回收貯存場所之貯存設施另有加重規定。
column21: Article 9 requires water-intrusion prevention plus collection or prevention of waste liquid, gas and odour pollution.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 一般廢棄物之貯存容器置於戶外者，其設施應符合何項規定？
column10: 不洩漏污水、不發生腐敗臭味、可防止雨水滲入並可防止貓狗覓食
column11: 應以金屬材質構築、離地面五十公分以上，並設置獨立排水管線
column12: 應加裝上鎖裝置、設置監視器材，並標示容器所有人及聯絡電話
column13: 應每日清洗消毒一次、加蓋防塵網，並於夜間移入室內妥為保管
column14: What requirements apply where general waste storage containers are placed outdoors?
column15: No leakage of wastewater, no putrid odour, prevention of rainwater ingress and prevention of scavenging by cats and dogs
column16: Construction from metal, placement at least fifty centimetres above the ground, and a separate drainage pipeline
column17: Installation of locks and surveillance devices, with the container owner and a contact telephone number marked on it
column18: Daily washing and disinfection, a dust cover net, and removal indoors for safekeeping during the night
column20: 第11條：一般廢棄物之貯存容器置於戶外者，其設施應符合不洩漏污水、不發生腐敗臭味、可防止雨水滲入、可防止貓狗覓食之設備或措施、可配合一般廢棄物之清除作業，及其他經主管機關或執行機關規定者等六款規定。
column21: Article 11 lists no wastewater leakage, no putrid odour, rain prevention and scavenging prevention among the requirements.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 公共場所及營業場所設置之資源垃圾回收桶，其標示應符合何種規定？
column10: 正面標示廢棄物代碼及重量上限，依材質標示顏色區別，側面標示回收廠商聯絡方式
column11: 正面標示縣市徽章及環保宣導標語，依季節標示收運時段，側面標示清運人員姓名
column12: 正面標示執行機關全銜及回收專線，依容量標示重量上限，側面標示啟用日期及編號
column13: 正面標示資源回收標誌及資源回收桶字樣，依設置種類標示類別，側面標示設置單位名稱
column14: How must recycling bins in public and business premises be labelled?
column15: The front bears the waste code and weight limit, colours are marked by material, and the side bears the recycler's contact details
column16: The front bears the city emblem and an environmental slogan, collection hours are marked by season, and the side bears the collector's name
column17: The front bears the executing agency's full title and hotline, the weight limit is marked by capacity, and the side bears the start date and number
column18: The front bears the recycling logo and the words recycling bin, the type is marked by bin category, and the side bears the installing unit's name
column20: 第12條：執行機關設置或輔導公共場所及營業場所設置資源垃圾回收桶，其標示應於正面之適當位置標示資源回收標誌及「資源回收桶」字樣、依資源回收桶設置種類標示資源垃圾類別字樣，並於側面標示設置單位名稱。
column21: Article 12 requires the recycling logo and wording on the front, the category marking, and the installing unit's name on the side.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 執行機關應宣導民眾將一般廢棄物依何種方式排出？
column10: 廚餘應以廚餘機打碎排入下水道，尖銳利器應以舊報紙包覆丟棄，有害垃圾交清潔隊回收
column11: 廚餘先瀝除水分並妥為包裝，尖銳利器以不易穿透材質包妥標示，有害垃圾應分開排出
column12: 廚餘應先加入除臭劑冷藏保存，尖銳利器應以透明塑膠袋盛裝，有害垃圾併入一般垃圾
column13: 廚餘應先脫水乾燥並自行堆肥，尖銳利器應送交醫療院所代收，有害垃圾投入資源回收桶
column14: How should the executing agency advise the public to discharge general waste?
column15: Grind kitchen waste into the sewer, wrap sharp objects in old newspaper for disposal, and give hazardous garbage to the cleaning team
column16: Drain and wrap kitchen waste, wrap and label sharp objects in puncture-resistant material, and discharge hazardous garbage separately
column17: Refrigerate kitchen waste with deodorant added, place sharp objects in clear plastic bags, and mix hazardous garbage with general garbage
column18: Dewater and compost kitchen waste at home, hand sharp objects to medical institutions, and place hazardous garbage in recycling bins
column20: 第13條：執行機關應因地制宜宣導民眾將一般廢棄物依廚餘先瀝除水分並妥為包裝、刀片玻璃碎片等尖銳利器以不易穿透容器或材質包妥並標示、木竹片予以裁剪並綑紮、封緊垃圾袋袋口、有害垃圾應分開貯存排出、資源垃圾依回收管道分類貯存排出及回收等方式排出。
column21: Article 13 requires draining and wrapping kitchen waste, puncture-resistant wrapping of sharps, and separate discharge of hazardous garbage.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 巨大垃圾應以何種方式交付回收、清除或處理？
column10: 交付執行機關或受託機構之資源垃圾回收車回收，並於指定時間送至回收桶站
column11: 交付執行機關或受託機構之專用車輛清除，並應先行拆解為體積較小之零組件
column12: 洽請執行機關或受託機構安排時間排出，並應符合執行機關規定之清除處理方式
column13: 逕行投置於執行機關設置之一般垃圾貯存設備內，並於外包裝標示排出者姓名
column14: How must bulky garbage be handed over for recycling, clearance or disposal?
column15: Hand it to the recyclable waste collection vehicle of the agency or entrusted institution at the designated collection station
column16: Hand it to the dedicated vehicle of the agency or entrusted institution after first dismantling it into smaller components
column17: Arrange a discharge time with the executing agency or its entrusted institution, following the prescribed clearance method
column18: Place it directly in the general garbage storage equipment set up by the executing agency, marked with the discharger's name
column20: 第14條第1項第1款：巨大垃圾應洽請執行機關或執行機關委託之公民營廢棄物清除處理機構（受託機構）安排時間排出，並應符合執行機關規定之清除處理方式。同項第3款有害垃圾始為交付專用車輛清除；第2款資源垃圾始為交付資源垃圾回收車回收。
column21: Article 14, paragraph 1, subparagraph 1 requires arranging a discharge time with the agency or its entrusted institution.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 巨大垃圾、有害垃圾、一般垃圾及廚餘之清運機具應符合何種規定？
column10: 具備即時追蹤系統及自動計量設備並每日消毒，車體規格符合廢棄物清理法相關規定
column11: 具備密閉壓縮裝置及自動秤重設備並每季檢驗，車體規格符合噪音管制標準之規定
column12: 具備影像監視系統及氣體偵測裝置並每週保養，車體規格符合空氣污染防制法之規定
column13: 具備作業安全警示系統及防漏功能並經常清洗消毒，車體規格符合道路交通安全規則
column14: What requirements apply to clearance vehicles for bulky, hazardous, general and kitchen waste?
column15: Real-time tracking systems and automatic weighing equipment, daily disinfection, and body specifications meeting the Waste Disposal Act
column16: Sealed compaction devices and automatic weighing equipment, quarterly inspection, and body specifications meeting noise control standards
column17: Video surveillance systems and gas detection devices, weekly maintenance, and body specifications meeting the Air Pollution Control Act
column18: Necessary safety warning systems and leak prevention, frequent washing and disinfection, and body specifications meeting road traffic safety rules
column20: 第15條：巨大垃圾、有害垃圾、一般垃圾及廚餘清運機具，應具備必要之作業安全警示系統及防漏功能並經常清洗、消毒以保持清潔，經常保養維持正常操作，且車輛之車體規格符合道路交通安全規則之規定。第18條並規定租用之車輛亦應符合本條規定。
column21: Article 15 requires safety warning systems, leak prevention, cleaning and compliance with road traffic safety rules.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 執行機關或受託機構之資源垃圾回收車應符合何種規定？
column10: 裝置舉伸或傾卸設備，車體標示資源回收標誌，並標示回收單位名稱、專線與回收項目
column11: 裝置即時追蹤及計量設備，車體標示廢棄物代碼，並標示回收處理業名稱與許可證字號
column12: 裝置壓縮或破碎設備，車體標示執行機關全銜，並標示車輛編號、載重上限與駕駛姓名
column13: 裝置冷藏或除臭設備，車體標示環保宣導圖樣，並標示收運路線、時段與聯絡之地址
column14: What requirements apply to a recyclable waste collection vehicle?
column15: Lifting or tipping equipment, the recycling logo on the body, and the collecting unit's name, hotline and collected items marked
column16: Real-time tracking and weighing equipment, the waste code on the body, and the recycling enterprise's name and permit number marked
column17: Compaction or crushing equipment, the executing agency's full title on the body, and the vehicle number, load limit and driver's name marked
column18: Refrigeration or deodorizing equipment, an environmental graphic on the body, and the route, time slots and contact address marked
column20: 第16條：資源垃圾回收車應裝置舉伸或傾卸設備、車體與車身應標示資源回收標誌、於適當位置標示回收單位名稱、回收服務專線與回收項目、具備必要之作業安全警示系統並經常清洗消毒、經常保養維持正常操作，且車體規格符合道路交通安全規則之規定。
column21: Article 16 requires lifting or tipping equipment, the recycling logo, and marking of the unit's name, hotline and items.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 執行機關之垃圾車應如何標示？密封式及框式垃圾車應具備何種安全警示系統？
column10: 應於車身標示資源回收標誌及專線；並具有固定式綠色指示燈及自動廣播系統
column11: 應於車身標示車輛編號及駕駛姓名；並具有間歇式藍色閃爍燈及倒車雷達裝置
column12: 應於車身標示機關全銜及車種名稱；並具有固定式黃色閃爍指示燈及廣播設備
column13: 應於車身標示執行區域及清運路線；並具有旋轉式紅色警示燈及蜂鳴警報裝置
column14: How must an executing agency's garbage truck be marked, and what warning system must sealed and frame trucks carry?
column15: The recycling logo and hotline on the body; a fixed green indicator light and an automatic broadcasting system
column16: The vehicle number and driver's name on the body; an intermittent blue flashing light and a reversing radar device
column17: The agency's full title and vehicle type on the body; a fixed yellow flashing indicator light and broadcasting equipment
column18: The service area and clearance route on the body; a rotating red warning light and a buzzer alarm device
column20: 第16條之1第1項：執行機關回收、清除一般廢棄物所使用之垃圾車，應於車身標示機關全銜及車種名稱，並就密封式、子母式、框式垃圾車分別規定應具備之投棄口、壓縮裝置或吊桿升降設備。第2項：密封式及框式垃圾車應具有固定式黃色閃爍指示燈及廣播設備之安全警示系統。
column21: Article 16-1 requires the agency title and vehicle type, plus a fixed yellow flashing light and broadcasting equipment.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 小型清掃機械使用證應向何機關申請？操作人員應遵守何種規定？
column10: 向所在地之鄉（鎮、市）公所申請並報備查；駕駛人應領有機車駕駛執照並接受八小時教育訓練
column11: 向所在地之公路監理機關申請並定期換發；駕駛人應領有小型車職業駕駛執照並通過體格檢查
column12: 向清掃作業所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請；駕駛人應領有小型車普通駕駛執照並隨身攜帶使用證
column13: 向中央主管機關指定之機構申請核發；駕駛人應領有大型車職業駕駛執照並隨身攜帶行車執照
column14: To which authority is a small sweeping machine permit applied for, and what must the operator observe?
column15: To the township or city office of the location for recordation; the driver holds a motorcycle licence and completes eight hours of training
column16: To the local motor vehicle office with periodic renewal; the driver holds a professional light vehicle licence and passes a physical examination
column17: To the municipal or county (city) authority where sweeping is carried out; the driver holds an ordinary light vehicle licence and carries the permit
column18: To an institution designated by the central competent authority; the driver holds a professional heavy vehicle licence and carries the registration
column20: 第16條之2第1項：小型清掃機械使用證，由執行機關或其委託執行道路清掃作業之廠商，向清掃作業所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請。第3項第1款：駕駛人應領有小型車普通駕駛執照，並隨身攜帶小型清掃機械使用證；第2款並要求設置適當交通管制設施導引車流。
column21: Article 16-2 requires application to the local authority where sweeping occurs and an ordinary light vehicle licence plus carrying the permit.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 一般廢棄物轉運設施之操作紀錄應如何辦理？
column10: 轉運設施之操作應逐月記錄，紀錄並應保存三年以供查核
column11: 轉運設施之操作應逐批記錄，紀錄並應保存十年以供查核
column12: 轉運設施之操作應逐季記錄，紀錄並應保存五年以供查核
column13: 轉運設施之操作應逐日記錄，紀錄並應保存一年以供查核
column14: How must operating records of a general waste transfer facility be kept?
column15: Operations are recorded monthly and the records kept for three years for inspection
column16: Operations are recorded per batch and the records kept for ten years for inspection
column17: Operations are recorded quarterly and the records kept for five years for inspection
column18: Operations are recorded daily and the records kept for one year for inspection
column20: 第17條第5款：轉運設施之操作應逐日記錄，紀錄並保存一年供查核。同條並要求轉運設施內具備防止再次污染環境之防治設備、消毒設備、適當之災害防止及緊急應變措施，且轉運過程應保持設施內外之環境衛生。
column21: Article 17, subparagraph 5 requires daily records kept for one year.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 執行機關辦理一般廢棄物清除業務，其車輛機具不足時得如何處理？
column10: 得逕行商請鄰近縣市之執行機關支援，並由支援機關自行指派人員隨車運送
column11: 得租用合法運輸業之車輛協助清除，並應由租用之機關（構）派員隨車運送
column12: 得委託未取得許可之民間車行代為清運，並由該車行負責人隨車監督運送
column13: 得徵用轄內私人自用小貨車協助清運，並由車主自行負責清運過程之安全
column14: What may an executing agency do when it lacks vehicles for general waste clearance?
column15: Directly request support from executing agencies in neighbouring counties, which assign their own accompanying staff
column16: Rent vehicles from a lawful transport operator, with the renting agency assigning staff to accompany each trip
column17: Entrust an unlicensed private vehicle operator, whose responsible person supervises the transport on board
column18: Requisition privately owned light trucks in the jurisdiction, with owners responsible for transport safety
column20: 第18條第1項：執行機關或本法第11條第9款之管理機構辦理一般廢棄物清除業務，其車輛機具不足時，得租用合法運輸業之車輛協助清除一般廢棄物，並應由租用之機關（構）派員隨車運送。第2項：租用之車輛應符合第15條及第16條之規定。
column21: Article 18 allows renting lawful transport vehicles, with the renting agency's staff accompanying the transport.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 一般廢棄物之處理設施應符合何種規定？
column10: 具防火防爆結構、與廢棄物接觸表面採混凝土構築、周圍具防止噪音外洩之隔音牆面
column11: 具耐重載結構、與廢棄物接觸表面採塑膠襯裡構築、周圍具防止車輛進入之阻隔設施
column12: 具堅固基礎結構、與廢棄物接觸表面採抗蝕材料構築、周圍具防止地表水流入之設備
column13: 具防震隔震結構、與廢棄物接觸表面採不鏽鋼構築、周圍具防止動物侵入之圍籬設施
column14: What requirements apply to general waste disposal facilities?
column15: A fire and explosion resistant structure, concrete on waste-contact surfaces, and sound barriers preventing noise escaping
column16: A heavy-load structure, plastic lining on waste-contact surfaces, and barriers preventing vehicles from entering the site
column17: A solid foundation structure, corrosion-resistant material on waste-contact surfaces, and equipment preventing surface water inflow
column18: An earthquake-isolating structure, stainless steel on waste-contact surfaces, and fencing preventing animals from entering
column20: 第19條：一般廢棄物之處理設施應具堅固之基礎結構、設施與廢棄物接觸之表面採抗蝕材料構築、周圍具防止地表水流入之設備、具污染防治設備及防蝕措施，及其他經主管機關規定者。第20條至第31條各種處理方式之設施均應先符合本條規定。
column21: Article 19 requires a solid foundation, corrosion-resistant contact surfaces and surface-water inflow prevention.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 一般廢棄物採破碎、分選及壓縮處理者，其設施尚應符合何種規定？
column10: 具備防止溢流及滲漏警報之功能，並具備防止蚊蠅、鼠類及惡臭孳生之設備或措施
column11: 具備防止及警示火災、爆炸之功能，並具備防止噪音、臭味及污水處理之設備或措施
column12: 具備自動停機及斷電保護之功能，並具備防止粉塵、輻射及廢氣排放之設備或措施
column13: 具備遠端遙控及影像監視之功能，並具備防止震動、油污及廢水回收之設備或措施
column14: What further requirements apply to crushing, sorting and compaction facilities for general waste?
column15: Functions to warn of overflow and seepage, plus equipment or measures against mosquitoes, flies, rodents and odour generation
column16: Functions to prevent and warn of fire and explosion, plus equipment or measures against noise and odour and for wastewater treatment
column17: Functions for automatic shutdown and power cut protection, plus equipment or measures against dust, radiation and waste gas emission
column18: Functions for remote control and video monitoring, plus equipment or measures against vibration and oil and for wastewater recovery
column20: 第20條：一般廢棄物採破碎、分選及壓縮處理者，其設施除應符合第19條規定外，並應具備防止及警示火災、爆炸之功能，及具備防止噪音、臭味及污水處理之設備或措施。
column21: Article 20 requires fire and explosion prevention and warning, plus noise, odour and wastewater controls.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 糞尿中間處理設施採生物化學處理者，應具備何種設備？
column10: 應具有投入、貯留、氧化處理及上澄液再處理之設備，並免設污泥處理設備
column11: 應具有投入、貯留、加藥、固液分離、中和及分離液處理之各項處理設備
column12: 應具有投入、脫水、乾燥、造粒、包裝及成品貯存之各項處理與貯存設備
column13: 應具有投入、貯留、消化處理、上澄液再處理、污泥處理及消毒之各項設備
column14: What equipment must a night soil intermediate treatment facility using biochemical treatment have?
column15: Equipment for feeding, storage, oxidation and supernatant re-treatment, with no sludge treatment equipment required
column16: Equipment for feeding, storage, chemical dosing, solid-liquid separation, neutralization and separated liquid treatment
column17: Equipment for feeding, dewatering, drying, granulation, packaging and finished product storage at the facility
column18: Equipment for feeding, storage, digestion, supernatant re-treatment, sludge treatment and disinfection
column20: 第21條第1款：糞尿中間處理設施採生物化學處理者，應具有投入、貯留、消化處理、上澄液再處理、污泥處理及消毒之設備。第2款採氧化處理者應具投入、貯留、氧化處理及上澄液再處理之設備；第3款採化學處理者應具投入、貯留、加藥、固液分離、中和、分離液處理及污泥處理之設備。
column21: Article 21, subparagraph 1 lists feeding, storage, digestion, supernatant re-treatment, sludge treatment and disinfection.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 糞尿利用為肥料或提供肥分者，須經何種處理方式？
column10: 須經高溫焚化處理、灰渣穩定化、固化包裝或其他符合規定之處理方式
column11: 須經充分醱酵腐熟處理、加溫處理、藥劑消毒處理或其他符合規定之處理方式
column12: 須經固液分離處理、逆滲透過濾、活性碳吸附或其他符合規定之處理方式
column13: 須經稀釋沉澱處理、曝氣消毒、離心脫水或其他符合規定之處理方式
column14: What treatment is required where night soil is used as fertilizer or to supply nutrients?
column15: High-temperature incineration, ash stabilization, solidification and packaging, or another prescribed treatment
column16: Full fermentation and maturation, heating, chemical disinfection, or another treatment meeting the prescribed requirements
column17: Solid-liquid separation, reverse osmosis filtration, activated carbon adsorption, or another prescribed treatment
column18: Dilution and sedimentation, aeration disinfection, centrifugal dewatering, or another prescribed treatment
column20: 第22條：糞尿利用為肥料或提供肥分者，須經充分醱酵腐熟處理、加溫處理、藥劑消毒處理或其他符合主管機關及目的事業主管機關規定之處理方式。第26條第2款並就施用農地之堆肥規定醱酵堆中心溫度及維持天數。
column21: Article 22 requires full fermentation and maturation, heating, chemical disinfection or another prescribed method.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 動物屍體之處理原則為何？
column10: 以掩埋處理為原則，必要時得採焚化或其他經主管機關規定之方式處理
column11: 以堆肥處理為原則，必要時得採冷凍或其他經主管機關規定之方式處理
column12: 以焚化處理為原則，必要時得採掩埋或其他經主管機關規定之方式處理
column13: 以化製處理為原則，必要時得採海拋或其他經主管機關規定之方式處理
column14: What is the principle for disposing of animal carcasses?
column15: Landfill in principle, with incineration or another prescribed method used where necessary
column16: Composting in principle, with freezing or another prescribed method used where necessary
column17: Incineration in principle, with landfill or another prescribed method used where necessary
column18: Rendering in principle, with ocean dumping or another prescribed method where necessary
column20: 第23條：動物屍體以焚化處理為原則，必要時得採掩埋或其他主管機關及目的事業主管機關規定之方式處理。焚化處理設施並應符合第19條及第24條之規定。
column21: Article 23 makes incineration the principle, with landfill or another prescribed method where necessary.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 一般廢棄物採焚化處理以外之熱處理法者，其設施應符合何項規定？
column10: 應符合第十九條及第二十四條全部各款有關焚化設施之規定，不得減省
column11: 應符合第二十條有關破碎分選設施及第二十六條堆肥設施之各項規定
column12: 應符合第二十九條有關衛生掩埋設施及第三十條掩埋作業之各項規定
column13: 應符合第十九條及第二十四條第一款、第二款、第六款、第七款之規定
column14: Which provisions must facilities using thermal treatment other than incineration meet?
column15: Article 19 and all subparagraphs of Article 24 on incineration facilities, with no reduction
column16: Article 20 on crushing and sorting facilities and Article 26 on composting facilities
column17: Article 29 on sanitary landfill facilities and Article 30 on landfill operations
column18: Article 19 and Article 24, subparagraphs 1, 2, 6 and 7
column20: 第25條：一般廢棄物採焚化處理以外之熱處理法處理者，其設施應符合第19條及第24條第1款（進料計量及檢查設備）、第2款（消防及臭氣處理設備、滲出水收集系統）、第6款（緊急應變處理裝置）、第7款（其他經主管機關規定者）之規定。第2條第15款並定義熱處理法包括焚化法、熱解法、熔融法等。
column21: Article 25 requires compliance with Article 19 and Article 24, subparagraphs 1, 2, 6 and 7.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 一般廢棄物採堆肥處理，施用農地之堆肥其醱酵過程之溫度規定為何？
column10: 醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏二十度至四十度間，並最少三十天維持攝氏三十度以上
column11: 醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏四十五度至七十度間，並最少七天維持攝氏五十度以上
column12: 醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏六十度至九十度間，並最少十四天維持攝氏七十度以上
column13: 醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏三十度至五十度間，並最少三天維持攝氏四十度以上
column14: What fermentation temperatures apply to compost from general waste applied to farmland?
column15: The pile core temperature is kept between 20 C and 40 C, and at 30 C or above for at least thirty days
column16: The pile core temperature is kept between 45 C and 70 C, and at 50 C or above for at least seven days
column17: The pile core temperature is kept between 60 C and 90 C, and at 70 C or above for at least fourteen days
column18: The pile core temperature is kept between 30 C and 50 C, and at 40 C or above for at least three days
column20: 第26條第2款：施用農地之堆肥，除高速堆肥外，醱酵過程中醱酵堆中心溫度應維持在攝氏四十五度至七十度間，及最少七天維持攝氏五十度以上，並符合肥料管理法之規定。第3款：堆肥供作土壤改良或園藝植物栽培使用時，應防止土壤或地下水污染，並得不受前款限制。
column21: Article 26, subparagraph 2 requires 45 to 70 C with at least seven days at 50 C or above.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 灰渣及其處理後衍生物之運作申報及清運機具有何規定？
column10: 應以網路傳輸方式向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申報，清運機具並應裝置即時追蹤系統
column11: 應以網路傳輸方式向目的事業主管機關申報，清運機具並應加裝車廂密閉監視系統
column12: 應以電子郵件方式向當地執行機關逐月通報，清運機具並應張貼灰渣運送專用標誌
column13: 應以書面方式向中央主管機關按季報備，清運機具並應加裝自動計量及秤重之設備
column14: What reporting and vehicle requirements apply to incineration ash and its derivatives?
column15: Report online to the municipal or county (city) competent authority, and fit clearance vehicles with a real-time tracking system
column16: Report online to the industry competent authority, and fit clearance vehicles with a sealed compartment monitoring system
column17: Report by email to the local executing agency each month, and display a dedicated ash transport marking on the vehicles
column18: Report in writing to the central competent authority each quarter, and fit clearance vehicles with automatic weighing equipment
column20: 第27條之1第1項：灰渣及其處理後衍生物之產出、貯存、清除、處理、再利用，應準用本法第31條第1項第2款規定，以網路傳輸方式向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申報。第2項：其清運機具應準用本法第31條第1項第3款規定，裝置即時追蹤系統並維持正常運作。
column21: Article 27-1 requires online reporting to the local authority and real-time tracking systems on clearance vehicles.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 得以安定掩埋法處理之一般廢棄物種類及終止使用時之覆蓋規定為何？
column10: 廢玻璃、廢陶瓷、廢磚瓦及石材碎片等；終止使用時覆蓋厚度五十公分以上砂質或泥質黏土
column11: 焚化飛灰、底渣及其衍生物等；終止使用時覆蓋厚度一百公分以上之砂質或泥質黏土
column12: 廚餘、廢食用油及廢照明光源等；終止使用時覆蓋厚度二十公分以上之砂質或泥質黏土
column13: 有害垃圾、廢電池及廢農藥容器等；終止使用時覆蓋厚度十五公分以上之砂質黏土層
column14: Which general wastes may go to stabilized landfill, and what final cover applies?
column15: Waste glass, ceramics, bricks and stone fragments; at least 50 cm of sandy or silty clay upon termination of use
column16: Incineration fly ash, bottom ash and their derivatives; at least 100 cm of sandy or silty clay upon termination
column17: Kitchen waste, waste cooking oil and waste lighting sources; at least 20 cm of sandy or silty clay upon termination
column18: Hazardous garbage, waste batteries and pesticide containers; at least 15 cm of a sandy clay layer upon termination
column20: 第28條：一般廢棄物中之廢玻璃、廢陶瓷、廢磚瓦、石材碎片（塊）或經中央主管機關指定者，得以安定掩埋法處理；其設施除應符合第19條規定外，並應於入口處豎立標示牌、周圍設圍牆與防止飛散設備、設置防止地盤滑動沈陷措施及水土保持措施，終止使用時應覆蓋厚度五十公分以上之砂質或泥質黏土。
column21: Article 28 covers waste glass, ceramics, bricks and stone, with 50 cm of clay cover on termination.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 灰渣採穩定化法處理後以衛生掩埋處理者，應如何辦理？
column10: 應運至專屬灰渣掩埋場，設置封閉掩埋單元並以抗壓材質構築，每月檢測滲出水之水質
column11: 應獨立分區掩埋，設置獨立滲出水收集系統並以雙層不透水材質構築，每季檢測相關水質
column12: 應與一般垃圾混合掩埋，設置共用滲出水收集系統並以單層黏土構築，每年檢測相關水質
column13: 應獨立分區掩埋，設置沼氣收集處理設施並以人造材質襯裡，每半年檢測地下水之水質
column14: How must stabilized incineration ash be handled when placed in a sanitary landfill?
column15: Transport to a dedicated ash landfill with a closed landfill cell built of pressure-resistant material, with monthly leachate testing
column16: Landfill in an independent zone with an independent leachate collection system built of double impermeable material, with quarterly water testing
column17: Landfill mixed with general garbage using a shared leachate collection system built of single-layer clay, with annual water testing
column18: Landfill in an independent zone with biogas collection facilities and artificial lining material, with semi-annual groundwater testing
column20: 第31條第1項第1款：灰渣採穩定化法處理後以衛生掩埋處理者，應獨立分區掩埋，設置獨立之滲出水收集系統及獨立分區設施，以雙層不透水材質構築，並設置間隔堤（牆）及防止滑動崩塌之設施。第2款：應每季定期檢測滲出水處理後及上下游地下水監測井水質，超標時一個月內提報因應措施。
column21: Article 31, paragraph 1 requires independent zoned landfill, an independent leachate system, double impermeable construction and quarterly testing.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 有害垃圾採封閉掩埋處理者，應適用何種規定？
column10: 準用事業廢棄物貯存清除處理方法及設施標準之規定辦理
column11: 準用一般廢棄物掩埋場營運管理計畫所定之規定辦理
column12: 準用公民營廢棄物清除處理機構許可管理辦法之規定辦理
column13: 準用有害事業廢棄物認定標準所定之溶出試驗規定辦理
column14: Which rules apply where hazardous garbage is placed in a closed landfill?
column15: The Standards for Industrial Waste Storage, Clearance and Disposal Methods and Facilities apply mutatis mutandis
column16: The operational management plan for general waste landfill sites applies mutatis mutandis
column17: The Regulations Governing Permits for Public and Private Waste Institutions apply mutatis mutandis
column18: The leaching test rules of the hazardous industrial waste identification standards apply mutatis mutandis
column20: 第32條：有害垃圾採封閉掩埋處理者，準用事業廢棄物貯存清除處理方法及設施標準之規定。第2條第22款並定義封閉掩埋法指將有害垃圾掩埋於以抗壓及雙層不透水材質所構築，並設有阻止污染物外洩及地下水監測裝置之處理方法。
column21: Article 32 applies the Standards for Industrial Waste Storage, Clearance and Disposal Methods and Facilities.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 掩埋場封場復育計畫之地下水監測頻率及終止監測之條件為何？
column10: 上下游地下水監測井每半年檢測一次；監測至少七年且最後二年連續符合規定者得申請終止
column11: 上下游地下水監測井每季檢測一次；監測至少三年且最後一年連續符合規定者得申請終止
column12: 上下游地下水監測井每月檢測一次；監測至少十年且最後五年連續符合規定者得申請終止
column13: 上下游地下水監測井每年檢測一次；監測至少五年且最後三年連續符合規定者得申請終止
column14: How often is groundwater monitored under a closure restoration plan, and when may monitoring end?
column15: Up and down gradient wells are tested every six months; monitoring runs at least seven years and may end after two compliant final years
column16: Up and down gradient wells are tested every quarter; monitoring runs at least three years and may end after one compliant final year
column17: Up and down gradient wells are tested every month; monitoring runs at least ten years and may end after five compliant final years
column18: Up and down gradient wells are tested every year; monitoring runs at least five years and may end after three compliant final years
column20: 第32條之2第1項：封場復育計畫之環境監測類別應包含上下游地下水監測井水質，檢測項目包括砷、鎘、鉻、銅、鉛、汞、鎳及鋅，且每半年檢測一次。第3項：封場後環境監測至少執行七年，最後二年連續符合未處理滲出水低於放流水標準、地下水低於監測標準者，得報請中央主管機關同意後終止。
column21: Article 32-2 requires semi-annual testing, at least seven years of monitoring, and two consecutive compliant final years.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 掩埋場監測作業之執行紀錄應保存幾年？監測成果應於何時公開？
column10: 監測紀錄應妥善保存三年；監測成果應於取得結果之次季季底前由中央主管機關彙整後公告
column11: 監測紀錄應妥善保存一年；監測成果應於取得結果之次年年底前由執行機關函送議會備查
column12: 監測紀錄應妥善保存十年；監測成果應於取得結果之當月月底前由目的事業主管機關公開
column13: 監測紀錄應妥善保存五年；監測成果應於取得結果之次月月底前由地方主管機關登錄網站公開
column14: How long are landfill monitoring records kept, and when are results published?
column15: Records are kept for three years; results are compiled and announced by the central authority by the end of the following quarter
column16: Records are kept for one year; results are sent by the executing agency to the council for recordation by the end of the next year
column17: Records are kept for ten years; results are published by the industry competent authority by the end of the month they are obtained
column18: Records are kept for five years; results are posted online by the local authority by the end of the month after they are obtained
column20: 第32條之3第1項：第30條第1項第3款、第31條第1項第2款及第32條之2第1項之監測作業執行情形應作成紀錄，妥善保存五年。第2項：環境監測執行成果應於取得監測結果之次月月底前，由直轄市、縣（市）主管機關登錄於網站予以公開。
column21: Article 32-3 requires five-year retention and online publication by the local authority by the end of the following month.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 再利用機構對於一般廢棄物再利用之紀錄應如何辦理？
column10: 應按月作成種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理紀錄，並妥善保存三年以供查核
column11: 應按日作成種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理紀錄，並妥善保存一年以供查核
column12: 應按年作成種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理紀錄，並妥善保存十年以供查核
column13: 應按季作成種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理紀錄，並妥善保存五年以供查核
column14: How must a reuse institution keep records of general waste reuse?
column15: Make monthly records of type, source, quantity, use and residual waste handling, and keep them for three years for inspection
column16: Make daily records of type, source, quantity, use and residual waste handling, and keep them for one year for inspection
column17: Make annual records of type, source, quantity, use and residual waste handling, and keep them for ten years for inspection
column18: Make quarterly records of type, source, quantity, use and residual waste handling, and keep them for five years for inspection
column20: 第34條第3項：再利用機構對於一般廢棄物再利用之種類、來源、數量、用途及剩餘廢棄物處理，應按月作成紀錄，並妥善保存相關紀錄及證明文件三年，以供查核。第1項並規定再利用應依公告方式辦理或報經中央主管機關核准；第4項規定技術研發得專案向直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請同意文件。
column21: Article 34, paragraph 3 requires monthly records kept for three years.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 一般廢棄物採海洋棄置法處理者，應符合何種法律之規定？
column10: 應符合水污染防治法之規定辦理其海洋棄置作業
column11: 應符合海洋污染防治法之規定辦理其海洋棄置作業
column12: 應符合國土計畫法之規定辦理其海洋棄置之作業
column13: 應符合海岸管理法之規定辦理其海洋棄置之作業
column14: Which Act governs the ocean dumping of general waste?
column15: The Water Pollution Control Act governs the ocean dumping operation
column16: The Marine Pollution Control Act governs the ocean dumping operation
column17: The Spatial Planning Act governs the ocean dumping operation involved
column18: The Coastal Zone Management Act governs the ocean dumping operation
column20: 第35條：一般廢棄物採海洋棄置法處理者，應符合海洋污染防治法之規定。第2條第13款第2目並將海洋棄置列為最終處置方式之一。
column21: Article 35 requires compliance with the Marine Pollution Control Act.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 回收處理業回收貯存清除處理應回收廢棄物，其設施未符本辦法規定者應如何處理？
column10: 應於本辦法修正施行之日起三個月內完成改善其不符規定之設施
column11: 應於本辦法修正施行之日起一年內完成改善其不符規定之相關設施
column12: 應於本辦法修正施行之日起六個月內完成改善其不符規定之設施
column13: 應於本辦法修正施行之日起三年內完成改善其不符規定之相關設施
column14: What deadline applies where a recycling enterprise's facilities do not meet these Regulations?
column15: Complete the improvement of the non-compliant facilities within three months of the Regulations taking effect
column16: Complete the improvement of the non-compliant facilities within one year of the amended Regulations taking effect
column17: Complete the improvement of the non-compliant facilities within six months of the Regulations taking effect
column18: Complete the improvement of the non-compliant facilities within three years of the amended Regulations taking effect
column20: 第36條之1第1項：回收處理業回收貯存清除處理本法所定之應回收廢棄物，其設施未符合本辦法規定者，應於本辦法修正施行之日起一年內完成改善。第2項：修正施行前已完成建造、建造中、完成招標或已發包簽約之處理設施，不受第29條第1項第4款規定限制。
column21: Article 36-1, paragraph 1 gives one year from the effective date of the amendment.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，應如何適用本辦法？
column10: 執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，得準用本辦法之規定辦理
column11: 執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，應另依事業廢棄物規定辦理
column12: 執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，應報中央主管機關核准
column13: 執行機關不得受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾，應由事業自行清理
column14: How do these Regulations apply where an executing agency is entrusted with an enterprise's recyclable waste?
column15: These Regulations apply mutatis mutandis to recyclable waste from enterprises cleared by the executing agency
column16: Such recyclable waste must instead be handled under the separate rules that govern industrial waste
column17: Such recyclable waste requires the prior approval of the central competent authority before any clearance
column18: An executing agency may not accept such recyclable waste, which the generating enterprise must clear itself
column20: 第37條：執行機關受託清除處理事業產生之資源垃圾得準用本辦法之規定。第6條第8項並規定執行機關受託處理一般事業廢棄物採焚化法、衛生掩埋法處理者，準用第19條、第24條、第29條及第30條規定。
column21: Article 37 allows these Regulations to apply mutatis mutandis.

column4: 一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法
column9: 本辦法之施行日期規定為何？
column10: 本辦法自發布後六個月施行
column11: 本辦法自公布後三個月施行
column12: 本辦法自發布後一年起施行
column13: 本辦法自發布日施行
column14: When do these Regulations take effect?
column15: These Regulations take effect six months after promulgation
column16: These Regulations take effect three months after publication
column17: These Regulations take effect one year after promulgation
column18: These Regulations take effect on the date of promulgation
column20: 第38條：本辦法自發布日施行。本辦法最近一次修正日期為民國一百十四年一月三日，其新增之第6條之2並就裝潢修繕廢棄物申報訂有分階段適用期程。
column21: Article 38 provides that the Regulations take effect on the date of promulgation.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 《應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法》之訂定法源依據為何？
column10: 依廢棄物清理法第十五條第二項規定訂定之
column11: 依廢棄物清理法第十六條第四項規定訂定之
column12: 依資源回收再利用法第十六條第四項規定訂定
column13: 依廢棄物清理法第十二條第一項規定訂定之
column14: Under which provision are these Regulations enacted?
column15: Enacted under Article 15, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column16: Enacted under Article 16, paragraph 4 of the Waste Disposal Act
column17: Enacted under Article 16, paragraph 4 of the Resource Recycling Act
column18: Enacted under Article 12, paragraph 1 of the Waste Disposal Act
column20: 第1條：本辦法依廢棄物清理法（本法）第十六條第四項規定訂定之。本法第十五條第二項為應回收物品之公告依據，第十二條第一項則為一般廢棄物回收清除處理辦法之授權依據。
column21: Article 1 cites Article 16, paragraph 4 of the Waste Disposal Act.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 本辦法所稱「責任物」之定義為何？
column10: 指經中央主管機關依本法第十六條第一項公告應設置回收設施之物品，及其銷售用之包裝與容器
column11: 指經直轄市、縣（市）主管機關公告應強制分類回收之一般廢棄物項目，及其製造使用之原料
column12: 指物品或其包裝、容器經中央主管機關依本法第十五條第二項公告者，及該物品或其包裝、容器之原料
column13: 指經目的事業主管機關認定具回收再利用價值之物品或容器，及其製造過程所使用之各項原料
column14: How are responsibility goods defined under these Regulations?
column15: Goods announced by the central authority under Article 16, paragraph 1 as requiring recycling facilities, plus their sales packaging
column16: General waste items announced by the municipal or county (city) authority as subject to mandatory sorting, plus their raw materials
column17: Goods or their packaging or containers announced by the central authority under Article 15, paragraph 2, and the raw materials of those items
column18: Goods or containers recognized by the industry competent authority as having recycling value, plus the materials used to make them
column20: 第2條第1款：責任物指物品或其包裝、容器經中央主管機關依本法第十五條第二項公告者，及該物品或其包裝、容器之原料。同條第2款定義營業量（製造業者為銷售量、容器商品製造業者為容器購入量及生產量等），第3款定義進口量。
column21: Article 2, subparagraph 1 covers announced goods, their packaging and containers, and the raw materials of those items.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 責任業者停止製造、輸入責任物者得如何辦理？經廢止登記後有何效果？
column10: 得檢具廢止登記申請表等文件申請廢止登記；經廢止登記者免依本辦法辦理申報及繳費
column11: 應於停止之日起三年內維持登記不得廢止；該期間仍應依規定辦理申報及繳費作業
column12: 應報請所在地主管機關備查後自動失其登記效力；並得就已繳費用申請全額之退還
column13: 得檢具停業證明文件申請暫停列管一年；暫停期間仍應按期辦理申報但得免予繳費
column14: What may a responsibility enterprise do when it stops manufacturing or importing, and what follows from deregistration?
column15: Apply for deregistration with the application form and related documents; once deregistered it need not declare or pay under these Regulations
column16: Maintain the registration for three years from stopping without deregistering, and continue to declare and pay during that period
column17: Report to the local competent authority for recordation, whereupon registration lapses automatically and all fees paid may be refunded
column18: Apply for a one-year suspension of control with a business suspension certificate; it must still declare on time but is exempt from payment
column20: 第5條第1項：責任業者停止製造、輸入責任物或有其他經認定免予列管情形者，得檢具廢止登記申請表（含切結聲明）、負責人身分證明文件影本、停工停業歇業或廢止公司登記證明文件影本等，向中央主管機關申請廢止登記。第3項：經廢止登記者免依本辦法辦理申報、繳費；恢復製造輸入者應重新辦理登記、申報及繳費。
column21: Article 5 allows deregistration on application, after which declaration and payment obligations cease.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 責任業者採用查定營業量或進口量後，於何種情形應改依規定自行申報、繳費？
column10: 負責人或公司登記地址有所變更，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣一千二百元者
column11: 責任物項目增加或減少一項以上，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣一百萬元以上
column12: 營業狀況變動致與查定量有些微差異，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣五十萬元者
column13: 營業狀況變動致與查定量有重大差異，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣五萬元以上者
column14: When must an enterprise using assessed volumes switch back to declaring and paying on its own?
column15: Where the responsible person or the registered company address changes, or an audit shows an annual difference over NT$1,200
column16: Where the number of responsibility goods items rises or falls by one or more, or an audit shows a difference over NT$1,000,000
column17: Where changed business conditions differ slightly from the assessed volume, or an audit shows an annual difference over NT$500,000
column18: Where changed business conditions differ materially from the assessed volume, or an audit shows an annual difference over NT$50,000
column20: 第8條第1項：責任業者採用查定營業量或進口量後，其營業狀況變動致與查定量有重大差異，或經主管機關查核年度差異超過新臺幣五萬元以上者，應依第6條或第9條規定自行申報、繳費。第2項：經查核有短漏者，應令其補繳短漏金額。
column21: Article 8, paragraph 1 applies where there is a material difference or an audited annual difference over NT$50,000.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 責任業者營業量或進口量之申報，應以何種方式為之？
column10: 應以書面方式向所在地主管機關遞送申報表並檢附發票影本；經同意者得改以網路申報
column11: 應以電子郵件方式向中央主管機關指定信箱申報並附繳費證明；不得使用網路申報系統
column12: 應以網路傳輸方式向中央主管機關網路申報系統申報並免檢具申報表；經同意者得書面申報
column13: 應以網路傳輸方式向所在地主管機關申報並同時檢具申報表；不得以任何方式改為書面
column14: How must business or import volumes be declared?
column15: In writing to the local competent authority with the declaration form and invoice copies; online filing is allowed only with consent
column16: By email to a mailbox designated by the central authority with payment proof; the online declaration system may not be used
column17: Online through the central authority's declaration system with no paper form required; a written filing is allowed only with consent
column18: Online to the local competent authority together with the declaration form; a written filing is not permitted under any circumstances
column20: 第10條：營業量或進口量之申報，應以網路傳輸方式向中央主管機關網路申報系統申報，免檢具責任物之營業量或進口量申報表；但報經中央主管機關同意以書面申報者，不在此限。第9條第1項之申請改為一年一次申報，亦應以網路傳輸方式為之。
column21: Article 10 requires online declaration to the central authority's system, with written filing only by consent.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 責任業者製造或輸入之責任物不在國內廢棄者，得如何辦理？
column10: 得檢具申報表及委外處理契約等文件，經目的事業主管機關核准後免除其全部之繳費責任
column11: 得檢具申報表及銷售發票影本等文件，向所在地主管機關申請退還已繳納之回收清除處理費
column12: 得檢具申報表及不在國內廢棄之證明文件等，經中央主管機關認定後扣抵其營業量或進口量
column13: 得檢具申報表及出口報單影本等文件，逕行自行扣抵其營業量或進口量並免報中央主管機關
column14: What may an enterprise do where its responsibility goods are not discarded domestically?
column15: File the declaration form with an outsourced treatment contract and be relieved of all payment duties once the industry authority approves
column16: File the declaration form with copies of sales invoices and apply to the local authority for a refund of the fees already paid
column17: File the declaration form with documents proving non-domestic discard and deduct the volume once the central authority recognizes it
column18: File the declaration form with copies of export declarations and deduct the volume directly without reporting to the central authority
column20: 第11條第1項：責任業者製造或輸入之責任物不在國內廢棄或使用後不產生廢棄物者，得檢具營業量或進口量申報表、不在國內廢棄或使用後不產生廢棄物之證明文件、不在國內廢棄之扣抵量彙總表等，經中央主管機關認定後扣抵其營業量或進口量。第2項：第7條第1項之責任業者不適用之。
column21: Article 11, paragraph 1 allows deduction after recognition by the central competent authority.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 平板容器銷售予容器商品製造業者之量，其製造或輸入業者得如何辦理？
column10: 得檢具銷售量扣抵彙總表及銷售發票，申報扣抵其營業量或進口量
column11: 得檢具銷售契約書及進貨統一發票，申請免辦理該期之申報及繳費
column12: 得檢具銷售對象名冊及庫存盤點表，申請延期繳納該期之處理費用
column13: 得檢具銷售量扣抵彙總表及出口報單，申請退還已繳納之處理費用
column14: What may a flat container manufacturer or importer do for volumes sold to container-goods manufacturers?
column15: File a deduction summary of sales volume with sales invoices and deduct the amount from its business or import volume
column16: File the sales contract and purchase invoices and apply to be exempt from declaring and paying for that period
column17: File a list of buyers and an inventory count sheet and apply to defer payment of the fee for that period
column18: File a deduction summary of sales volume with export declarations and apply for a refund of the fees already paid
column20: 第13條第1項：平板容器或非平板類免洗餐具銷售予容器商品製造業者之量，平板容器製造或輸入業者、非平板類免洗餐具製造或輸入業者得檢具銷售量扣抵彙總表及銷售發票申報扣抵其營業量或進口量。第2項就生質塑膠原料及平板容器板材另有類似規定；第3項規定第7條第1項之責任業者不適用。
column21: Article 13, paragraph 1 allows deduction on filing a sales deduction summary and sales invoices.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 責任業者溢繳回收清除處理費者得如何辦理？其退費金額有何限制？
column10: 得向所在地主管機關申請退費，但退費總金額以當年度已繳納金額之半數為上限
column11: 得向中央主管機關申請退費，但退費總金額以責任業者已繳納之總金額為其上限
column12: 得向中央主管機關申請退費，但退費總金額以新臺幣十萬元為其上限不得超過
column13: 得向指定之金融機構申請退費，但退費總金額以前六期已繳納金額合計為上限
column14: How may an overpaid recycling fee be recovered, and what limit applies?
column15: Apply to the local competent authority for a refund, capped at half of the amount paid during the current year
column16: Apply to the central competent authority for a refund, capped at the total amount the enterprise has already paid
column17: Apply to the central competent authority for a refund, capped at NT$100,000 which may not be exceeded
column18: Apply to the designated financial institution for a refund, capped at the total paid over the previous six periods
column20: 第14條第1項：責任業者溢繳之回收清除處理費，得向中央主管機關申請退費，但退費總金額以責任業者已繳納之總金額為限。第2項：退費依第11條及第13條檢具文件或銷售發票所載日期對應之費率計算；可證明扣抵量原申報繳費日期者，以原申報繳費日期對應費率計算。
column21: Article 14, paragraph 1 permits refunds from the central authority, capped at the total already paid.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 責任業者提供之資料不實或未提供完整帳冊時，主管機關如何認定其營業量或進口量？
column10: 依銷售額相近同業平均營業量之三倍計算，作為該責任業者當期之營業量或進口量並據以計費
column11: 依上年度申報之營業量加計百分之二十，作為該責任業者當期之營業量或進口量認定之基準
column12: 依原（物）料、人員、水電或設備使用情形等六種方法，擇定其中可取得之最低營業量或進口量
column13: 依原（物）料、人員、水電或設備使用情形等六種方法，擇定其中可取得之最高營業量或進口量
column14: How does the authority determine volumes where an enterprise gives false data or incomplete books?
column15: Multiply by three the average volume of peers with similar turnover and use that as the current period's volume for the fee
column16: Add twenty percent to the volume declared for the previous year and use that as the basis for the current period's volume
column17: Adopt the lowest volume obtainable among six prescribed methods based on materials, staff, utilities, equipment use and similar data
column18: Adopt the highest volume obtainable among six prescribed methods based on materials, staff, utilities, equipment use and similar data
column20: 第15條第1項：主管機關或其委託之專業人員依本法第20條查核時，責任業者所提供資料不實或未提供完整帳冊者，得依原（物）料人員水電設備使用情形、上下游業者資料、銷售額相近同業申報量、同業費額占銷售額比例、相近同業製造量計算方式、稅捐機關提供資料等六種方法，擇定其中可取得之最高營業量或進口量。
column21: Article 15, paragraph 1 requires choosing the highest obtainable volume among the six listed methods.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 責任業者違反登記、變更登記、申報或繳費等規定者，依何規定處罰？
column10: 依廢棄物清理法第三十一條第五項規定處罰
column11: 依資源回收再利用法第二十六條規定處罰
column12: 依廢棄物清理法第五十一條第二項規定處罰
column13: 依廢棄物清理法第五十八條之規定予以處罰
column14: Under which provision is a responsibility enterprise punished for registration, declaration or payment violations?
column15: Punished under Article 31, paragraph 5 of the Waste Disposal Act
column16: Punished under Article 26 of the Resource Recycling and Reuse Act
column17: Punished under Article 51, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column18: Punished under Article 58 of the Waste Disposal Act as applicable
column20: 第17條第1項：違反第3條、第4條第2項、第4條之1第1項、第3項、第5條第3項、第6條、第9條第2項、第3項或第16條規定者，依本法第51條第2項規定處罰。第2項並規定營業量及進口量為零、已申請廢止登記或有第8條第1項情形者，應於指定期限內申報繳費，逾期仍依同條項處罰。
column21: Article 17 applies Article 51, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act.

column4: 應回收廢棄物責任業者管理辦法
column9: 本辦法及其一百十三年十二月十六日修正條文之施行日期為何？
column10: 本辦法自一百十年一月一日施行；修正發布之第七條及第八條自一百十五年一月一日施行
column11: 本辦法自發布日起施行；修正發布之第七條及第八條自發布後滿六個月之日起開始施行
column12: 本辦法自一百零九年一月一日施行；修正發布之全部條文自一百十四年七月一日起施行
column13: 本辦法自一百零九年七月一日施行；修正發布之第七條及第八條自一百十四年一月一日施行
column14: When did these Regulations and the amendments of 16 December 2024 take effect?
column15: The Regulations took effect on 1 January 2021; the amended Articles 7 and 8 took effect on 1 January 2026
column16: The Regulations took effect on promulgation; the amended Articles 7 and 8 took effect six months after promulgation
column17: The Regulations took effect on 1 January 2020; all amended provisions took effect on 1 July 2025 as a whole
column18: The Regulations took effect on 1 July 2020; the amended Articles 7 and 8 took effect on 1 January 2025
column20: 第18條第1項：本辦法自中華民國一百零九年七月一日施行。第2項：本辦法修正條文，除中華民國一百十三年十二月十六日修正發布之第7條及第8條自一百十四年一月一日施行外，自發布日施行。第7條、第8條即查定營業量之相關規定。
column21: Article 18 sets 1 July 2020 for the Regulations and 1 January 2025 for the amended Articles 7 and 8.

column4: 事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則
column9: 《事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則》之訂定法源依據為何？
column10: 依廢棄物清理法第三十一條第一項規定訂定之
column11: 依廢棄物清理法第二十八條第二項規定訂定之
column12: 依廢棄物清理法第三十九條第二項規定訂定之
column13: 依廢棄物清理法第三十條第二項規定訂定之
column14: Under which provision are these Criteria enacted?
column15: Enacted under Article 31, paragraph 1 of the Waste Disposal Act
column16: Enacted under Article 28, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column17: Enacted under Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column18: Enacted under Article 30, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column20: 第1條：本準則依廢棄物清理法（本法）第三十條第二項規定訂定之。本法第二十八條為事業廢棄物清理方式之規定，第三十一條為公告事業之清理計畫書及申報義務，第三十九條第二項則為再利用管理辦法之授權依據。
column21: Article 1 cites Article 30, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act.

column4: 事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則
column9: 第2條第8款所稱事業負責人及其授權之人應如何認定？授權方式為何？
column10: 負責人指實際出資之股東，授權之人指受託清理機構之現場主管人員，授權應報請主管機關核准後始生其效力
column11: 負責人指清理計畫書登載之負責人，授權之人指經授權管理指揮該工作場所之負責人，授權應以書面為之且不得再授權
column12: 負責人指廢棄物專業技術人員，授權之人指公（協）會指派之查訪人員，授權應每年重新辦理一次確認手續
column13: 負責人指公司登記之代表人，授權之人指公司內部指定之環境保護專責人員，授權得以口頭為之並得再行轉授權他人
column14: Who is the responsible person and the authorized person under Article 2, subparagraph 8, and how is authorization made?
column15: The shareholder who actually invested, and the site supervisor of the entrusted clearance institution; authorization takes effect only on authority approval
column16: The person named in the waste clearance plan, and a workplace head authorized to manage or direct the enterprise; authorization must be written and may not be sub-delegated
column17: The waste professional technician, and a visiting officer assigned by an association; authorization must be renewed and confirmed once every year
column18: The company's registered representative, and an internally designated environmental protection officer; authorization may be oral and may be further delegated to others
column20: 第4條第2項：第2條第8款所稱事業負責人，指事業廢棄物清理計畫書登載之負責人；所稱其授權之人，指經事業負責人授權而管理、指揮或監督該事業之工作場所負責人；事業負責人授權他人之方式，應以書面為之，且被授權之人不得再為授權。第1項並規定得委託公（協）會、學會、技師等協助辦理部分管理措施。
column21: Article 4, paragraph 2 defines both roles and requires written, non-sub-delegable authorization.

column4: 事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則
column7: 相當注意義務-聯合查訪
column9: 公（協）會之會員事業就受委託之處理或再利用機構，得如何辦理查訪？
column10: 得委請公（協）會辦理聯合查訪，其查訪結果得供會員事業參考
column11: 得委請公（協）會辦理聯合查訪，其查訪結果即取代個別查訪義務
column12: 得委請主管機關代為聯合查訪，其查訪結果並為認定之唯一依據
column13: 應由各會員事業分別自行查訪，不得委由公（協）會代為聯合查訪
column14: How may member enterprises of an association arrange visits to entrusted disposal or reuse institutions?
column15: They may ask the association to conduct joint visits, whose results may serve as reference for member enterprises
column16: They may ask the association to conduct joint visits, whose results then replace their individual visit duty
column17: They may ask the competent authority to conduct joint visits, whose results are the sole basis for determination
column18: Each member enterprise must visit on its own and may not have the association conduct joint visits
column20: 第5條：公（協）會之會員事業得委請公（協）會聯合查訪受委託之處理或再利用機構，其查訪結果得供會員事業參考。第4條第1項並規定事業得委託公（協）會、學會、專業技師、專任工程人員或財團法人協助辦理第2條第一款至第三款及第六款之管理措施。
column21: Article 5 allows association-led joint visits whose results serve as reference for members.

column4: 事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則
column7: 相當注意義務-認定程序
column9: 直轄市、縣（市）主管機關為辦理相當注意義務之認定，得採取何種措施？
column10: 得召開聽證程序，並應邀請檢察機關及司法機關代表全程參與該程序
column11: 得委由中央主管機關代為認定，並由中央主管機關逕行作成相關處分
column12: 得召開研商會議，並得邀請相關機關（構）及公（協）會代表列席與會
column13: 得逕行認定而免通知事業，並於認定完成後始通知事業陳述其意見
column14: What may a local competent authority do in determining whether due care was exercised?
column15: It may hold a formal hearing and must invite prosecutorial and judicial representatives to take part throughout
column16: It may delegate the determination to the central competent authority, which then issues the disposition directly
column17: It may convene a consultation meeting and invite representatives of relevant agencies and associations to attend
column18: It may determine the matter without notifying the enterprise and invite its statement only after the determination
column20: 第7條：直轄市、縣（市）主管機關為辦理相當注意義務之認定，得召開研商會議，並得邀請相關機關（構）及公（協）會代表列席。第6條第1項並規定主管機關辦理認定事宜，得要求事業或相關機關（構）提供有關資料。
column21: Article 7 allows convening a consultation meeting with relevant agencies and associations attending.

column4: 事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則
column9: 主管機關調查未妥善清理廢棄物之分布範圍及數量時，得如何辦理？
column10: 得通知事業限期提出書面說明及相關證明文件；認定顯有困難時得以估算認定之
column11: 得命事業立即停工並限期清理完成；認定顯有困難時得免予調查並逕行結案
column12: 得逕行查封事業之廠房及設備；認定顯有困難時應報請中央主管機關代為認定
column13: 得要求事業先行繳納一定金額之清理保證金；認定顯有困難時應委託技師鑑定
column14: How may the authority investigate the extent and quantity of improperly cleared waste?
column15: Notify the enterprise to submit a written explanation and supporting documents within a set period; estimate where determination is clearly difficult
column16: Order the enterprise to stop work and complete clearance by a deadline; close the case without investigation where difficult
column17: Seal up the enterprise's plant and equipment directly; refer the matter to the central competent authority where determination is clearly difficult
column18: Require the enterprise to first pay a clearance guarantee deposit; commission a licensed engineer where determination is difficult
column20: 第8條第1項：直轄市、縣（市）主管機關為調查未妥善清理廢棄物之分布範圍、數量，得通知事業限期提出書面說明及相關證明文件。第2項：事業未依前項規定提出說明或文件，或未妥善清理廢棄物之分布範圍及數量認定顯有困難時，主管機關得以估算認定之。
column21: Article 8 allows a written explanation to be demanded and estimation where determination is clearly difficult.

column4: 事業委託清理之相當注意義務認定準則
column9: 本準則及其修正條文之施行日期為何？
column10: 本準則自發布後三個月施行；其修正條文自發布後一年施行
column11: 本準則自發布日施行；本準則修正條文自發布後六個月施行
column12: 本準則自發布後六個月施行；其修正條文自發布日起即施行
column13: 本準則自發布日施行；本準則修正條文亦自發布日起即施行
column14: When do these Criteria and their amendments take effect?
column15: The Criteria take effect three months after promulgation; the amendments take effect one year after that
column16: The Criteria take effect on promulgation; the amended provisions take effect six months after promulgation
column17: The Criteria take effect six months after promulgation; the amended provisions take effect on promulgation
column18: The Criteria take effect on promulgation; the amended provisions likewise take effect upon promulgation
column20: 第9條：本準則自發布日施行；本準則修正條文，自發布後六個月施行。本準則最近一次修正日期為民國一百十年二月二十三日，其修正條文即自發布後六個月始行施行，使事業有調整期間。
column21: Article 9 sets promulgation for the Criteria and six months after promulgation for the amendments.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-總則
column9: 《環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法》之訂定法源依據為何？
column10: 依資源回收再利用法第三十九條第二項規定訂定
column11: 依廢棄物清理法第二十八條第二項規定訂定之
column12: 依廢棄物清理法第三十九條第二項規定訂定之
column13: 依廢棄物清理法第三十條第二項之規定訂定之
column14: Under which provision are these Regulations enacted?
column15: Enacted under Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Resource Recycling Act
column16: Enacted under Article 28, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column17: Enacted under Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column18: Enacted under Article 30, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column20: 第1條：本辦法依廢棄物清理法（本法）第三十九條第二項規定訂定之。共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法第1條亦以同一條項為授權依據；本法第三十條第二項則為相當注意義務認定準則之授權依據。
column21: Article 1 cites Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-定義
column9: 本辦法所稱「再利用機構」之定義為何？
column10: 指經目的事業主管機關指定並公告，得收受一般廢棄物進行資源回收之回收處理業者
column11: 指依公司法設立登記且實收資本額達一定金額以上，經營廢棄物買賣之貿易商或工廠
column12: 指取得中央主管機關核發廢棄物處理許可證，收受事業廢棄物進行中間處理之處理機構
column13: 指經政府機關登記有案或依法律規定免辦理登記，收受事業廢棄物再利用之農工商廠（場）
column14: How is a reuse institution defined under these Regulations?
column15: A recycling enterprise designated and announced by the industry competent authority that may receive general waste for resource recovery
column16: A trading company or factory incorporated under the Company Act with paid-in capital above a set amount that trades in waste materials
column17: A disposal institution holding a waste disposal permit issued by the central authority that receives industrial waste for intermediate treatment
column18: An agricultural, industrial or commercial plant registered with a government agency or exempt from registration that receives industrial waste for reuse
column20: 第2條第3款：再利用機構指經政府機關登記有案或依法律規定免辦理登記，收受事業廢棄物再利用之農工商廠（場）。同條第1款定義事業指以環境部為中央目的事業主管機關之事業；第2款定義再利用指作為原料、材料、燃料、填土或其他經本部認定之用途行為。
column21: Article 2, subparagraph 3 defines it as a registered or registration-exempt plant receiving industrial waste for reuse.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-個案許可
column9: 個案再利用許可應由何者提出申請？提出試驗計畫者應於何時送本部審查？
column10: 由事業及再利用機構共同檢具文件向本部申請；應於試驗計畫期間屆滿之次日起三十日內送審
column11: 由再利用用途目的事業主管機關代為申請；應於試驗計畫期間屆滿後六個月內補行送本部審查
column12: 由事業單獨檢具文件向地方主管機關申請；應於試驗計畫期間屆滿之當日前十五日內送請審查
column13: 由再利用機構單獨檢具文件向本部申請；應於試驗計畫期間屆滿之次日起九十日內送本部審查
column14: Who applies for a case-by-case reuse permit, and when must a trial-plan applicant submit for review?
column15: The enterprise and the reuse institution apply jointly to the MOENV; submission is within thirty days after the trial period ends
column16: The industry competent authority for the reuse purpose applies; submission follows within six months after the trial ends
column17: The enterprise applies alone to the local competent authority; submission is fifteen days before the trial period ends
column18: The reuse institution applies alone to the MOENV; submission is within ninety days after the trial period ends the next day
column20: 第4條第1項：個案再利用許可之申請，由事業及再利用機構共同檢具再利用許可申請文件，向本部為之。第5項：無國內外再利用可行性實廠實績而提出試驗計畫者，應於接獲本部試驗通知後進行試驗計畫，並於試驗計畫期間屆滿之次日起三十日內，檢具含試驗結果之申請書送本部審查；屆期未送審或審查不同意者，試驗期間之產出物應依本法第28條或第39條辦理。
column21: Article 4 requires a joint application and submission within thirty days after the trial period ends.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-通案許可
column9: 通案再利用許可應由何者申請？其再利用計畫應包含多久期間之月統計資料？
column10: 由再利用機構檢具文件向地方主管機關申請；再利用計畫應包含六個月以上之收受量與再利用量月統計資料
column11: 由再利用用途目的事業主管機關申請；再利用計畫應包含二十四個月以上之收受量及暫存量月統計資料
column12: 由事業及再利用機構共同向本部申請；再利用計畫應包含三個月以上之收受量、再利用量及暫存量月統計資料
column13: 由再利用機構檢具文件向本部申請；再利用計畫應包含十二個月以上之收受量、再利用量及暫存量月統計資料
column14: Who applies for a general reuse permit, and how many months of statistics must the reuse plan contain?
column15: The reuse institution applies to the local competent authority; the plan contains at least six months of receipt and reuse statistics
column16: The industry competent authority for the reuse purpose applies; the plan contains at least twenty-four months of receipt statistics
column17: The enterprise and institution apply jointly to the MOENV; the plan contains at least three months of receipt, reuse and storage statistics
column18: The reuse institution applies to the MOENV; the plan contains at least twelve months of receipt, reuse and temporary storage statistics
column20: 第5條第1項：通案再利用許可之申請，由再利用機構檢具再利用許可申請文件，向本部為之。第3項第3款：再利用計畫應包含十二個月以上之事業廢棄物收受量、再利用量及暫存量月統計資料。同項第8款並要求檢具地方主管機關開具申請前一年內未曾違反環保法令受處分之證明文件。
column21: Article 5 requires a reuse institution's own application with at least twelve months of monthly statistics.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-許可文件
column9: 個案再利用許可文件應記載之事項為何？
column10: 事業之清理計畫書編號與專責人員姓名、廢棄物之貯存容量與清運路線、再利用產品之售價與其主要銷售對象
column11: 事業與再利用機構之名稱地址負責人、廢棄物來源產業種類名稱與許可數量用途及產品名稱、核發日期及許可期限
column12: 再利用機構之土地權狀與建築執照字號、廢棄物運輸車輛車號與駕駛姓名、主管機關歷次查核所作成之結果紀錄
column13: 事業與再利用機構之股東名冊與資本額、廢棄物之含水率熱值與成分分析結果、再利用設施之型號規格與產能
column14: What must a case-by-case reuse permit document record?
column15: The clearance plan number and technician's name, the waste storage capacity and clearance routes, plus the sale price and main buyers of the reuse product
column16: Names, addresses and responsible persons of both parties, the waste source industry, type, name, permitted quantity, use and product name, plus issue date and term
column17: The institution's land title and building permit numbers, the transport vehicle numbers and drivers' names, plus records of every past inspection by the authority
column18: Shareholder lists and capital of both parties, the waste moisture content, calorific value and composition analysis, plus the model and capacity of the reuse facilities
column20: 第7條第1項：個案再利用之許可文件應記載事業名稱地址負責人、再利用機構名稱地址負責人、再利用事業廢棄物來源產業與種類（代碼）名稱與許可再利用數量用途及再利用產品名稱、核發日期及許可期限，及其他經本部規定事項。第2項通案再利用許可文件則不含事業之相關資料。
column21: Article 7, paragraph 1 lists both parties' details, the waste and product particulars, and the issue date and term.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-駁回
column9: 個案及通案再利用許可之申請或展延，於何種情形本部應予駁回？
column10: 申請文件之外文部分未檢附中文譯本，或申請時未同時繳納規定之許可審查相關規費
column11: 申請機構之實收資本額未達新臺幣五百萬元，或其負責人未具備相關之專業技術資格
column12: 申請文件經通知限期補正而屆期未補正，或申請文件補正之總日數超過九十個工作日者
column13: 申請文件經通知限期補正而屆期未補正，或申請文件補正之總日數超過三十個工作日者
column14: In which situation must the MOENV reject a reuse permit application or extension?
column15: Foreign-language parts of the application lack a Chinese translation, or the prescribed review fees are not paid at the same time
column16: The applicant institution's paid-in capital is below NT$5 million, or its responsible person lacks the relevant technical qualification
column17: Supplementary documents are not filed by the set deadline, or the total supplementation period exceeds ninety working days
column18: Supplementary documents are not filed by the set deadline, or the total supplementation period exceeds thirty working days
column20: 第9條第2項：個案及通案再利用許可之申請或展延，有申請文件經通知限期補正屆期未補正、補正總日數超過九十個工作日、申請期間曾因違反環保法令受限期改善屆期未改善或按日處罰等情形、經實質審查不具再利用可行性等情形之一者，本部應予駁回。第1項並得要求改以申請個案再利用許可。
column21: Article 9, paragraph 2 requires rejection for failure to supplement in time or supplementation exceeding ninety working days.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-副知
column9: 本部核發再利用許可文件時，應副知何機關？
column10: 應副知中央目的事業主管機關及全國各直轄市、縣（市）主管機關，並於公報公告其許可之內容
column11: 應副知事業及再利用機構所在地之直轄市或縣（市）主管機關，及再利用用途目的事業主管機關
column12: 應副知再利用產品之銷售對象及其所在地主管機關，並函知該項產品之國家標準主管機關備查
column13: 應副知事業所屬之公（協）會及環境檢驗測定機構，並副知該廢棄物之原產生源事業與買受人
column14: Which agencies must be copied when the MOENV issues a reuse permit?
column15: The central industry competent authority and every municipal and county (city) authority nationwide, with the permit announced in the gazette
column16: The municipal or county (city) authorities where the enterprise and the institution are located, and the industry authority for the reuse purpose
column17: The buyers of the reuse product and the authorities of their locations, with notice to the authority for the product's national standard
column18: The association to which the enterprise belongs and the environmental testing agency, plus the original generating enterprise and buyer
column20: 第10條：本部核發再利用許可文件，應副知事業及再利用機構所在地之直轄市或縣（市）主管機關，及再利用用途目的事業主管機關。第13條第3項通案再利用契約書報備查時，亦應副知事業及再利用機構所在地之地方主管機關。
column21: Article 10 requires copying the local authorities of both parties and the industry authority for the reuse purpose.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-清除
column9: 事業廢棄物送往再利用機構再利用前之清除，得以何種方式為之？
column10: 自行清除、委託共同清除處理機構清除，或委託取得再利用許可之其他再利用機構代為運送至廠內
column11: 自行清除、委託領有廢棄物清除許可證之公民營清除機構清除，或依附表規定委託合法運輸業代為清除
column12: 自行清除、委託未領有許可證但已辦理公司登記之運輸業清除，或委託再利用產品之買受人代為清除
column13: 委託執行機關之垃圾車清除、委託取得處理許可證之處理機構清除，或委託目的事業主管機關清除
column14: In what ways may industrial waste be cleared before being sent to a reuse institution?
column15: Self-clearance, entrusting a joint clearance and disposal institution, or entrusting another permitted reuse institution to transport it in
column16: Self-clearance, entrusting a permitted public or private clearance institution, or entrusting a lawful transport operator as the attached table allows
column17: Self-clearance, entrusting an unlicensed but company-registered transport operator, or entrusting the buyer of the reuse product to clear it
column18: Entrusting the executing agency's garbage truck, entrusting a permitted disposal institution, or entrusting the industry competent authority
column20: 第12條第1項：事業廢棄物送往再利用機構再利用前之清除，由事業或再利用機構以自行清除、委託領有廢棄物清除許可證之公民營廢棄物清除機構清除（受託機構並應依公民營廢棄物清除處理機構許可管理辦法第18條第4項辦理）、依附表再利用管理方式規定委託合法運輸業代為清除等方式為之。第2項並要求清運機具依本法第31條第1項第3款裝置即時追蹤系統。
column21: Article 12, paragraph 1 allows self-clearance, a permitted clearance institution, or a lawful transport operator under the attached table.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-產品管理
column9: 再利用機構生產再利用產品及清理衍生廢棄物，應依何種規定辦理？
column10: 產品規格品質用途應經環境檢驗測定機構逐批檢驗並取得合格報告，限制用途者應報地方主管機關核准後售
column11: 產品規格品質用途應由買受人自行確認並負相關責任，限制用途者由主管機關另行公告其應標示之方式內容
column12: 產品規格品質用途僅需符合機構自訂之內部規範並報本部備查，限制用途者得免於產品包裝標示相關之警語
column13: 產品規格品質用途應符合國家標準、國際標準或相關使用規定並於清理計畫書載明，限制用途者並應標示警語
column14: What rules apply to a reuse institution's products and to the residual waste it generates?
column15: Product specification, quality and use must be tested batch by batch by an environmental testing agency, and restricted-use products need local authority approval before sale
column16: Product specification, quality and use are for the buyer to confirm at its own responsibility, and the authority separately announces how restricted uses are to be labelled
column17: Product specification, quality and use need only meet the institution's own internal rules filed with the MOENV, and restricted-use products need no warning label on the packaging
column18: Product specification, quality and use must meet national or international standards or relevant use rules and be stated in the clearance plan, with warning labels on restricted-use products
column20: 第15條第3項第1款：再利用產品之規格、品質及用途應符合國家標準、國際標準或該產品相關之使用規定，並於廢棄物清理計畫書資料中載明。第2款：附表或許可文件內容規定限制用途之再利用產品，應於產品包裝或盛裝容器明顯處標示使用限制及注意事項警語。第3款：衍生廢棄物應依本法相關規定清理。第1項並要求作成銷售流向、數量與庫存量之營運紀錄。
column21: Article 15, paragraph 3 requires standard-compliant specifications stated in the clearance plan and warning labels for restricted uses.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-保存
column9: 依第13條至第15條作成之契約書或紀錄，應如何保存？
column10: 應妥善保存十年留供查核；必要時主管機關得要求提報紀錄及相關憑證
column11: 應妥善保存三年留供查核；必要時主管機關得要求提報紀錄及相關憑證
column12: 應妥善保存一年留供查核；必要時主管機關得要求提報紀錄及相關憑證
column13: 應妥善保存五年留供查核；必要時主管機關得要求提報紀錄及相關憑證
column14: How must the contracts and records made under Articles 13 to 15 be kept?
column15: Kept properly for ten years for inspection; the authority may require the records and vouchers to be submitted when necessary
column16: Kept properly for three years for inspection; the authority may require the records and vouchers to be submitted when necessary
column17: Kept properly for one year for inspection; the authority may require the records and vouchers to be submitted when necessary
column18: Kept properly for five years for inspection; the authority may require the records and vouchers to be submitted when necessary
column20: 第16條：依第13條（契約書）、第14條（送往及再利用紀錄）、第15條（產品營運紀錄）作成之契約書或紀錄應妥善保存三年，留供查核；必要時，主管機關得要求提報紀錄及相關憑證。第22條第2項第5款並規定違反第14條至第17條經限期改善屆期未改善者，本部得廢止其許可。
column21: Article 16 requires three-year retention of contracts and records for inspection.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 事業廢棄物再利用-產品品質
column9: 作為鋪面級配粒料、瀝青混凝土等用途之再利用產品，應符合何種規定？
column10: 應符合買賣契約約定之品質規格要求，且由買受人自行檢測一次；未符品質標準者由買受人自行處理
column11: 應符合附件一使用地點及品質標準，且每年至少檢測一次；未符品質標準者應依規定進行處理或再利用
column12: 應符合國家標準所定之抗壓強度規定，且每半年至少檢測一次；未符品質標準者應報地方主管機關核准
column13: 應符合附件一使用地點及品質標準，且每三年至少檢測一次；未符品質標準者得逕行降級改作其他用途
column14: What rules apply to reuse products used as paving aggregate, asphalt concrete and similar uses?
column15: They must meet the quality specifications agreed in the sales contract and be tested once by the buyer; non-conforming batches are handled by the buyer itself
column16: They must meet the use locations and quality standards in Attachment 1 and be tested at least yearly; non-conforming batches are disposed of or reused as prescribed
column17: They must meet the compressive strength required by national standards and be tested at least twice a year; non-conforming batches need local authority approval
column18: They must meet the use locations and quality standards in Attachment 1 and be tested at least every three years; non-conforming batches may be downgraded to other uses
column20: 第18條第1項：作為鋪面工程基層或底層級配粒料、工程填地材料、道路工程粒料、瀝青混凝土、預拌混凝土、控制性低強度回填材料、磚品、水泥製品等用途或加工再製品原料之再利用產品，應符合附件一使用地點及品質標準。第2項：每年至少檢測一次，未符標準者該批產出物應依本法第28條或本辦法規定處理或再利用。第3項、第4項並就加工再製品原料規定銷售對象及即時追蹤系統。
column21: Article 18 requires compliance with Attachment 1 and at least annual testing, with non-conforming output handled under Article 28 of the Act.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法

column9: 再利用機構應依何種規定設置閉路電視錄影監視系統？
column10: 應依中央主管機關另行公告之統一規格，一律設置閉路電視錄影監視系統
column11: 應依所在地地方主管機關逐案指定之位置，設置閉路電視錄影監視系統
column12: 應依第三條附表管理方式規定或許可文件內容，設置閉路電視錄影監視系統
column13: 應依事業與再利用機構契約書之約定內容，設置閉路電視錄影監視系統
column14: Under what rule must a reuse institution install a closed-circuit video surveillance system?
column15: As required by a uniform specification separately announced by the central competent authority for all cases
column16: As required by the location designated case by case by the local competent authority of its location
column17: As required by the management method in the Article 3 attached table or by the content of the permit document
column18: As required by the content agreed in the contract between the enterprise and the reuse institution
column20: 第20條：再利用機構應依第3條附表管理方式規定或許可文件內容設置閉路電視錄影監視系統。第19條第2項第4款並規定規避、妨礙、拒絕配合再利用運作之查核者，主管機關得令其停止再利用運作並限期改善。
column21: Article 20 ties the requirement to the Article 3 attached table or the permit document.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法

column9: 取得再利用許可之機構終止再利用業務或暫停營業時，應如何辦理？
column10: 終止業務者應向地方主管機關報請備查；暫停營業在三個月以上者應於滿三個月後三十日內報備查
column11: 終止業務者應由本部逕行廢止其許可；暫停營業在一年以上者應於期滿後六十日內報本部備查
column12: 終止業務者應向本部申請廢止其許可；暫停營業在一個月以上者應於滿一個月後十五日內報本部備查
column13: 終止業務者得逕行停止營運免辦理手續；暫停營業在六個月以上者應於復業前報本部核准後為之
column14: What must a permitted reuse institution do when it terminates business or suspends operations?
column15: On termination it reports to the local competent authority for recordation; a suspension of three months or more is filed within thirty days after that period
column16: On termination the MOENV revokes the permit on its own motion; a suspension of one year or more is filed with the MOENV within sixty days after it
column17: On termination it applies to the MOENV to revoke the permit; a suspension of one month or more is filed with the MOENV within fifteen days after that month
column18: On termination it may simply stop operating with no formality; a suspension of six months or more needs MOENV approval before operations resume
column20: 第21條：取得再利用許可之再利用機構終止廢棄物再利用業務者，應向本部申請廢止其許可；其暫停營業在一個月以上者，應於滿一個月後十五日內，檢具相關資料報本部備查。第22條第2項第1款並規定再利用機構喪失從事業務能力或一年內無從事再利用業務者，本部得廢止其許可。
column21: Article 21 requires an application to revoke on termination, and recordation within fifteen days after a one-month suspension.

column4: 環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法

column9: 再利用許可申請文件如為英文以外之其他外文者，應如何辦理？
column10: 應由申請人切結譯文內容無誤即可
column11: 應檢附經駐外單位驗證之原文正本
column12: 應檢附中文譯本，一併送本部審查
column13: 應檢附英文譯本，一併送本部審查
column14: What applies where reuse permit application documents are in a foreign language other than English?
column15: The applicant may simply certify that the translation is accurate
column16: An original authenticated by an overseas mission must be attached
column17: A Chinese translation must be attached and submitted to the MOENV
column18: An English translation must be attached and submitted to the MOENV
column20: 第23條：第4條第2項及第5條第2項再利用許可申請文件，如為英文以外其他外文者，應檢附中文譯本。可對照環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法第28條，該辦法規定外文文件應檢附駐外單位驗證之中譯本，但證明文件為英文者免附。
column21: Article 23 requires a Chinese translation for foreign-language documents other than English.

column12: 本辦法自發布後一年起施行

column17: These Regulations take effect one year after their promulgation

column21: Article 24 provides that the Regulations take effect on the date of promulgation.

column4: 共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法

column11: 依廢棄物清理法第三十一條第一項規定訂定之
column12: 依資源回收再利用法第三十九條第二項規定訂定
column13: 依廢棄物清理法第三十九條第二項規定訂定之
column14: Under which provision are these Regulations enacted?
column15: Enacted under Article 28, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column16: Enacted under Article 31, paragraph 1 of the Waste Disposal Act
column17: Enacted under Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Resource Recycling Act
column18: Enacted under Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column20: 第1條：本辦法依廢棄物清理法（本法）第三十九條第二項規定訂定之。環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法第1條亦以同一條項為授權依據，二者分別規範共通性廢棄物與以環境部為中央目的事業主管機關之事業廢棄物。
column21: Article 1 cites Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act.

column4: 共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法

column9: 共通性事業廢棄物之再利用應依何規定辦理？非屬附表規定之再利用行為應如何處理？
column10: 應依中央主管機關逐案核發之許可辦理；非屬附表規定之再利用行為，一律不得進行且應改依處理方式清理
column11: 應依事業廢棄物清理計畫書之記載辦理；非屬附表規定之再利用行為，得由事業自行認定其管理方式進行
column12: 應依附表規定進行再利用；非屬附表規定之再利用行為，應依各中央目的事業主管機關所定再利用管理辦法辦理
column13: 應依國家標準所定之品質規範辦理；非屬附表規定之再利用行為，應報請所在地主管機關核准後始得為之
column14: Under what rules is common industrial waste reused, and what applies to reuse outside the attached table?
column15: Reuse follows a case-by-case permit from the central authority; reuse outside the table is prohibited and the waste must be disposed of instead
column16: Reuse follows the content of the industrial waste clearance plan; for reuse outside the table the enterprise may set its own management method
column17: Reuse follows the attached table; reuse outside it follows the reuse regulations made by the relevant central industry competent authority
column18: Reuse follows the quality specifications of national standards; reuse outside the table requires prior approval of the local competent authority
column20: 第4條第1項：事業及再利用機構應依附表規定進行共通性事業廢棄物再利用；非屬附表規定之再利用行為，應依各中央目的事業主管機關所定之事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法規定辦理。第2項：附表所列再利用用途有污染環境之虞者，中央主管機關得暫停其再利用，原因消失時應即解除。
column21: Article 4, paragraph 1 requires following the attached table, with other reuse governed by the relevant industry authority's regulations.

column4: 共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 共通性再利用-產品管理
column9: 再利用機構生產再利用產品及清理衍生廢棄物，應依何種規定辦理？
column10: 產品規格品質用途應符合國家標準、國際標準或相關使用規定並於清理計畫書載明，限制用途者應標示警語
column11: 產品規格品質用途僅需符合機構自訂內部規範並報地方主管機關備查，限制用途者得免標示相關之警語
column12: 產品規格品質用途應由買受人自行確認並自負相關責任，限制用途者由主管機關另行公告其標示之方式
column13: 產品規格品質用途應逐批送環境檢驗測定機構檢驗並取得合格報告，限制用途者應報中央主管機關核准
column14: What rules apply to a reuse institution's products and the residual waste from reuse?
column15: Specification, quality and use must meet national or international standards or relevant use rules and be stated in the clearance plan, with warning labels for restricted uses
column16: Specification, quality and use need only meet the institution's internal rules filed with the local authority, and restricted-use products need no warning label at all
column17: Specification, quality and use are for the buyer to confirm at its own risk, and the competent authority separately announces how restricted uses are to be labelled
column18: Specification, quality and use must be tested batch by batch by an environmental testing agency, and restricted-use products need central authority approval first
column20: 第6條第1款：再利用產品之規格、品質及用途應符合國家標準、國際標準或該產品相關之使用規定，並於事業廢棄物清理計畫書中載明。第2款：附表規定限制用途之再利用產品，應於產品包裝或盛裝容器明顯處標示使用限制及其他注意事項之警語。第3款：再利用後之衍生廢棄物應依本法相關規定清理。
column21: Article 6 requires standard-compliant specifications stated in the clearance plan and warning labels for restricted uses.

column4: 共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column9: 共通性事業廢棄物送至再利用機構前之清除，得以何種方式為之？
column10: 自行清除、委託領有廢棄物清除許可證之公民營清除機構清除，或依附表規定委託合法運輸業代為清除
column11: 自行清除、委託共同清除處理機構清除，或委託其他已取得再利用資格之機構代為運送至其廠內
column12: 委託執行機關之垃圾車清除、委託取得處理許可證之處理機構清除，或委託目的事業主管機關清除
column13: 自行清除、委託未領有許可證但已辦妥公司登記之運輸業清除，或委託再利用產品之買受人代為清除
column14: In what ways may common industrial waste be cleared before delivery to a reuse institution?
column15: Self-clearance, entrusting a permitted public or private clearance institution, or entrusting a lawful transport operator as the attached table allows
column16: Self-clearance, entrusting a joint clearance and disposal institution, or entrusting another qualified institution to transport it to its plant
column17: Entrusting the executing agency's garbage truck, entrusting a permitted disposal institution, or entrusting the industry competent authority
column18: Self-clearance, entrusting an unlicensed but company-registered transport operator, or entrusting the buyer of the reuse product to clear it
column20: 第7條：共通性事業廢棄物送至再利用機構前之清除，由事業或再利用機構以自行清除、委託領有廢棄物清除許可證之公民營廢棄物清除機構清除、依附表再利用管理方式規定委託合法運輸業代為清除等方式為之。此三種方式與環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法第12條之規定相同。
column21: Article 7 allows self-clearance, a permitted clearance institution, or a lawful transport operator under the attached table.

column4: 共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column9: 事業委託清除或再利用共通性事業廢棄物前，其契約書應檢附及記載何項內容？
column10: 應檢附主管機關核發之個案再利用許可文件，並記載事業之資本額、員工人數、製程說明及年度生產之計畫
column11: 應檢附清理計畫書中之再利用檢核資料及清除許可證影本，並記載種類成分數量、工具方法設備、用途及有效期間
column12: 應檢附再利用機構之土地權狀及建築執照影本，並記載清運車輛車號、駕駛姓名、清運路線及每趟之計價方式
column13: 應檢附再利用產品之國家標準檢驗合格報告，並記載產品售價、付款條件、違約金額及爭議解決之管轄法院
column14: What must be attached to and stated in the contract before entrusting clearance or reuse of common industrial waste?
column15: The case-by-case reuse permit issued by the authority, stating the enterprise's capital, headcount, process description and its annual production plan
column16: The reuse checklist from the clearance plan and a copy of the clearance permit, stating type, composition, quantity, tools, methods, use and validity period
column17: Copies of the institution's land title and building permit, stating vehicle numbers, drivers' names, clearance routes and the price charged for each trip
column18: A national standard inspection report for the reuse product, stating the sale price, payment terms, penalty amounts and the court for dispute resolution
column20: 第8條第2項：契約書應檢附事業廢棄物清理計畫書中之再利用檢核資料、廢棄物清除許可證或汽車運輸業營業執照影本，並記載共通性事業廢棄物之種類成分及清除或再利用數量、清除或再利用之工具方法及設備、再利用用途、契約書有效期間，以及清除或再利用機構無法繼續運作時尚未完竣廢棄物之處置方式。
column21: Article 8, paragraph 2 lists the reuse checklist and permit copy plus five required contract particulars.

column4: 共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column9: 再利用機構於何種情形得免依規定連線申報再利用產品營運紀錄？
column10: 該再利用機構當月未收受任何廢棄物，或其產品僅銷售予同一法人之分廠場
column11: 該再利用用途未產出產品，或依商品檢驗法第三條公告規定應辦理檢驗之產品
column12: 該再利用機構已依規定作成書面紀錄，或其產品已取得環境保護標章使用證
column13: 該再利用產品當月無任何銷售，或該再利用產品之庫存量低於前月之產出量
column14: In which situation is a reuse institution exempt from online declaration of product operating records?
column15: The institution received no waste during the current month, or its products are sold only to branch plants of the same juristic person
column16: The reuse purpose produces no product, or the product is one subject to inspection announced under Article 3 of the Commodity Inspection Act
column17: The institution has already made written records as required, or its product has obtained an environmental protection label licence
column18: The product had no sales in the current month, or the product inventory is lower than the output of the preceding month at the plant
column20: 第10條第5項：僅再利用本法第31條第1項第2款規定免連線申報之廢棄物種類所產製再利用產品、該再利用用途未產出產品、共通性事業廢棄物返回原生產製程作為原料所產製之再利用產品且該製程無再利用其他事業廢棄物、依商品檢驗法第3條公告應辦理檢驗之產品、其他經中央主管機關同意者，得免連線申報。第4項並規定無銷售或無庫存時仍應申報。
column21: Article 10, paragraph 5 exempts cases such as reuse producing no product and products subject to Commodity Inspection Act inspection.

column4: 共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column9: 再利用機構終止再利用業務或經解除列管者，於何種條件下得免申報產品營運紀錄？
column10: 廠（場）內尚有廢棄物待處理但已辦妥歇業登記，並向所在地鄉鎮市公所報備查者
column11: 廠（場）內已無再利用事業廢棄物及再利用產品庫存，並檢具證明文件經地方主管機關同意者
column12: 廠（場）內尚有再利用產品庫存但已停止收受廢棄物，並報請中央主管機關核准備查者
column13: 廠（場）內已無再利用事業廢棄物但仍有產品庫存，並向目的事業主管機關報備查者
column14: On what condition is a terminating or delisted reuse institution exempt from declaring product operating records?
column15: Waste still awaits treatment but a business closure registration is completed, and the matter is filed with the township or city office
column16: No reuse industrial waste and no product inventory remain at the plant, and supporting documents are approved by the local competent authority
column17: Product inventory still remains at the plant but waste receipt has ceased, and the matter is filed with the central authority for recordation
column18: No reuse industrial waste remains but product inventory is still held, and the matter is filed with the industry competent authority
column20: 第12條：再利用機構終止再利用業務或經直轄市、縣（市）主管機關解除列管，且廠（場）內已無再利用事業廢棄物及再利用產品庫存者，得檢具相關證明文件，經直轄市、縣（市）主管機關同意後，免依第10條第3項及第4項規定申報再利用產品營運紀錄。
column21: Article 12 requires no remaining waste or product inventory plus local authority consent.

column4: 共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法
column7: 共通性再利用-適用關係
column9: 本辦法施行後，各中央目的事業主管機關所定辦法中關於附表共通性事業廢棄物之規定，其效力為何？

column12: 自本辦法施行日起，各中央目的事業主管機關所定辦法之全部規定一律廢止並不再適用
column13: 自本辦法施行日起由中央主管機關逐案認定，其認定結果並應報請行政院核定後生效
column14: What is the effect of industry authorities' rules on wastes listed in the attached table once these Regulations take effect?
column15: They continue to apply for one year from the effective date, and only then are replaced by the attached table of these Regulations
column16: From the effective date, their provisions on the reuse types and management methods for the listed common wastes cease to apply
