column18: From the effective date the central authority decides case by case, and its decisions take effect after Executive Yuan approval
column20: 第16條：自本辦法施行日起，各中央目的事業主管機關所定事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法或管理方式，有關附表共通性事業廢棄物再利用種類及管理方式之規定，不再適用。第4條第1項並規定非屬附表規定之再利用行為，仍應依各中央目的事業主管機關所定之再利用管理辦法辦理。

column4: 共通性事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法

column12: 本辦法自發布後一年起施行

column15: These Regulations take effect three months after promulgation
column16: These Regulations take effect on the date of promulgation
column17: These Regulations take effect one year after their promulgation
column18: These Regulations take effect six months after promulgation

column21: Article 17 provides that the Regulations take effect on the date of promulgation.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column9: 《資源回收再利用法施行細則》之訂定法源依據為何？
column10: 依資源回收再利用法第二十六條規定訂定之
column11: 依廢棄物清理法第三十條第二項之規定訂定之
column12: 依資源回收再利用法第十五條第一項規定訂定
column13: 依資源回收再利用法第三十條規定訂定之
column14: Under which provision are these Enforcement Rules enacted?
column15: Enacted under Article 26 of the Resource Recycling and Reuse Act
column16: Enacted under Article 30, paragraph 2 of the Waste Disposal Act
column17: Enacted under Article 15, paragraph 1 of the Resource Recycling Act
column18: Enacted under Article 30 of the Resource Recycling and Reuse Act
column20: 第1條：本細則依資源回收再利用法（本法）第三十條規定訂定之。本法第二十六條為處罰規定（第11條至第17條之按日連續處罰即據以規範），第十五條第一項則為再生資源項目之公告依據。
column21: Article 1 cites Article 30 of the Resource Recycling and Reuse Act.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column9: 再使用或再生利用之歸類發生疑義時，應由何機關認定？
column10: 由中央主管機關報請行政院指定專責機關認定之
column11: 由中央目的事業主管機關逕行認定後函知申請人
column12: 由所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關會商後認定
column13: 由中央主管機關會商中央目的事業主管機關認定之
column14: Which agency decides when the classification of reuse or recycling is in doubt?
column15: The central competent authority refers it to the Executive Yuan to designate a responsible agency
column16: The central industry competent authority decides directly and notifies the applicant of the result
column17: The municipal or county (city) competent authority of the location decides after consultation
column18: The central competent authority decides in consultation with the central industry competent authority
column20: 第2條：本法第二條第三款與第四款所定再使用或再生利用歸類有疑義時，由中央主管機關會商中央目的事業主管機關認定之。可對照第4條第2項，中央目的事業主管機關之認定產生爭議時，始由中央主管機關報請行政院指定之。
column21: Article 2 requires the central competent authority to decide in consultation with the central industry authority.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column7: 資源回收-中央主管機關
column9: 下列何者屬本法所定中央主管機關之主管事項？
column10: 全國性再生資源回收再利用政策、方案與計畫之策劃訂定督導及執行，與再生資源再使用之查核宣導
column11: 再生資源再生利用用途目的事業主管機關之指定，與再生利用專用區土地徵收之核定等相關事項
column12: 直轄市或縣（市）再生資源再使用自治法規之訂定及釋示，與再使用事業之督導管理等相關事項
column13: 所轄事業再生資源再生利用方案與計畫之策劃訂定督導執行，與再生利用成效之定期檢討等事項
column14: Which of the following falls within the central competent authority's responsibilities under the Act?
column15: Planning, setting, supervising and implementing national recycling and reuse policies and plans, and auditing and promoting resource reuse
column16: Designating the industry competent authority for recycling purposes, and approving land expropriation for recycling special zones
column17: Making and interpreting municipal or county (city) self-government rules on resource reuse, and supervising local reuse enterprises
column18: Planning, setting, supervising and implementing recycling plans for enterprises under its charge, and periodically reviewing recycling results
column20: 第3條列舉中央主管機關主管事項，包括全國性再生資源回收再利用政策方案與計畫之策劃訂定督導及執行、全國性再生資源再使用之查核宣導訓練輔導評鑑及研究、再生資源再使用成效之定期檢討、全國性年報之資料彙集及編撰、涉及二以上直轄市縣（市）再使用之協調或執行、專用區之規劃設置等。第5條則為中央目的事業主管機關就再生利用之主管事項。
column21: Article 3 assigns national reuse policy, auditing, promotion, review, yearbooks and coordination to the central competent authority.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column7: 資源回收-目的事業主管機關
column9: 下列何者屬本法所定中央目的事業主管機關之主管事項？
column10: 所轄事業再生資源再生利用方案與計畫之策劃、訂定、督導及執行，與再生利用成效之定期檢討
column11: 直轄市或縣（市）再生資源再使用之調查及統計資料製作，與再使用事業之督導管理等事項
column12: 全國性再生資源回收再利用年報之資料彙集及編撰，與再生資源再使用成效之定期檢討事項
column13: 涉及二以上直轄市、縣（市）再生資源再使用之協調或執行，與再使用自治法規之訂定釋示
column14: Which of the following falls within the central industry competent authority's responsibilities?
column15: Planning, setting, supervising and implementing recycling plans for enterprises under its charge, and periodically reviewing recycling results
column16: Conducting surveys and compiling statistics on resource reuse in a municipality or county, and supervising local reuse enterprises
column17: Compiling and editing the national yearbook on recycling and reuse, and periodically reviewing the results of resource reuse nationwide
column18: Coordinating or implementing resource reuse spanning two or more municipalities or counties, and interpreting self-government rules
column20: 第5條列舉中央目的事業主管機關主管事項，包括所轄事業再生資源再生利用方案與計畫之策劃訂定督導及執行、所轄事業再生利用之查核宣導訓練輔導評鑑及研究、再生利用成效之定期檢討、涉及二以上直轄市縣（市）再生利用之協調或執行、全國性專用區之規劃設置等。中央主管機關主管者則為「再使用」相關事項。
column21: Article 5 assigns recycling plans, audits and reviews for its own enterprises to the central industry competent authority.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column9: 中央主管機關或中央目的事業主管機關就可再使用或再生利用之再生資源項目，得如何辦理？
column10: 得就其項目排定收費費率並向產生事業徵收回收再利用基金
column11: 得就其項目逕行認定為環境保護產品並核發使用許可之證書
column12: 得就其項目委由地方主管機關分別公告並訂定自治法規管理
column13: 得就其項目排定依本法第十五條第一項、第三項公告之優先順序
column14: What may the central or central industry competent authority do regarding reusable or recyclable resource items?
column15: Set fee rates for those items and collect a recycling and reuse fund from the generating enterprises
column16: Recognize those items directly as environmental protection products and issue label licences for them
column17: Delegate the announcement of those items to local authorities to regulate by self-government rules
column18: Set the priority order in which those items are announced under Article 15, paragraphs 1 and 3 of the Act
column20: 第7條：中央主管機關或中央目的事業主管機關得就可再使用或再生利用之再生資源項目，排定其依本法第十五條第一項、第三項公告之優先順序。第9條並規定未經公告為再生資源項目者，得由產生事業與再使用或再生利用事業共同申請核准為再生資源項目。
column21: Article 7 allows setting the priority order for announcements under Article 15, paragraphs 1 and 3.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column7: 資源回收-用途主管機關
column9: 本法第15條第2項及第4項所定再使用及再生利用用途目的事業主管機關，應如何認定？
column10: 應依再生資源再使用或再生利用用途事業所屬業別或屬性認定；爭議時由中央主管機關報請行政院指定
column11: 應依再生資源之種類代碼及危害特性認定；爭議時由中央主管機關逕行指定並刊登公報後生效
column12: 應依再生資源再利用產品之市場價值高低認定；爭議時由目的事業主管機關委託公會協助認定
column13: 應依再生資源產生事業之所在地行政區域認定；爭議時由各該地方主管機關會商後共同協議指定
column14: How is the industry competent authority for reuse and recycling purposes determined under Article 15?
column15: By the industry category or nature of the enterprise using the resource; disputes are referred by the central authority to the Executive Yuan
column16: By the type code and hazard characteristics of the renewable resource; disputes are designated by the central authority and gazetted
column17: By the market value of the recycled product concerned; disputes are determined with the help of an association commissioned for that
column18: By the administrative district where the generating enterprise is located; disputes are settled by agreement among the local authorities
column20: 第8條第1項：本法第十五條第二項及第四項所定再使用及再生利用用途目的事業主管機關，應依再生資源再使用或再生利用用途事業所屬業別或屬性認定之。第2項：前項目的事業主管機關之認定產生爭議時，由中央主管機關報請行政院指定之。與第4條就產生事業之認定方式相同。
column21: Article 8 determines the authority by the using enterprise's industry category, with disputes referred to the Executive Yuan.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column9: 未經公告為再生資源項目者，得由何者向何機關申請核准為再生資源項目？
column10: 得由再使用或再生利用事業單獨向再利用用途之目的事業主管機關申請，並副知產生事業所屬之公（協）會
column11: 得由再生資源之產生事業及再使用或再生利用事業，共同向中央主管機關或產生事業之中央目的事業主管機關申請
column12: 得由再生資源之產生事業單獨向所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關申請，並由該機關逕行核准後公告實施
column13: 得由產生事業所屬之公（協）會代為向行政院申請，並於核准後由中央主管機關列入年度公告之項目清單
column14: Who may apply, and to which agency, to have an unannounced item recognized as a renewable resource?
column15: The reuse or recycling enterprise applies alone to the industry authority for the reuse purpose, copying the generator's trade association
column16: The generating enterprise together with the reuse or recycling enterprise applies to the central authority or the generator's central industry authority
column17: The generating enterprise applies alone to the municipal or county (city) authority of its location, which approves and announces the item directly
column18: The generator's trade association applies on its behalf to the Executive Yuan, which then has the item added to the annual announced list
column20: 第9條第1項：未經公告為再生資源項目者，得由再生資源之產生事業及再使用或再生利用事業，共同向中央主管機關或再生資源產生事業之中央目的事業主管機關申請核准為再生資源項目。第2項、第3項並分別定義再使用事業與再生利用事業，指從事該行為之事業。
column21: Article 9, paragraph 1 requires a joint application by the generator and the reuse or recycling enterprise.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column9: 處分機關依本法第26條所為之處罰，其處分書應載明何項事項？
column10: 應載明處分事由；須限期補正或改善者，並應載明補正改善內容、期限、應檢具之證明文件及按日處罰規定
column11: 應載明處分事由；並應載明受處分人之營業額、員工人數、資本額及最近三年內之違規紀錄與裁罰金額
column12: 應載明處分事由；並應載明受處分人得申請分期繳納罰鍰之期數、利率、擔保方式及逾期加計之滯納金
column13: 應載明處分事由；並應載明主管機關承辦人員姓名、聯絡電話、開會日期及委員會決議之票數與比例
column14: What must a disposition under Article 26 of the Act state in the written disposition?
column15: The grounds; and where correction is ordered, the content, deadline, documents required on completion, and the daily continuous penalty rules
column16: The grounds; and the recipient's turnover, headcount, capital, and its violation records and penalty amounts over the past three years
column17: The grounds; and the number of instalments, interest rate, security and late payment surcharge applicable to paying the fine
column18: The grounds; and the name and telephone number of the handling officer, the meeting date, and the committee's vote count and ratio
column20: 第11條：主管機關或目的事業主管機關（處分機關）依本法第二十六條所為之處罰，應於處分書載明處分事由；其須限期補正或改善者，應載明補正或改善內容、期限、完成補正或改善應檢具之證明文件，及屆期未完成補正或改善者按日連續處罰之相關規定。
column21: Article 11 requires the grounds plus, where correction is ordered, its content, deadline, documents and daily penalty rules.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column9: 本細則所稱「完成補正或改善」，其意義為何？
column10: 指完成補正或改善行為，並自行拍照存證後於期限內函報處分機關備查，即為完成改善
column11: 指完成補正或改善行為，並檢齊證明文件報請處分機關查驗，經處分機關查驗符合規定者
column12: 指完成補正或改善行為，並於期限屆滿前以口頭方式向處分機關承辦人員陳報完成情形
column13: 指完成補正或改善行為，並取得公（協）會或專業技師出具之改善完成證明書即為完成
column14: What does completion of correction or improvement mean under these Rules?
column15: Completing the act, keeping photographic evidence, and filing it with the disposition agency for recordation within the deadline
column16: Completing the act, submitting the full supporting documents for inspection, and being found compliant by the disposition agency
column17: Completing the act, and orally reporting the completion to the handling officer of the disposition agency before the deadline
column18: Completing the act, and obtaining a certificate of completed improvement issued by an association or a licensed engineer
column20: 第12條：前條（第11條）所稱完成補正或改善，指完成補正或改善行為，並檢齊證明文件報請處分機關查驗，經處分機關查驗符合規定者。故僅完成改善行為而未經查驗合格，尚不構成完成補正或改善，第14條至第17條之按日連續處罰起算與停止均以此為判準。
column21: Article 12 requires completion plus documents submitted for inspection and a finding of compliance.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column9: 依規定暫停按日連續處罰者，經查驗認定仍未完成補正或改善時，應如何處理？
column10: 自暫停日起免除全部連續處罰
column11: 自暫停日起繼續按日連續處罰
column12: 自查驗日起重新開始按日處罰
column13: 自次月一日起重新起算按日處罰
column14: What applies where inspection shows the correction is still incomplete after the daily penalty was suspended?
column15: The daily continuous penalty is waived from the suspension date
column16: The daily continuous penalty resumes from the date of suspension
column17: The daily continuous penalty restarts from the date of inspection
column18: The daily penalty is recalculated from the first of the next month
column20: 第16條：依前條（第15條）規定暫停按日連續處罰者，經檢齊完成補正或改善之證明文件送達處分機關後，經查驗認定仍未完成補正或改善者，自暫停日起繼續按日連續處罰。第17條第1款則規定經查驗認定完成者，以暫停日為停止日。
column21: Article 16 resumes the daily penalty from the suspension date.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column9: 按日連續處罰之停止日應如何認定？
column10: 經查驗認定補正或改善完成者以次月一日為停止日；經命歇業者自處分書送達後三十日停止
column11: 經查驗認定補正或改善完成者以暫停日為停止日；經命停工停業或歇業者自該日起停止處罰
column12: 經查驗認定補正或改善完成者以查驗日為停止日；經命停工停業或歇業者仍應繼續按日處罰
column13: 經查驗認定補正或改善完成者以文件送達日為停止日；經命停工停業者自復業日起停止處罰
column14: How is the stop date of a daily continuous penalty determined?
column15: Where inspection confirms completion, the first of the next month is the stop date; where closure is ordered, it stops thirty days after service
column16: Where inspection confirms completion, the suspension date is the stop date; where work or business is ordered to cease, the penalty stops from that day
column17: Where inspection confirms completion, the inspection date is the stop date; where work or business is ordered to cease, the daily penalty still continues
column18: Where inspection confirms completion, the date of service is the stop date; where work is ordered to cease, the penalty stops from the resumption day
column20: 第17條第1款：檢齊完成補正或改善之證明文件送達處分機關後，經查驗認定補正或改善完成者，以暫停日為停止日。第2款：經處分機關依法命其停工、停業或歇業者，自其停工、停業或歇業日起，停止按日連續處罰。第18條並規定復工復業前應報經處分機關審查核准。
column21: Article 17 makes the suspension date the stop date on confirmed completion, and stops the penalty from an ordered cessation.

column4: 資源回收再利用法施行細則
column9: 本細則之施行日期規定為何？
column10: 本細則自發布後六個月施行
column11: 本細則自發布日施行
column12: 本細則自發布後一年起施行
column13: 本細則自發布後三個月施行
column14: When do these Enforcement Rules take effect?
column15: These Enforcement Rules take effect six months after promulgation
column16: These Enforcement Rules take effect on the date of promulgation
column17: These Enforcement Rules take effect one year after their promulgation
column18: These Enforcement Rules take effect three months after promulgation
column20: 第19條：本細則自發布日施行。本細則修正日期為民國九十二年八月二十七日，其後未再修正，故現行條文即自該發布日起施行。
column21: Article 19 provides that the Rules take effect on the date of promulgation.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 《公害糾紛處理法施行細則》之訂定法源依據為何？
column10: 依環境影響評估法第五十條之規定訂定之
column11: 依公害糾紛處理法第三十條第二項規定訂定
column12: 依公害糾紛處理法第五十條規定訂定之
column13: 依公害糾紛處理法第四十三條規定訂定之
column14: Under which provision are these Enforcement Rules enacted?
column15: Enacted under Article 50 of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act
column16: Enacted under Article 30, paragraph 2 of the Dispute Resolution Act
column17: Enacted under Article 50 of the Public Nuisance Dispute Resolution Act
column18: Enacted under Article 43 of the Public Nuisance Dispute Resolution Act
column20: 第1條：本細則依公害糾紛處理法（本法）第五十條規定訂定之。本法第四十三條為調處及裁決費用之規定（第13條第6款、第35條均與其相關），第三十條第二項則為環境保護協定之規定（第28條、第29條據以規範）。
column21: Article 1 cites Article 50 of the Public Nuisance Dispute Resolution Act.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 公害糾紛調處或裁決程序中，當事人之稱謂如何區分？
column10: 申請調處或裁決者為聲請人，他造為利害關係人，僅聲請人為程序當事人
column11: 申請調處或裁決者為申請人，他造為相對人，申請人及相對人均為當事人
column12: 申請調處或裁決者為原告，他造為被告，原告及被告均稱為程序關係人
column13: 申請調處或裁決者為陳情人，他造為受陳情人，兩造均稱為公害關係人
column14: How are the parties designated in a public nuisance mediation or ruling procedure?
column15: The applicant is the petitioner, the other side is an interested person, and only the petitioner is a party
column16: The applicant is the party applying, the other side is the respondent, and both are the parties to the dispute
column17: The applicant is the plaintiff, the other side is the defendant, and both are called procedural participants
column18: The applicant is the complainant, the other side is the complained-of party, and both are nuisance-related persons
column20: 第2條第1項：申請調處或裁決者，為申請人，他造為相對人。第2項：申請人及相對人，均為公害糾紛之當事人。第3條所定調處申請書應記載當事人姓名等事項，即以本條之稱謂為據。
column21: Article 2 designates the applicant and the respondent, both being parties to the dispute.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處申請書應記載之事項及委任代理人之要求為何？
column10: 應記載當事人之財產狀況、營業收入、納稅紀錄及保險資料等，並由代理人於申請書上按捺指印以資確認
column11: 應記載當事人與代理人資料、請求事項、公害糾紛原因事實、供調查之證據及調處委員會名稱等，並提出委任書狀
column12: 應記載雙方已進行協商之次數、時間、地點及未達成協議之原因，並提出經公證之協商過程逐字紀錄稿
column13: 應記載公害發生地之地籍圖說、環境影響評估書件及主管機關歷次稽查紀錄，並檢附鑑定機構之估價報告
column14: What must a mediation application state, and what is required of an appointed agent?
column15: The parties' financial condition, business income, tax records and insurance details, with the agent affixing a fingerprint to the application
column16: Party and agent details, the claim, the cause and facts of the dispute, evidence for investigation and the committee's name, with a power of attorney filed
column17: The number, times and places of prior negotiations and why no agreement was reached, with a notarized verbatim transcript of the negotiations
column18: Cadastral maps of the nuisance site, environmental impact documents and past inspection records, with an appraisal institution's valuation report
column20: 第3條第1項列舉調處申請書應記載之八款事項，包括當事人姓名性別出生年月日職業及住居所（法人則為名稱、主事務所及代表人資料）、法定或委任代理人資料、請求事項、公害糾紛原因及事實、供調查之證據、附屬文件名稱及件數、調處委員會名稱、申請年月日，並由申請人簽名。第2項：委任代理人應提出委任書狀。第3項規定於申請裁決準用之。
column21: Article 3 lists the eight required particulars and requires an agent to file a power of attorney.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處申請書之抄本提出及程式欠缺時，應如何處理？
column10: 應按調處委員人數提出抄本；不合程式或有欠缺者，調處委員會應逕行駁回其申請不另通知補正
column11: 應按相對人或選定當事人人數提出抄本；不合程式或有欠缺者，調處委員會得通知申請人限期補正
column12: 應提出抄本一份送地方法院；不合程式或有欠缺者，應由申請人於調處期日當場以言詞補充說明
column13: 應按主管機關指定份數提出抄本；不合程式或有欠缺者，應由調處委員會職權代為補正其內容
column14: How many copies of a mediation application are filed, and what applies if it is defective?
column15: Copies are filed according to the number of mediation committee members; a defective application is dismissed at once with no notice to correct
column16: Copies are filed according to the number of respondents or selected parties; a defective application may be ordered corrected within a set period
column17: One copy is filed with the district court; a defective application is supplemented orally by the applicant at the mediation date itself
column18: Copies are filed in the number designated by the competent authority; a defective application is corrected by the committee on its own motion
column20: 第4條第1項：調處申請書應按相對人或選定當事人人數，提出抄本。第2項：調處申請書不合程式或有欠缺者，調處委員會得通知申請人於一定期間內補正。第3項：第1項規定於相對人提出答辯書者，準用之。第13條第5款並規定申請書不合程式或有欠缺者，屬申請不合法之情形。
column21: Article 4 requires copies matching the number of respondents or selected parties, with correction ordered for defects.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 本法第5條第2項所定有關機關代表，其職務有異動時應如何處理？
column10: 應報請中央主管機關核准後重新聘任之
column11: 應由主任委員逕行遴聘適當人士繼任之
column12: 得由各該機關重行改派代表，補足原任期
column13: 得由該直轄市長、縣（市）長改聘他人
column14: What applies when an agency representative under Article 5, paragraph 2 of the Act changes position?
column15: A new appointment is made after approval by the central authority
column16: The chairperson directly appoints a suitable person as the successor
column17: The agency may reassign a representative to serve out the original term
column18: The mayor or county magistrate may appoint another person instead
column20: 第5條：本法第五條第二項所定有關機關代表，職務有異動時，得由各該機關重行改派代表，補足原任期。可對照第7條，調處委員因解聘、辭職、失蹤達一年以上或死亡而出缺者，始由該直轄市長、縣（市）長遴聘適當人士為其繼任人。
column21: Article 5 allows the agency to reassign a representative for the remainder of the term.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處委員出缺時，其繼任人由何人遴聘？
column10: 由該直轄市長、縣（市）長遴聘適當人士為其繼任人
column11: 由中央主管機關就推薦名單中指定其繼任之人選
column12: 由調處委員會主任委員遴聘適當人士為其繼任人
column13: 由裁決委員會主任委員指定適當人士為其繼任人
column14: Who appoints a successor when a mediation committee member's seat falls vacant?
column15: The mayor of the special municipality or the county (city) magistrate appoints a suitable successor
column16: The central competent authority designates the successor from a list of recommended candidates
column17: The chairperson of the mediation committee appoints a suitable person as the successor member
column18: The chairperson of the ruling committee designates a suitable person as the successor member
column20: 第7條：調處委員有前條（第6條）所定解聘、辭職、失蹤達一年以上、死亡等情形之一者，由該直轄市長、縣（市）長遴聘適當人士為其繼任人。第23條第2項並規定第6條、第7條之規定於裁決委員準用之。
column21: Article 7 has the mayor or county (city) magistrate appoint the successor.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處委員名簿應記載何項事項？並應報請何機關備查？
column10: 應記載姓名、學歷、出席紀錄、發言內容及評議結果；報請所在地檢察機關及地方議會備查後對外公布
column11: 應記載姓名、聘期、酬勞金額、兼職情形及利益衝突聲明；報請行政院及所在地地方法院備查並公告
column12: 應記載姓名性別出生年月日及出生地、學經歷、職業及現行職務、專長、任期起訖；報請所在地地方法院及裁決委員會備查
column13: 應記載姓名、身分證字號、戶籍地址、財產申報資料及家庭成員；報請中央主管機關及監察機關備查後公開
column14: What must the roster of mediation committee members record, and to whom is it filed?
column15: Name, education, attendance record, statements made and review outcomes; filed with the local prosecutors office and the council and then made public
column16: Name, term, remuneration, concurrent posts and conflict of interest declarations; filed with the Executive Yuan and the district court and announced
column17: Name, sex, date and place of birth, education and experience, occupation and current post, expertise and term; filed with the local district court and the ruling committee
column18: Name, ID number, household address, property declarations and family members; filed with the central competent authority and the control agency and then published
column20: 第8條第1項：調處委員會應備置調處委員名簿，登錄調處委員並記載姓名性別出生年月日及出生地、學歷及經歷、職業及現行職務、專長、任期起訖年月日等五款事項。第2項：名簿應報請所在地地方法院及裁決委員會備查，委員變動時亦同。第4項：當事人得請求閱覽、抄錄或影印調處委員名簿。
column21: Article 8 lists the five recorded particulars and requires filing with the local district court and the ruling committee.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 當事人就調處委員之選定有何權利？未被選定之委員有何效果？
column10: 當事人得聲請主任委員指定委員三人合議調處；未被選定之調處委員應於期日到場列席旁聽
column11: 當事人得共同選定委員一人或數人逕行調處；未被選定之調處委員於調處期日得不到場調處
column12: 當事人不得參與委員之選定而應由主任委員指派；全體調處委員均應於調處期日到場調處
column13: 當事人得各自選定委員一人擔任其代理人；未被選定之調處委員仍應全體到場參與調處程序
column14: What right do the parties have over the selection of mediation members, and what follows for others?
column15: The parties may ask the chairperson to designate three members to decide jointly; members not selected attend the date as observers
column16: The parties may jointly select one or more members to mediate directly; members not selected need not attend the mediation date
column17: The parties may not take part in the selection, which the chairperson makes; all mediation members must attend the mediation date
column18: Each party may select one member as its own representative; members not selected must still all attend and take part in the procedure
column20: 第10條第1項：當事人得共同選定委員一人或數人逕行調處。第2項：前項選定後，未被選定之調處委員於調處期日，得不到場調處。可對照第11條，指定管轄事件始由裁決委員會主任委員指定委員三人或五人合議決定。
column21: Article 10 lets the parties jointly select members, and unselected members need not attend.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 申請指定調處委員會管轄者，應如何辦理？由何人以何種方式決定？
column10: 應將有關書件送交中央主管機關，由部長指定委員五人或七人，以多數決方式決定其管轄
column11: 應將有關書件送交裁決委員會，由主任委員指定委員三人或五人，以合議方式決定其管轄
column12: 應將有關書件送交所在地地方法院，由院長指定法官三人，以裁定方式決定其管轄之歸屬
column13: 應將有關書件送交行政院，由院長指定政務委員一人，以行政命令方式決定其管轄歸屬
column14: How is an application to designate a competent mediation committee handled, and who decides?
column15: The documents go to the central competent authority, whose minister designates five or seven members to decide by majority
column16: The documents go to the ruling committee, whose chairperson designates three or five members to decide collegially
column17: The documents go to the local district court, whose president designates three judges to decide the matter by ruling
column18: The documents go to the Executive Yuan, whose premier designates one minister to decide by administrative order
column20: 第11條第1項：依本法第十六條第一項規定申請指定調處委員會管轄者，應將有關書件送交裁決委員會，由主任委員指定委員三人或五人，以合議決定之。第2項：裁決委員會得指定直轄市或縣（市）調處委員會管轄。第3項：為指定後應即通知當事人及受指定之調處委員會。
column21: Article 11 sends the documents to the ruling committee, whose chairperson names three or five members to decide collegially.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處委員有應迴避情形而不自行迴避，或有偏頗之虞時，應如何處理？
column10: 當事人應向所在地地方法院聲請裁定其迴避之事由
column11: 該調處委員應自行辭職並由市長另行遴聘繼任人選
column12: 主任委員應依職權或依當事人之申請，為迴避之決定
column13: 應由調處委員會全體委員以無記名投票方式決議之
column14: What applies where a mediation member does not recuse himself or may be biased?
column15: The party applies to the local district court for a ruling ordering the recusal
column16: The member must resign and the mayor must appoint another person as successor
column17: The chairperson decides on recusal on his own initiative or on a party's application
column18: All members of the mediation committee decide the matter by secret ballot vote
column20: 第12條：調處委員有本法第十七條所定情形而不自行迴避，或有事實足認其執行職務有偏頗之虞者，主任委員應依職權或依當事人之申請，為迴避之決定。第23條第2項並規定本條規定於裁決委員準用之。
column21: Article 12 has the chairperson decide on recusal ex officio or on a party's application.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處委員會依本法第18條第3項規定為移送時，應如何辦理？
column10: 應將有關書件送交受移送之調處委員會，並即通知當事人；其有代理人者亦同
column11: 應將有關書件送交所在地地方法院，並由法院逕行通知兩造當事人到場說明
column12: 應將有關書件留存原委員會備查，並僅通知申請人而無庸通知相對人知悉
column13: 應將有關書件送交裁決委員會轉交，並於移送後三十日內公告其移送之結果
column14: How must a mediation committee effect a transfer under Article 18, paragraph 3 of the Act?
column15: Send the documents to the receiving mediation committee and immediately notify the parties, and their agents where any
column16: Send the documents to the local district court, which then notifies both parties to appear and give their explanations
column17: Keep the documents at the original committee for record, and notify only the applicant without notifying the respondent
column18: Send the documents through the ruling committee, and announce the outcome of the transfer within thirty days after it
column20: 第14條：調處委員會依本法第十八條第三項規定為移送時，應將有關書件送交受移送之調處委員會，並即通知當事人，其有代理人者，亦同。第13條並列舉本法第十八條第一項所稱申請不合法之九款情形。
column21: Article 14 requires sending the documents to the receiving committee and immediately notifying the parties and their agents.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 多數有共同利益之當事人就同一公害原因分別申請調處者，調處委員會得如何處理？
column10: 調處委員會得合併進行調處
column11: 調處委員會得逕行駁回其申請
column12: 調處委員會應分別進行調處
column13: 調處委員會應移送裁決委員會
column14: What may a mediation committee do where multiple parties with a common interest apply separately over the same cause?
column15: The mediation committee may consolidate the mediations
column16: The mediation committee may dismiss the applications outright
column17: The mediation committee must mediate each case separately
column18: The mediation committee must transfer them to the ruling body
column20: 第15條：多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人，就同一公害原因分別申請調處者，調處委員會得合併進行調處。第16條並就依本法第二十條第一項選定當事人之情形，規定調處委員會得不通知未被選定之人於調處期日到場。
column21: Article 15 allows consolidation of mediations arising from the same cause.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 多數有共同利益之當事人依本法第20條第1項為選定後，其效果為何？
column10: 調處委員會仍應通知全體當事人到場，選定之通知於作成之日起即發生效力
column11: 調處委員會得不通知未被選定之人到場，選定之通知於送達相對人後發生效力
column12: 調處委員會得逕行駁回其選定之申請，選定之通知於公告七日後始發生效力
column13: 調處委員會應停止程序俟法院裁定，選定之通知須經法院核定後始發生效力
column14: What follows once parties with a common interest make a selection under Article 20, paragraph 1 of the Act?
column15: The committee must still notify all parties to attend, and the notice of selection takes effect from the day it is made out
column16: The committee need not notify unselected persons to attend, and the notice of selection takes effect on service on the respondent
column17: The committee may dismiss the selection application outright, and the notice takes effect seven days after announcement
column18: The committee must stay the procedure pending a court ruling, and the notice takes effect only after court approval
column20: 第16條第1項：多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人依本法第二十條第一項為選定後，調處委員會得不通知未被選定之人於調處期日到場。第2項：選定之通知，於送達相對人後，發生效力。第3項：被選定之人中有喪失資格者，其他被選定之人仍得為全體申請或進行調處。第4項並得建議或協助再為選定。
column21: Article 16 allows omitting notice to unselected persons, with the selection notice effective on service on the respondent.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處程序之進行場所及保密義務規定為何？
column10: 應一律於調處委員會辦公處所行之；調處委員及經辦人員得就調處內容對外公開說明其經過
column11: 得於調處委員會辦公處所或其他適當場所行之；調處委員及經辦人員除已公開事項外應保守秘密
column12: 應於公害發生地之鄉鎮市區公所行之；調處委員及經辦人員應將全部內容公告於機關之網站
column13: 得於任一方當事人指定之場所行之；調處委員及經辦人員僅就涉及營業秘密部分負保密義務
column14: Where may mediation be conducted, and what confidentiality duty applies?
column15: It must always be held at the committee's office; members and staff may publicly explain the course of the mediation to outsiders
column16: It may be held at the committee's office or another suitable place; members and staff keep matters confidential except those already public
column17: It must be held at the township or district office of the nuisance site; members and staff must post the full content on the website
column18: It may be held at a place designated by either party; members and staff owe confidentiality only as to trade secrets involved
column20: 第17條第1項：調處程序，得於調處委員會辦公處所或其他適當之場所行之。第2項：調處委員或經辦調處事務之人，對於調處事件，除已公開之事項外，應保守秘密。第23條第1項並規定第15條至第22條之規定於裁決程序準用之。
column21: Article 17 allows the office or another suitable place and requires confidentiality except for matters already public.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處進行中有人以強暴、脅迫或詐術妨礙調處者，調處委員得如何處理？
column10: 調處委員得逕行對該人科處罰鍰並命其離場
column11: 調處委員得請求警察機關協助排除，並依法處理
column12: 調處委員應報請裁決委員會決定其處理方式
column13: 調處委員應立即宣告調處不成立並終結其程序
column14: What may a mediation member do where someone obstructs mediation by violence, threat or deceit?
column15: The member may directly impose an administrative fine on that person and order them to leave
column16: The member may request police assistance to remove the obstruction and handle it according to law
column17: The member must report to the ruling committee for it to decide how the matter is handled
column18: The member must immediately declare the mediation failed and terminate the entire procedure
column20: 第18條：調處進行中在場之人，如有以強暴、脅迫或詐術進行或妨礙調處，或為其他涉嫌犯罪之行為者，調處委員得請求警察機關協助排除，並依法處理。第24條所定調處不成立之事由，則為相對人明示拒絕調處或一造連續二次無正當理由不到場。
column21: Article 18 allows requesting police assistance and handling the matter according to law.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處委員會就證據之調查，有何權限？
column10: 僅得就當事人提出之證據為調查，不得依職權另行調查其他證據
column11: 應俟兩造當事人合意後始得調查證據，一造反對者即不得調查之
column12: 得依職權調查證據，不受當事人提出之證據及請求調查證據之拘束
column13: 應委由所在地地方法院代為調查證據，並以法院調查結果為準據
column14: What power does the mediation committee have over the investigation of evidence?
column15: It may investigate only the evidence offered by the parties and may not investigate other evidence on its own motion
column16: It may investigate evidence only once both parties agree, and may not do so where either party objects to it
column17: It may investigate evidence ex officio and is not bound by the evidence offered or investigation requested by the parties
column18: It must have the local district court investigate the evidence and must follow the results of that court investigation
column20: 第19條：調處委員會得依職權調查證據，不受當事人提出之證據及請求調查證據之拘束。第20條並列舉調查證據時得為之處置；第21條規定主任委員得於調處期日前指定委員一人先行審查申請書或調查證據。
column21: Article 19 allows ex officio investigation, unbound by the parties' offers or requests.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處委員會因調查證據之必要，得為下列何種處置？
column10: 請當事人或關係人提出文書表冊物件、詢問證人或鑑定人、請有關機關協助提供文書、進行勘驗或鑑定
column11: 拘提無正當理由不到場之證人、對拒絕陳述者科處罰鍰、查封當事人之財產、限制當事人出境
column12: 搜索當事人之營業處所、扣押相關帳冊憑證、監聽當事人之通訊、命令關係人具保後始得離境
column13: 命當事人先行繳納鑑定費用、指定特定鑑定機構、逕行採信一造之陳述、拒絕另一造提出證據
column14: What measures may the mediation committee take when investigating evidence?
column15: Ask parties or others to produce documents and objects, question witnesses or experts, seek agency assistance, and conduct inspection or appraisal
column16: Summon absent witnesses by force, fine those refusing to state, seize the parties' property, and restrict the parties from leaving the country
column17: Search the parties' business premises, impound account books and vouchers, intercept communications, and require bail before departure
column18: Order a party to prepay appraisal fees, designate a particular appraiser, accept one side's statement, and refuse the other's evidence
column20: 第20條：調處委員會因調查證據之必要，得請當事人或其他關係人提出文書、表冊及物件，聽取當事人之意見、詢問證人或鑑定人或取得其書面意見，請有關機關協助提供有關文書、表冊及物件，以及進行勘驗或鑑定等四款處置。第22條並規定當事人或代理人於調處進行中得請求閱覽、抄錄或影印有關文書表冊及物件。
column21: Article 20 lists production of documents, questioning of witnesses and experts, agency assistance, and inspection or appraisal.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 調處委員會主任委員於調處期日前，得為何種安排？
column10: 得指定書記官先行約詢兩造當事人，並於開會時代為陳述其協商結果
column11: 得指定委員三人先行作成調處方案，並於開會時逕付表決通過後生效
column12: 得委由公害發生地之鄉鎮市公所先行協調，並以協調結果作為調處書
column13: 得指定委員一人先行審查調處申請書或調查證據，並於開會時提出意見
column14: What may the chairperson arrange before the mediation date?
column15: Designate a clerk to interview both parties beforehand and to state the results of their negotiation at the meeting
column16: Designate three members to draft a mediation proposal beforehand, to be put to a vote and take effect at the meeting
column17: Commission the township office of the nuisance site to mediate first and use that result as the mediation record
column18: Designate one member to review the application or investigate evidence beforehand and present views at the meeting
column20: 第21條：調處委員會主任委員得於調處期日前，指定委員一人先行審查調處申請書或調查證據，於開會時提出意見。第9條第1項並規定調處委員會收到調處申請書後應於一個月內訂定調處期日。
column21: Article 21 allows designating one member for advance review or evidence investigation.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 當事人或代理人於調處進行中，就有關文書、表冊及物件有何權利？
column10: 僅得請求閱覽，不得抄錄或影印其文書及表冊
column11: 應經他造當事人書面同意後始得請求閱覽抄錄
column12: 得請求閱覽、抄錄或影印有關之文書、表冊及物件
column13: 應俟調處成立並經法院核定後始得請求其影印
column14: What right do parties or agents have over documents and objects during mediation?
column15: They may only request to read them, and may not transcribe or photocopy the documents
column16: They may request access only with the other party's written consent given in advance
column17: They may request to read, transcribe or photocopy the relevant documents, records and objects
column18: They may request photocopies only after mediation succeeds and the court approves it
column20: 第22條：當事人或代理人於調處進行中，得請求閱覽、抄錄或影印有關文書、表冊及物件。第8條第4項並規定當事人得向調處委員會請求閱覽、抄錄或影印調處委員名簿；第23條第1項規定本條於裁決程序準用之。
column21: Article 22 grants the right to read, transcribe or photocopy relevant documents and objects.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 本細則有關調處之規定，於裁決程序及裁決委員之準用範圍為何？
column10: 第一條至第十條之規定於裁決程序準用；第十一條至第二十條之規定於裁決委員及其主任委員一併準用之
column11: 第二十四條至第二十七條之規定於裁決程序準用；第二十八條、第二十九條之規定於裁決委員準用之
column12: 全部有關調處之規定於裁決程序一體準用；惟有關調處委員之規定均不得於裁決委員之情形準用
column13: 第四條、第九條、第十五條至第二十二條之規定於裁決程序準用；第六條、第七條、第十二條之規定於裁決委員準用
column14: To what extent do the mediation provisions apply mutatis mutandis to ruling procedures and ruling members?
column15: Articles 1 to 10 apply to ruling procedures; Articles 11 to 20 apply to ruling members and their chairperson alike
column16: Articles 24 to 27 apply to ruling procedures; Articles 28 and 29 apply to the members of the ruling committee
column17: All mediation provisions apply wholesale to ruling procedures; none of the provisions on members apply to ruling members
column18: Articles 4, 9 and 15 to 22 apply to ruling procedures; Articles 6, 7 and 12 apply to ruling committee members
column20: 第23條第1項：第四條、第九條、第十五條至第二十二條之規定，於裁決程序準用之。第2項：第六條、第七條、第十二條之規定，於裁決委員準用之。第3條第3項並規定調處申請書之記載事項於申請裁決準用；第8條第3項規定調處委員名簿規定於裁決委員會準用。
column21: Article 23 applies Articles 4, 9 and 15 to 22 to ruling procedures and Articles 6, 7 and 12 to ruling members.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 本法第28條第1項、第39條第2項所稱之「管轄法院」，係指何者？
column10: 指公害糾紛發生地或損害結果地之管轄地方法院
column11: 指相對人事業所在地或其主事務所之管轄法院
column12: 指最高法院指定之專業環境事件審理管轄法院
column13: 指調處委員會及裁決委員會所在地之管轄地方法院
column14: What is the court of jurisdiction under Article 28, paragraph 1 and Article 39, paragraph 2 of the Act?
column15: The district court having jurisdiction over the place of the nuisance or of the damage
column16: The court having jurisdiction over the respondent enterprise or its principal office
column17: A specialist environmental court designated for such cases by the Supreme Court
column18: The district court having jurisdiction over the seat of the mediation and ruling committees
column20: 第27條：本法第二十八條第一項、第三十九條第二項所稱之管轄法院，係指調處委員會及裁決委員會所在地之管轄地方法院。第8條第2項並規定調處委員名簿應報請所在地地方法院備查。
column21: Article 27 defines it as the district court where the mediation and ruling committees are seated.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 環境保護協定應載明之事項為何？
column10: 簽訂協定之人、協定標的、環境保護措施、緊急應變計畫、其他環境保護約定事項、協定有效期間及簽訂年月日
column11: 簽訂協定之人、協定標的、違約金額計算方式、仲裁機構名稱、管轄法院、擔保方式及簽訂之年月日
column12: 簽訂協定之人、雙方資本額、環境保護支出預算、員工人數、產品項目、協定有效期間及簽訂之年月日
column13: 簽訂協定之人、居民戶籍資料、地方政府核准文號、環境影響評估結論、監測項目及簽訂之年月日
column14: What must an environmental protection agreement state?
column15: The signatories, the subject matter, environmental protection measures, the emergency response plan, other agreed matters, the valid period and the signing date
column16: The signatories, the subject matter, how penalties are calculated, the arbitration body, the competent court, the security and the signing date
column17: The signatories, each side's registered capital, the environmental spending budget, headcount, product items, the valid period and the date of signing
column18: The signatories, residents' household registration data, the local government approval number, EIA conclusions, monitoring items and the date
column20: 第29條：環境保護協定應載明簽訂協定之人、協定標的、環境保護措施、緊急應變計畫、其他有關環境保護約定事項、協定有效期間、簽訂年、月、日等七款事項，並由雙方簽名。第28條第1款並定義環境保護協定為事業與所在地居民或地方政府基於雙方合意所簽訂之書面協議。
column21: Article 29 lists the seven required particulars, signed by both sides.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 裁決委員會依本法第35條行詢問時，其詢問紀錄應記明何項事項？並應如何確認？
column10: 應記明處所與年月日、當事人之財產狀況、事件、到場人員之住所、預估賠償金額、分期方式及利息；並由紀錄職員逕行歸檔無須簽名
column11: 應記明處所與年月日、裁決委員及紀錄職員姓名、事件、到場人員、程序公開與否、聲明陳述及證人鑑定結果；並向當事人朗讀或交其閱覽後簽名
column12: 應記明處所與年月日、裁決委員之學經歷、事件、到場人員之聯絡電話、詢問問題編號及作答時間；並公告於機關網站供公眾查閱
column13: 應記明處所與年月日、雙方之律師費用、事件、到場人員之職稱、程序進行時數、休息次數及旁聽人數；並由主任委員一人簽名確認即可
column14: What must a ruling committee inquiry record state, and how is it confirmed?
column15: The place and date, the parties' financial condition, the case, attendees' addresses, estimated compensation, instalments and interest; filed by the recording officer without signature
column16: The place and date, names of members and the recording officer, the case, those attending, whether it was public, statements made and expert findings; read or shown to the parties for signature
column17: The place and date, the members' qualifications, the case, attendees' phone numbers, question numbers and answering times; posted on the website for public inspection
column18: The place and date, both sides' attorney fees, the case, the titles of attendees, the hours of proceedings, breaks taken and the number of observers; signed by the chairperson alone
column20: 第30條第1項：裁決委員會行詢問時，應命職員製作詢問紀錄，記明詢問之處所及年月日、裁決委員及紀錄職員姓名、公害糾紛事件、到場當事人代表人及代理人姓名、程序之公開或不公開及不公開理由、當事人所為之聲明或陳述、證人之陳述或鑑定人之鑑定結果等七款。第2項：詢問紀錄應向當事人朗讀或交其閱覽，並請其於紀錄內簽名。第3項：裁決委員及紀錄職員亦應簽名。
column21: Article 30 lists the seven required particulars, read or shown to the parties who sign, with members and the recorder also signing.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 裁決委員會行詢問期日，當事人一造經合法通知無正當理由不到場者，應如何處理？
column10: 得逕行停止裁決程序並移送調處委員會；不到場者經再通知仍不到場，即由主管機關逕為行政處分
column11: 應延展詢問期日並重新通知兩造；不到場者經再通知仍不到場，即視為其撤回申請並終結該裁決程序
column12: 得依到場當事人申請由其一造陳述而為裁決；不到場者經再通知仍不到場，並得依職權由一造陳述而為裁決
column13: 應逕以不到場之當事人敗訴而為裁決；不到場者經再通知仍不到場，並應移送所在地地方法院審理
column14: What applies where a duly notified party fails to appear at the ruling inquiry without justification?
column15: The ruling procedure is stayed and transferred to the mediation committee; on a further failure the authority issues an administrative act
column16: The inquiry date is postponed and both parties re-notified; on a further failure to appear the application is deemed withdrawn and closed
column17: A ruling may be made on the attending party's statement upon its application; on a further failure to appear it may also be made ex officio
column18: A ruling is made directly against the absent party; on a further failure to appear the case is transferred to the local district court
column20: 第31條第1項：裁決委員會行詢問期日，當事人一造經合法通知無正當理由不到場者，得依到場當事人申請，由其一造陳述而為裁決；不到場之當事人，經再通知而仍不到場者，並得依職權由一造陳述而為裁決。第2項：如以前已為陳述或證據調查或未到場人有書面陳述者，為裁決時應斟酌之。
column21: Article 31 allows a one-sided ruling on application, and ex officio after a further failure to appear.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 本法第16條第1項、第33條第1項之申請，多數有共同利益之當事人得如何為之？
column10: 應先選定當事人後由被選定之人代表全體為之
column11: 多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人得單獨或共同為之
column12: 多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人僅得共同為之
column13: 多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人僅得單獨為之
column14: How may multiple parties with a common interest make an application under Article 16 or 33 of the Act?
column15: They must first select representatives who then apply on behalf of them all
column16: Parties with a common interest may make the application individually or jointly
column17: Parties with a common interest may make the application only jointly together
column18: Parties with a common interest may make the application only individually
column20: 第33條：本法第十六條第一項、第三十三條第一項之申請，多數有共同利益之公害糾紛當事人得單獨或共同為之。第11條並就本法第十六條第一項指定管轄之申請程序另有規定；第16條則就選定當事人之效果為規範。
column21: Article 33 allows such applications individually or jointly.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 當事人申請裁決時所繳納之費用，得如何處理？
column10: 得申請裁決委員會裁決由兩造比例分擔或由相對人負擔
column11: 應由申請人全額自行負擔，不得申請由相對人負擔之
column12: 得申請調處委員會裁定由主管機關就環保基金支應之
column13: 應俟裁決確定後由敗訴一造向勝訴一造全額償還之
column14: How may the fee paid on applying for a ruling be dealt with?
column15: The applicant may ask the ruling committee to apportion it between the parties or place it on the respondent
column16: The applicant must bear the whole fee itself and may not ask that the respondent bear any part of it
column17: The applicant may ask the mediation committee to have the authority pay it from an environmental fund
column18: The losing party must reimburse the winning party in full once the ruling has become final and binding
column20: 第35條：當事人申請裁決時，其依本法第四十三條規定所繳納之費用，得申請裁決委員會裁決兩造比例分擔或由相對人負擔。第13條第6款並規定未依本法第四十三條規定繳納費用者，屬申請不合法之情形；第37條則規定移送之公害糾紛事件免繳調處費。
column21: Article 35 allows the applicant to seek apportionment between the parties or full payment by the respondent.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 直轄市、縣（市）政府及鄉（鎮、市、區）公所辦理公害陳情事務，應如何管理及陳報？
column10: 應將有關資料送交陳情人自行保管，並將辦理概況於年度終了後函報所在地議會審查通過
column11: 應將有關資料送交調處委員會保管，並將辦理概況陳報所在地地方法院及裁決委員會備查
column12: 應將有關資料編訂卷宗分類集中保管，並將辦理概況陳報上級機關層轉行政院環境保護署備查
column13: 應將有關資料逕行銷毀不予保存，並將辦理概況於每月月底前公告於該機關網站供民眾查閱
column14: How must local governments and township offices manage and report public nuisance complaint affairs?
column15: Return the materials to complainants for their own keeping, and submit the annual handling summary to the local council for approval
column16: Send the materials to the mediation committee for keeping, and report the handling summary to the district court and the ruling committee
column17: Compile the materials into files kept centrally by category, and report the handling summary through superiors to the EPA for recordation
column18: Destroy the materials without retention, and publish the handling summary on the agency website by the end of each month for public access
column20: 第36條：直轄市、縣（市）政府及鄉（鎮、市、區）公所應將辦理公害陳情事務有關資料編訂卷宗，分類集中保管，並將辦理概況陳報上級機關層轉行政院環境保護署備查。第32條第2項並規定調處及裁決事件文書應按一案一卷之方式編訂卷宗管理。
column21: Article 36 requires centrally filed records and a handling summary reported through superiors to the EPA.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 本細則施行前已依其他法律由各該主管機關處理之公害糾紛事件，得如何處理？
column10: 得經當事人之同意，移送該管調處委員會進行調處，並免繳調處費用
column11: 得逕行移送所在地地方法院審理，並由申請人負擔全部訴訟費用
column12: 應一律移送該管調處委員會重新調處，並依規定補繳調處之費用
column13: 應由原主管機關繼續處理至終結，不得移送調處委員會為調處
column14: How may public nuisance disputes already handled by other authorities before these Rules took effect be dealt with?
column15: With the parties' consent they may be transferred to the competent mediation committee, free of mediation fees
column16: They may be transferred directly to the local district court, with the applicant bearing all litigation costs
column17: They must all be transferred to the competent mediation committee for fresh mediation, with fees paid as prescribed
column18: The original competent authority must continue handling them to the end and may not transfer them for mediation
column20: 第37條：本細則施行前，已依其他法律規定由各該主管機關處理之公害糾紛事件，得經當事人之同意，移送該管調處委員會進行調處，並免繳調處費。此與第35條所定裁決費用得由兩造比例分擔或由相對人負擔之規定，同屬費用負擔之特別規範。
column21: Article 37 allows transfer with the parties' consent, exempt from mediation fees.

column4: 公害糾紛處理法施行細則
column9: 本細則之施行日期規定為何？
column10: 本細則自發布後一年起施行
column11: 本細則自發布後六個月施行
column12: 本細則自發布後三個月施行
column13: 本細則自發布日施行
column14: When do these Enforcement Rules take effect?
column15: These Enforcement Rules take effect one year after their promulgation
column16: These Enforcement Rules take effect six months after promulgation
column17: These Enforcement Rules take effect three months after promulgation
column18: These Enforcement Rules take effect on the date of promulgation
column20: 第38條：本細則自發布日施行。本細則修正日期為民國九十三年十一月二十四日，其中第26條及第34條已刪除，其餘條文即自該發布日起施行。
column21: Article 38 provides that the Rules take effect on the date of promulgation.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 《環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法》之訂定，係依據何種法律之授權？
column10: 依商品檢驗法及計量法之授權規定訂定，並由經濟部會同中央主管機關共同發布後施行之
column11: 依空氣污染防制法、水污染防治法、廢棄物清理法、氣候變遷因應法等十部環保法律之授權規定訂定
column12: 依環境影響評估法及環境教育法之特別授權規定訂定，並適用於所有環境檢驗與監測之業務
column13: 依環境基本法及行政程序法之概括授權規定訂定，並經行政院核定後由中央主管機關發布施行
column14: Which statutes authorize these Regulations?
column15: The authorization of the Commodity Inspection Act and the Weights and Measures Act, promulgated jointly by the Ministry of Economic Affairs
column16: Ten environmental statutes including the Air Pollution Control Act, Water Pollution Control Act, Waste Disposal Act and Climate Change Response Act
column17: The special authorization of the Environmental Impact Assessment Act and the Environmental Education Act, covering all monitoring work
column18: The general authorization of the Basic Environment Act and the Administrative Procedure Act, promulgated after Executive Yuan approval
column20: 第1條：本辦法依空氣污染防制法第49條第2項、室內空氣品質管理法第11條第2項、噪音管制法第20條第2項、水污染防治法第23條第2項、土壤及地下水污染整治法第10條第2項、廢棄物清理法第43條第2項、毒性及關注化學物質管理法第44條第3項、環境用藥管理法第36條第2項、飲用水管理條例第12條之1第2項及氣候變遷因應法第41條第2項規定訂定之。
column21: Article 1 lists ten environmental statutes, including the Air Pollution Control Act and the Climate Change Response Act.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 本辦法所稱「環境檢驗測定業務」之定義為何？
column10: 指針對環境污染案件進行現場稽查、採證、告發與裁處書製作及後續行政救濟之工作
column11: 指應用各種物理性、化學性或生物性檢測方法，以執行環境標的物採樣、檢驗、測定之工作
column12: 指依主管機關委託辦理環境品質監測站之設置、維護及數據傳輸與統計分析之相關工作
column13: 指就事業之污染防制設備進行設計、安裝、操作與功能驗證測試及性能保證之相關工作
column14: How is environmental testing and measurement business defined under these Regulations?
column15: Work conducting on-site inspections, evidence collection, citations, penalty documents and subsequent administrative remedies
column16: Work applying physical, chemical or biological testing methods to sample, examine and measure environmental subject matter
column17: Work commissioned by the authority to build and maintain environmental quality monitoring stations and transmit and analyse data
column18: Work designing, installing, operating and verifying the performance of an enterprise's pollution control equipment
column20: 第2條第1款：環境檢驗測定業務指應用各種物理性、化學性或生物性檢測方法以執行環境標的物採樣、檢驗、測定之工作。第2款定義檢測機構為依本辦法申請核發許可證執行該業務之機構；第3款定義檢測人員包括檢驗室主管、品保品管人員及其他從事該業務之專業技術人員。
column21: Article 2, subparagraph 1 defines it as sampling, examining and measuring environmental subject matter by physical, chemical or biological methods.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 檢測機構取得許可證與執行檢驗測定之關係為何？有何例外規定？
column10: 得先行執行檢驗測定並於一年內補辦許可證；但執行廢棄物清理法之檢驗測定者應先取得許可證始得為之
column11: 應取得中央目的事業主管機關之登記證始得辦理；但公立大專院校執行之檢驗測定一律免辦理任何許可
column12: 應取得中央主管機關核發之許可證始得辦理；但執行水污法、土污法、毒管法之檢驗測定經核准者不在此限
column13: 應取得所在地主管機關核發之許可證始得辦理；但執行空污法及噪音管制法之檢驗測定者一律不在此限
column14: How does the permit relate to performing testing, and what exception applies?
column15: Testing may begin first with the permit obtained within a year; only testing under the Waste Disposal Act requires the permit beforehand
column16: A registration certificate from the industry authority is required first; testing by public colleges is entirely exempt from any permit
column17: A permit from the central authority is required first; testing under the Water, Soil and Toxic Chemicals Acts is excepted where the authority approves
column18: A permit from the local competent authority is required first; testing under the Air Pollution and Noise Control Acts is always excepted from this
column20: 第3條第1項：申請檢測機構許可證者，應向中央主管機關為之。第2項：檢測機構應取得中央主管機關核發之許可證，始得辦理第1條所定環保法律授權之檢驗測定；但執行水污染防治法、土壤及地下水污染整治法、毒性及關注化學物質管理法規定之檢驗測定，經中央主管機關核准者，不在此限。第24條第10款並就未經核准或未取得許可證逕行辦理者定有罰則。
column21: Article 3, paragraph 2 requires a central authority permit, excepting approved testing under three named statutes.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 檢驗室品保品管人員之學歷條件為何？何種檢測類別得由物理或工科畢業者充任？
column10: 原則應為化學或環境相關科系碩士以上畢業；僅從事土壤及底泥檢測類者得由商管科系專科以上畢業者充任
column11: 原則應為理工醫農相關科系高中職以上畢業；僅從事溫室氣體檢測類者得由法律科系專科以上畢業者充任
column12: 原則應為醫農或食品相關科系大學以上畢業；僅從事空氣及水質檢測類者得由物理或工科專科以上畢業者充任
column13: 原則應為化學或環境相關科系專科以上畢業；僅從事噪音、振動、物理性公害檢測類者得由物理或工科專科以上畢業者充任
column14: What education is required of QA/QC staff, and which categories allow physics or engineering graduates?
column15: In principle a master's or higher degree in chemistry or an environment-related field; soil and sediment testing may use business administration graduates
column16: In principle a senior high school or higher qualification in science or agriculture; greenhouse gas testing may use law graduates from junior college
column17: In principle a university or higher degree in medicine, agriculture or food science; air and water quality testing categories may use physics or engineering junior college graduates
column18: In principle a junior college or higher degree in chemistry or an environment-related field; noise, vibration and physical nuisance testing may use physics or engineering graduates
column20: 第7條第1項第1款：品保品管人員應為公立或立案私立專科以上學校或經教育部承認之國外專科以上學校之化學或環境相關科系畢業（政府機關（構）申請者得為與其主管業務相關科系）。第2項：僅從事噪音、振動、物理性公害檢測類或其他經中央主管機關公告檢測類別項目之檢驗室，其品保品管人員得以物理或工科專科以上畢業者充任。
column21: Article 7 requires a chemistry or environment-related junior college degree, with physics or engineering graduates allowed for noise and physical nuisance testing.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 檢測人員（檢驗室主管及品保品管人員以外）之相關檢測經驗，得以何種講習訓練代替二年經歷？
column10: 得以完成十六小時之檢測環境安全與檢測基本學理，及八小時之檢測實務訓練代替二年相關檢測經歷
column11: 得以完成四十小時之檢測環境安全與檢測基本學理，及三日之檢測實務訓練代替二年相關檢測經歷
column12: 得以完成三十小時之檢測環境安全與檢測基本學理，及六小時之檢測實務訓練代替二年相關檢測經歷
column13: 得以完成六十小時之檢測環境安全與檢測基本學理，及十二小時之檢測實務訓練代替二年檢測經歷
column14: What training may substitute for two years of testing experience for testing personnel other than supervisors and QA/QC staff?
column15: Completing 16 hours of testing environment safety and basic testing theory plus 8 hours of practical testing training substitutes for two years
column16: Completing 40 hours of testing environment safety and basic testing theory plus 3 days of practical testing training substitutes for two years
column17: Completing 30 hours of testing environment safety and basic testing theory plus 6 hours of practical testing training substitutes for two years
column18: Completing 60 hours of testing environment safety and basic testing theory plus 12 hours of practical training substitutes for two years
column20: 第8條第2項：第1項第2款至第4款所需之相關檢測經驗，得以完成中央主管機關或其認可機構舉辦之三十小時檢測環境安全與檢測基本學理，及六小時檢測實務訓練代替二年相關檢測經歷。第1項並就理工醫農或環境相關科系專科以上畢業（第1款）、其他科系專科以上畢業並具二年經驗（第2款）等分別規定資格。
column21: Article 8, paragraph 2 allows 30 hours of theory plus 6 hours of practical training to substitute for two years.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 申請檢測機構許可證時，關於檢測數據及品管資料應檢具何種文件？文件欠缺時如何處理？
column10: 應具有申請項目十五組以上實際檢測數據及相關品管圖表或檢測經驗能力證明；文件欠缺經通知限期補正屆期未補正者予以駁回
column11: 應具有申請項目五組以上實際檢測數據及相關品管圖表或檢測經驗能力證明；文件欠缺者由中央主管機關逕行核發附條件許可
column12: 應具有申請項目三十組以上實際檢測數據及相關品管圖表或檢測經驗能力證明；文件欠缺者得於取得許可證後一年內補提送
column13: 應具有申請項目一百組以上實際檢測數據及相關品管圖表或檢測能力之證明；文件欠缺者應重新申請並另行繳納審查規費
column14: What testing data must accompany a permit application, and what if documents are deficient?
column15: At least 15 sets of actual testing data with QC charts or proof of testing capability; a deficient application is rejected if not corrected within the set period
column16: At least 5 sets of actual testing data with QC charts or proof of testing capability; the central authority issues a conditional permit where documents are missing
column17: At least 30 sets of actual testing data with QC charts or proof of testing capability; deficient documents may be supplied within one year after the permit
column18: At least 100 sets of actual testing data with QC charts or proof of capability; a deficient application must be refiled with the review fee paid again
column20: 第10條第1項第8款：應具有申請項目十五組以上實際檢測數據及相關品管圖表，或具有申請項目檢測經驗能力之證明文件與相關品管資料（中央主管機關另有規定者除外）。第2項：申請文件不符規定或內容有欠缺者，中央主管機關應通知限期補正，屆期未補正者應予駁回，所收文件不予退還。第9款並要求檢附檢驗室管理手冊。
column21: Article 10 requires at least 15 sets of data and provides for rejection if a deficient application is not corrected in time.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 許可證之檢測類別包括下列何者？其檢測項目之範圍如何界定？
column10: 包括空氣、水質、噪音三大類；項目以各級主管機關逐案指定之項目及事業自行申請之項目為限而不設上限
column11: 包括空氣、水質水量、飲用水、廢棄物、土壤、噪音、溫室氣體等類；項目以環境法規管制項目及已公告檢測方法之項目為限
column12: 包括食品、藥品、化粧品、農產品、建材、機械等類；項目以國家標準所列之全部檢驗項目及國際標準項目為限
column13: 包括生物、地質、氣象、海洋、輻射等類；項目以中央目的事業主管機關認可之項目及學術研究項目為限
column14: Which testing categories does the permit cover, and how is the scope of items defined?
column15: Three categories only, namely air, water quality and noise; items limited to those designated case by case and those enterprises apply for, without a cap
column16: Air, water quality and quantity, drinking water, waste, soil, noise and greenhouse gases among others; items limited to regulated items with announced methods
column17: Food, drugs, cosmetics, agricultural products, building materials and machinery; items limited to all national standard and international standard items
column18: Biology, geology, meteorology, ocean and radiation; items limited to those recognized by the industry authority and to academic research items
column20: 第12條第1項列舉十二款檢測類別：空氣、水質水量、飲用水、廢棄物、土壤、環境用藥、毒性及關注化學物質、噪音、地下水、底泥、溫室氣體，及其他經中央主管機關公告之檢測類。第2項：各款檢測類別之項目，以環境法規規定之管制項目及中央主管機關已公告檢測方法之項目或其他經公告之項目為限。
column21: Article 12 lists twelve categories and limits items to regulated items with announced testing methods.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 中央主管機關審查檢測機構許可證之申請、展延，應辦理何種事項？
column10: 應辦理書面審核及財務查核，並委由公（協）會辦理現場輔導及人員面試後，由審議會逕行決定核發與否
column11: 應辦理實地勘查及環境影響評估，並由所在地主管機關辦理消防與建築安全查驗後始得核發其許可證
column12: 應辦理書面審核、績效評鑑（盲樣測試、實地比測或術科考試）、系統評鑑（現場實地查核）及其他指定之審核或評鑑
column13: 應辦理線上系統資料比對及信用調查，並由中央目的事業主管機關辦理技術鑑定後核發之許可證明
column14: What must the central authority carry out when reviewing a permit application or extension?
column15: Document review and a financial audit, with trade associations commissioned to give on-site guidance and interviews before the review board decides the case
column16: A site survey and environmental impact assessment, with the local authority checking fire and building safety before the permit may be issued
column17: Document review, performance evaluation by blind samples, field comparison or practical tests, system evaluation by on-site audit, and other designated reviews
column18: Online data comparison and a credit check, with the industry competent authority conducting a technical appraisal before the permit is issued
column20: 第13條第1項：中央主管機關審查許可證之申請、展延應辦理書面審核、績效評鑑（對申請之檢測項目進行盲樣測試、實地比測或術科考試）、系統評鑑（對個別檢驗室品質管理系統進行現場實地查核與評鑑），及其他指定之審核或評鑑，經審查合格始得核發。第2項：屬同一類別增加檢測項目者得免辦理系統評鑑；第3項並就展延定有免辦績效評鑑之三款條件。
column21: Article 13, paragraph 1 requires document review, performance evaluation, system evaluation and other designated reviews.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 中央主管機關為辦理檢測機構許可證之審查、評鑑及諮詢，得設置何種組織？其委員人數及任期為何？
column10: 得設評鑑技術審議會，置委員二十一人至二十五人，任期均為二年，期滿得續聘之
column11: 得設檢測技術輔導團，置委員三十一人至三十五人，任期均為四年，並得連任之
column12: 得設環境檢驗諮詢委員會，置委員十一人至十五人，任期均為三年，期滿不得續聘
column13: 得設品質系統評鑑小組，置委員五人至九人，任期均為一年，期滿應全數改聘之
column14: What body may the central authority set up for permit review, evaluation and consultation, and what is its composition?
column15: An evaluation and technical review board of 21 to 25 members, each serving a two-year term and eligible for reappointment
column16: A testing technology guidance corps of 31 to 35 members, each serving a four-year term and eligible for another term
column17: An environmental testing advisory committee of 11 to 15 members, each serving a three-year term without reappointment
column18: A quality system evaluation group of 5 to 9 members, each serving a one-year term after which all must be replaced
column20: 第14條第1項：中央主管機關為辦理檢測機構許可證之審查、評鑑及諮詢，得設評鑑技術審議會（審議會）。第2項：審議會置委員二十一人至二十五人，任期均為二年，期滿得續聘之。第26條並規定中央主管機關得委託相關機關或機構辦理檢測機構之輔導、審查、評鑑及查核事項。
column21: Article 14 provides for an evaluation and technical review board of 21 to 25 members serving two-year renewable terms.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 檢測機構許可證應記載之事項為何？
column10: 機構名稱、歷年檢測件數及金額、客戶名冊、收費標準、違規紀錄及主管機關裁處之情形
column11: 機構名稱、檢驗室名稱及地址、檢驗室主管姓名、檢測類別項目及方法、有效期限及其他指定事項
column12: 機構名稱、檢驗室面積及樓層、儀器設備清冊、購置金額、折舊年限及保養廠商聯絡方式
column13: 機構名稱、負責人身分證字號、股東名冊、資本額、員工人數、營業項目及公司登記之字號
column14: What must a testing agency permit record?
column15: The agency name, the number and value of tests over the years, client list, fee schedule, violation records and penalties imposed
column16: The agency name, laboratory name and address, laboratory supervisor's name, testing categories, items and methods, validity period and designated matters
column17: The agency name, laboratory floor area and level, an instrument inventory, purchase costs, depreciation periods and maintenance contacts
column18: The agency name, the responsible person's ID number, the shareholder list, paid-in capital, headcount, business items and the company registration number
column20: 第15條：許可證應記載機構名稱、檢驗室名稱及地址、檢驗室主管姓名、檢測類別項目及方法、有效期限，及其他經中央主管機關指定事項。第19條第3項並規定許可證應記載事項有變更者，應於變更後三十日內辦理變更登記。
column21: Article 15 lists the agency name, laboratory details, supervisor, categories, items, methods and validity period.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 檢測報告涉及違反第17條第1項第2款或第3款規定者，簽署該報告之檢驗室主管或簽署人受有何限制？
column10: 應由所在地主管機關逕行註銷其簽署資格，並自處分之日起五年內不得再簽署
column11: 應自行停止簽署一年後即得恢復簽署，無須另報中央主管機關評鑑或核可
column12: 應改由品保品管人員代為簽署即可，該主管仍得簽署其他檢測項目之報告
column13: 應報經中央主管機關評鑑核可後，始得再簽署涉及違反規定檢測項目之檢測報告
column14: What restriction applies to the supervisor or signatory of a report violating Article 17, paragraph 1, subparagraph 2 or 3?
column15: The local competent authority cancels their signing qualification, and they may not sign again for five years from the disposition
column16: They may resume signing after stopping voluntarily for one year, with no need to report to the central authority for evaluation
column17: The QA/QC staff may sign instead, and the supervisor may continue to sign reports for other testing items without restriction
column18: They may sign reports for the item concerned again only after reporting to and being approved by the central authority upon evaluation
column20: 第16條之3第1項：檢測機構出具之檢測報告涉及違反第17條第1項第2款或第3款規定者，簽署該報告之檢驗室主管或簽署人應報經中央主管機關評鑑核可後，始得再簽署涉及違反規定檢測項目之檢測報告。第2項：經撤銷或廢止許可證涉及違規檢測項目者，應於限制期間屆滿後始得報請評鑑，並經核可後始得再簽署。
column21: Article 16-3, paragraph 1 requires central authority evaluation and approval before signing such reports again.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 檢測機構出具檢測報告應由何人簽署？簽署人之資格及核可期限為何？
column10: 應經中央主管機關指派之監督人簽署；因專業需要者得由外聘技師簽署，其資格準用技師法規定，核可期限為三年不得展延
column11: 應經各該檢驗室主管簽署；因專業或業務需要者得由經評鑑核可之簽署人簽署，其資格準用主管規定，核可期限與許可證相同
column12: 應經檢測人員及主管共同簽署；因業務需要者得由行政人員代簽，其資格無須另行規定，核可期限依機構內部規章訂定
column13: 應經機構代表人簽署；因專業或業務需要者得由品保品管人員代為簽署，其資格由機構自行認定，核可期限為一年並得展延
column14: Who signs a testing report, and what qualification and approval period apply to signatories?
column15: A supervisor assigned by the central authority signs; where expertise requires, an outside engineer may sign under the Engineer Act, approved for three years
column16: The laboratory supervisor signs; where expertise or business needs require, an approved signatory may sign, qualifying as a supervisor, approved for the permit period
column17: Testing personnel and the supervisor sign jointly; where business needs require, administrative staff may sign, with the period set by internal rules
column18: The agency representative signs; where expertise or business needs require, QA/QC staff may sign instead, with qualifications set by the agency for one renewable year
column20: 第18條第1項：檢測機構出具檢測報告應經各該檢驗室主管簽署之；但因專業領域或業務需要者，得由報經中央主管機關評鑑核可之檢測報告簽署人簽署之。第2項：檢測報告簽署人之資格準用檢驗室主管之規定。第3項：核可簽署報告之期限與許可證有效期限相同，申請許可證展延時得同時申請簽署人之核可。第24條第1款並就違反本條第1項定有罰則。
column21: Article 18 requires the laboratory supervisor or an approved signatory whose qualification mirrors the supervisor's and whose approval runs with the permit.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 中央主管機關對檢測機構之查核權限及保密義務規定為何？
column10: 得委由公（協）會代為查核並逕行作成處分，機構不得異議；所取得之資料應於查核完成後三十日內全數退還受查核之機構
column11: 得派員攜帶證明文件進入機構或採樣現場查核並命提供資料，機構不得規避妨礙拒絕；所取得涉及隱私、工商或軍事秘密之資料應予保密
column12: 僅得於機構之營業時間內以書面調閱資料，不得進入檢驗室或採樣現場；所取得之資料得逕行提供其他同業作為比對之參考
column13: 應於查核前七日以書面通知機構並經其同意，機構得就涉及營業秘密部分拒絕提供；所取得之全部資料均應主動公開於機關網站
column14: What inspection powers and confidentiality duties apply to the central authority?
column15: It may commission an association to inspect and issue dispositions without objection, and all data obtained must be returned within thirty days of the inspection
column16: It may send officers with credentials into the agency or sampling site to inspect and demand data, which may not be evaded; privacy, trade and military secrets obtained are kept confidential
column17: It may only request documents in writing during business hours and may not enter the laboratory or sampling site; the data may be shared with peer agencies
column18: It must give seven days' written notice in advance and obtain the agency's consent, the agency may refuse trade secret material, and all data obtained must be published on the website
column20: 第20條第1項：中央主管機關得派員攜帶證明文件，進入檢測機構或採樣現場進行查核工作，並命其提供有關資料，檢測機構不得規避、妨礙或拒絕。第2項：依前項所為查核或辦理許可證申請、審查、核（換）發、撤銷及廢止事項業務所取得之資料，涉及受檢者之個人隱私、工商秘密、軍事秘密應予保密。第24條第1款並就違反第1項定有罰則。
column21: Article 20 grants entry and data demand powers that may not be evaded, with confidentiality for privacy, trade and military secrets.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 檢測機構參加盲樣測試之費用及不支付費用之效果為何？
column10: 參加國內或國際盲樣測試之相關費用由審議會決議分攤；不支付費用者僅須以書面敘明理由即可免除
column11: 參加國內或國際盲樣測試之相關費用由委託之事業負擔；不支付費用者得改以實地比測方式替代參加
column12: 參加國內或國際盲樣測試之相關費用由中央主管機關全額補助；不支付費用者得申請延期一年後參加
column13: 參加國內或國際盲樣測試之相關費用應由檢測機構自行支付；不支付費用致無法參加者，視為拒絕參加
column14: Who bears the cost of blind sample testing, and what follows from non-payment?
column15: The review board decides how the cost is shared; an agency that does not pay need only state its reasons in writing to be excused from participating
column16: The commissioning enterprise bears the cost of such testing; an agency that does not pay may take part by field comparison testing instead of blind samples
column17: The central competent authority fully subsidizes the cost of such testing; an agency that does not pay may apply to postpone participation for one year
column18: The testing agency bears the cost of domestic or international blind sample testing; failing to pay and therefore not taking part counts as refusal to participate
column20: 第21條第1項：檢測機構或其檢測人員應依規定接受中央主管機關之採樣技術評鑑或盲樣測試，並於規定期限內將盲樣測試結果送交中央主管機關。第2項：中央主管機關亦得指定參加國內或國際盲樣測試，檢測機構應自行支付相關費用；不支付費用致無法參加盲樣測試者，視為拒絕參加。第24條第5款、第6款並就未依期限送交結果、拒絕參加或連續二次不合格定有罰則。
column21: Article 21, paragraph 2 makes the agency bear the cost and treats non-payment preventing participation as refusal.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 中央主管機關命檢測機構指派檢測人員接受在職訓練時，檢測機構有何義務？
column10: 檢測機構僅須指派檢驗室主管一人參加，其餘人員得免接受訓練
column11: 檢測機構得視業務繁忙情形拒絕，並改以線上課程自行辦理訓練
column12: 檢測機構不得拒絕，應指派適當或被指定之檢測人員接受在職訓練
column13: 檢測機構應先向所在地主管機關報備後，始須指派人員接受訓練
column14: What duty does a testing agency have when ordered to send personnel for on-the-job training?
column15: The agency need only send one laboratory supervisor, and the remaining testing personnel are exempt from training
column16: The agency may refuse when business is heavy and may instead arrange its own online courses for the personnel
column17: The agency may not refuse and must assign suitable or designated testing personnel to receive the on-the-job training
column18: The agency need only assign personnel after first filing a report with the local competent authority of its location
column20: 第22條：中央主管機關得命檢測機構指派適當或被指定之檢測人員接受在職訓練，檢測機構不得拒絕。第24條第1款並規定違反第22條規定者，依各該環保法律之罰則規定辦理。第11條第3項並規定申請許可證展延時應檢附檢測人員依第22條接受訓練之證明文件。
column21: Article 22 provides that the agency may not refuse such an order.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 檢測機構自行停業或有歇業、解散情形時，其許可證應如何處理？
column10: 自行停業者應檢具許可證向中央主管機關辦理廢止；歇業、解散或喪失執行業務能力者，中央主管機關得逕行廢止其許可證
column11: 自行停業者應向所在地主管機關報請備查即可；歇業、解散者其許可證自動失效，無須辦理任何廢止之手續
column12: 自行停業者應先繳回許可證由中央主管機關保管；歇業、解散者應由審議會決議後始得廢止其許可證
column13: 自行停業者得保留許可證三年後再行復業；歇業、解散者應由代表人於六個月內申請移轉予其他檢測機構
column14: How is the permit handled when a testing agency suspends business or closes down?
column15: On voluntary suspension it files the permit with the central authority for revocation; on closure, dissolution or loss of capacity the authority may revoke it directly
column16: On voluntary suspension it need only report to the local authority for recordation; on closure or dissolution the permit lapses automatically without formality
column17: On voluntary suspension it must surrender the permit to the central authority for custody; on closure the review board must resolve before revocation
column18: On voluntary suspension it may keep the permit for three years before resuming; on closure the representative must transfer it to another agency within six months
column20: 第23條第1項：檢測機構自行停業時，應檢具許可證向中央主管機關辦理廢止。第2項：檢測機構有歇業、解散或喪失執行業務能力者，中央主管機關得逕行廢止其許可證。第11條第2項並規定申請復業應檢附第10條第1項第1款、第4款至第10款規定之文件，第13條第2項規定其審查程序準用申請規定。
column21: Article 23 requires filing the permit for revocation on suspension and allows direct revocation on closure or dissolution.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 下列何者屬檢測機構應依各該環保法律罰則規定處罰之情形？
column10: 檢測人員未參加公（協）會舉辦之研討會，或機構未加入相關同業公會組織
column11: 已申報採樣行程未實際到場執行採樣，或發生採樣時間或地點申報不實之情形
column12: 檢測報告之格式未依機構內部規章製作，或報告未於出具後三日內寄送客戶
column13: 檢驗室之儀器設備未於每年年底前完成盤點，或設備使用紀錄未以電腦建檔
column14: Which situation subjects a testing agency to penalties under the relevant environmental statutes?
column15: Testing personnel not attending association seminars, or the agency not joining the relevant trade association body
column16: A declared sampling trip where no one actually attended to sample, or a false declaration of the sampling time or place
column17: A report format not matching the agency's internal rules, or a report not sent to the client within three days of issue
column18: Laboratory instruments not inventoried before the end of each year, or equipment use records not kept in a computer file
column20: 第24條列舉十款應依空氣污染防制法第70條、水污染防治法第49條、廢棄物清理法第58條、氣候變遷因應法第50條等各該罰則處罰之情形，其中第9款即為已申報採樣行程未實際到場執行採樣，或發生採樣時間或地點申報不實。其餘尚包括違反第3條第2項、第17條、第18條第1項、第19條、第20條第1項、第21條、第22條規定及有第16條之1任一違規情形等。
column21: Article 24, subparagraph 9 covers unattended declared sampling trips and false declarations of sampling time or place.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 檢測機構經撤銷、廢止其許可證涉及違規之檢測項目者，自何時起不得執行該項業務？
column10: 自處分書送達之日起，不得再執行該檢測項目之檢測業務
column11: 自許可證有效期限屆滿之日起，始不得執行該檢測業務
column12: 自完成公告程序之次月一日起，不得執行該檢測業務
column13: 自處分書作成之日起三十日後，始不得執行該檢測業務
column14: From when may a testing agency no longer perform the item whose permit was revoked?
column15: From the date the written disposition is served, it may no longer perform that testing item
column16: From the date the permit's validity period expires, it may no longer perform the item
column17: From the first day of the month after the announcement, it may not perform the item
column18: From thirty days after the written disposition is made, it may no longer perform the item
column20: 第25條：檢測機構經中央主管機關撤銷、廢止其許可證涉及違規之檢測項目者，自處分書送達之日起，不得再執行該檢測項目之檢測業務。第24條第7款並規定經撤銷或廢止許可證者自處分書送達之日起仍繼續執行該檢測業務者，應依各該環保法律罰則處罰。
column21: Article 25 bars performing the item from the date the written disposition is served.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 中央主管機關對於執行環境檢驗測定績效優良之機構或個人，得如何處理？
column10: 中央主管機關對績效優良之機構得免除其查核義務
column11: 中央主管機關對績效優良之機構或個人得予以獎勵
column12: 中央主管機關對績效優良之機構得延長許可證十年
column13: 中央主管機關對績效優良之個人得逕行提高其薪資
column14: How may the central authority treat agencies or individuals with outstanding testing performance?
column15: The central authority may exempt such an agency from its inspection obligations
column16: The central authority may give rewards to such outstanding agencies or individuals
column17: The central authority may extend such an agency's permit for a further ten years
column18: The central authority may directly raise the salary of such outstanding individuals
column20: 第25條之1：中央主管機關對於執行環境檢驗測定績效優良之機構或個人得予以獎勵。本條與第24條、第25條之處罰及處分效果規定相對，屬正面之管理誘因；第16條第1項則就有第24條第8款、第9款情形經處分確定者，限縮其許可證展延期限最長為三年。
column21: Article 25-1 allows rewards for outstanding performance.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 中央主管機關就檢測機構之輔導、審查、評鑑及查核事項，得如何辦理？
column10: 得委託相關機關或機構辦理檢測機構之輔導、審查、評鑑及查核事項
column11: 應一律由中央主管機關自行辦理，不得委託任何機關或機構代辦
column12: 得授權所在地直轄市、縣（市）主管機關逕行核發或廢止許可證
column13: 得委由受查核之檢測機構自行辦理內部稽核並以其結果替代查核
column14: How may the central authority handle guidance, review, evaluation and inspection of testing agencies?
column15: It may commission relevant agencies or institutions to handle guidance, review, evaluation and inspection
column16: It must handle all such matters itself and may not commission any agency or institution to do so
column17: It may authorize the municipal or county (city) authority to issue or revoke the permits directly
column18: It may let the agency under inspection audit itself and accept that internal audit in place of inspection
column20: 第26條：中央主管機關得委託相關機關或機構辦理檢測機構之輔導、審查、評鑑及查核事項。第13條第1項所定書面審核、績效評鑑、系統評鑑，及第20條第1項所定進入機構或採樣現場之查核，均屬得委託辦理之事項範圍。
column21: Article 26 allows commissioning relevant agencies or institutions.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 本辦法所定之相關文件為外文者，應如何辦理？有何例外？
column10: 應檢附駐外單位或外交部授權機構驗證之中譯本；但證明文件為英文者，免附中譯本
column11: 應檢附經法院公證之中譯本及原文正本；但證明文件為簡體中文者，免附中譯本
column12: 應檢附經公（協）會審閱之中譯本摘要；但證明文件為西班牙文者，免附中譯本
column13: 應檢附申請人自行翻譯並用印之中譯本；但證明文件為日文或韓文者，免附中譯本
column14: What applies where documents under these Regulations are in a foreign language, and what is the exception?
column15: A Chinese translation authenticated by an overseas mission or an agency authorized by MOFA is required; English documents are exempt
column16: A court-notarized Chinese translation and the original are required; documents in simplified Chinese are exempt from translation
column17: A summary translation reviewed by a trade association is required; documents in Spanish are exempt from the translation duty
column18: A Chinese translation made and sealed by the applicant itself is required; documents in Japanese or Korean are exempt from translation
column20: 第28條：本辦法所定之相關文件為外文者，應檢附駐外單位或外交部授權機構驗證之中譯本；但證明文件為英文者，免附中譯本。可對照環境部事業廢棄物再利用管理辦法第23條，其規定申請文件為英文以外其他外文者，應檢附中文譯本。
column21: Article 28 requires an authenticated Chinese translation, exempting documents in English.

column4: 環境檢驗測定機構管理辦法
column9: 本辦法之施行日期規定為何？其中有無條文另定施行日？
column10: 全部條文自發布後六個月施行，其中有關罰則之條文並自發布後滿一年之日起始行適用於檢測機構
column11: 除一百十年一月二十七日修正發布之第十條第一項第九款及第二十四條第一項第二款自一百十年四月一日施行外，自發布日施行
column12: 除一百十年一月二十七日修正發布之第十六條及第十七條自一百十一年一月一日施行外，其餘條文一律自發布日起施行
column13: 全部條文一律自發布日施行，並無任何條文另定其施行日期或設有分階段適用之過渡期間相關規定
column14: When do these Regulations take effect, and do any provisions have a separate effective date?
column15: All provisions take effect six months after promulgation, and the penalty provisions apply to agencies only one year after promulgation
column16: They take effect on promulgation, except that Article 10(1)(9) and Article 24(1)(2) as amended on 27 January 2021 took effect on 1 April 2021
column17: They take effect on promulgation, except that Articles 16 and 17 as amended on 27 January 2021 took effect on 1 January 2022 instead
column18: All provisions take effect on the date of promulgation, with no provision given a separate effective date or transitional arrangement
column20: 第30條：本辦法除中華民國一百十年一月二十七日修正發布之第十條第一項第九款（檢驗室管理手冊）及第二十四條第一項第二款（違反檢驗室管理手冊執行業務之罰則）自一百十年四月一日施行外，自發布日施行。本辦法最近一次修正日期為民國一百十四年十月二日。
column21: Article 30 sets promulgation generally, with two amended provisions effective from 1 April 2021.

column4: 開發行為應實施環境影響評估細目及範圍認定標準
column9: 本標準所稱「興建」與「擴建（含擴大）」，其定義為何？
column10: 興建指目的事業主管機關核發開發許可之日起算；擴建指開發基地內既有建築物之改建、修繕或汰舊換新
column11: 興建指開發單位取得建造執照並實際動工開挖整地；擴建指原已取得許可之開發行為申請提高其生產設備產能
column12: 興建指開發行為完工後首次向主管機關申請營運登記；擴建指原開發行為變更其負責人或變更營業項目登記
column13: 興建指開發單位向目的事業主管機關申請開發行為許可；擴建指原已取得許可之開發行為申請擴增其開發基地面積
column14: How does this Standard define construction and expansion?
column15: Construction is the date the industry authority issues the development permit; expansion is rebuilding, repairing or replacing existing buildings inside the site
column16: Construction is the developer obtaining a building permit and actually starting excavation; expansion is an already permitted development applying to raise its production capacity
column17: Construction is applying for an operating registration for the first time after completion; expansion is registering a change of responsible person or of business items
column18: Construction is the developer applying to the industry authority for development permission; expansion is an already permitted development applying to enlarge its site area
column20: 第2條第1款：興建指開發單位向目的事業主管機關申請開發行為許可。第2款：擴建（含擴大）指原已取得目的事業主管機關許可之開發行為，開發單位申請擴增其開發基地面積。同條並定義水庫集水區分為第一級、第二級水庫集水區及攔河堰集水區，農業用地指依區域計畫法編定之農牧、林業、養殖、水利、生態保護用地。

column4: 開發行為應實施環境影響評估細目及範圍認定標準
column9: 附表一之工業類別工廠，其擴建或擴增產能，於下列何種情形應實施環境影響評估？
column10: 擴增產能百分之二十以上；位於都市土地申請開發或累積開發面積十公頃以上；位於非都市土地二十公頃以上
column11: 擴增產能百分之三十以上；位於都市土地申請開發或累積開發面積十五公頃以上；位於非都市土地三十公頃
column12: 擴增產能百分之五以上；位於都市土地申請開發或累積開發面積二公頃以上；位於非都市土地五公頃以上
column13: 擴增產能百分之十以上；位於都市土地申請開發或累積開發面積五公頃以上；位於非都市土地十公頃以上
column14: For a factory in the Table 1 industry categories, expansion triggers EIA when:
column15: Capacity expansion of 20% or more; 10 hectares or more of development on urban land; 20 hectares or more on non-urban land
column16: Capacity expansion of 30% or more; 15 hectares or more of development on urban land; 30 hectares or more on non-urban land
column17: Capacity expansion of 5% or more; 2 hectares or more of development on urban land; 5 hectares or more on non-urban land
column18: Capacity expansion of 10% or more; 5 hectares or more of development on urban land; 10 hectares or more on non-urban land
column20: 第3條第1項第2款：附表一工業類別擴建或擴增產能，位於國家公園、野生動物保護區、重要濕地、水庫集水區、自來水水質水量保護區或海拔一千五百公尺以上者不分規模應實施環評；位於山坡地、國家風景區或特定農業區之農業用地一公頃以上；擴增產能百分之十以上（但空氣污染、水污染排放總量及廢棄物產生量未增加並經審核同意者除外）；位於都市土地五公頃以上；非都市土地十公頃以上。

column4: 開發行為應實施環境影響評估細目及範圍認定標準
column9: 工廠設立於經環境影響評估審查完成之園區內，以及工廠屬汰舊換新工程者，本標準如何規定？
column10: 設於已完成環評之園區內者，其開發面積門檻增為三倍；汰舊換新工程之污染量未增加者應報請主管機關備查，並於三年內補行完成第二階段環境影響評估
column11: 設於已完成環評之園區內者，其開發或累積開發面積門檻均增為二倍；汰舊換新工程產能及污染量未增加且單位能耗降低，經目的事業主管機關審核同意者免實施環評
column12: 設於已完成環評之園區內者一律免實施環境影響評估；汰舊換新工程須產能及污染量減少百分之十以上，並經中央主管機關核准後始得免實施環境影響評估
column13: 設於已完成環評之園區內者，其開發或累積開發面積門檻均減為二分之一；汰舊換新工程只要產能未增加即當然免實施環境影響評估，無須任何機關審核同意
column14: How does the Standard treat factories inside a park that has completed EIA, and like-for-like replacement projects?
column15: Area thresholds are tripled inside a park that completed EIA; a replacement project with no added pollution is filed for record and must complete a second-stage EIA within three years
column16: Area thresholds are doubled inside a park that completed EIA; a replacement project with no rise in capacity or pollution and lower unit energy use is exempt with the industry authority's approval
column17: Factories inside a park that completed EIA are always exempt; a replacement project must cut capacity and pollution by 10% or more and be approved by the central competent authority
column18: Area thresholds are halved inside a park that completed EIA; a replacement project is automatically exempt so long as capacity does not increase, needing no approval from any authority at all
column20: 第3條第2項：工廠申請設立於經環境影響評估審查完成之園區內，其開發或累積開發面積均增為二倍。第3項：工廠屬汰舊換新工程，其產能及污染量未增加，且單位能耗降低，經目的事業主管機關審核同意者，免實施環境影響評估。第4項：申請設立於已完成公共設施及整地之園區內者，免依位於山坡地區位之規定實施環評。

column4: 開發行為應實施環境影響評估細目及範圍認定標準
column9: 依本標準，道路之開發於下列何種情形應實施環境影響評估？
column10: 高速公路或快速道（公）路之興建須長度五公里以上；道路興建位於非都市土地長度二十公里以上；位於山坡地長度五公里以上，同時位於自來水水質水量保護區者三公里以上
column11: 高速公路或快速道（公）路之興建須長度十公里以上；道路興建位於非都市土地長度三十公里以上；位於山坡地長度一公里以上，同時位於自來水水質水量保護區者○．五公里
column12: 高速公路或快速道（公）路之拓寬不分規模；道路興建位於非都市土地長度五公里以上；位於山坡地長度二公里以上，其同時位於水庫集水區者長度一公里以上者始須實施
column13: 高速公路或快速道（公）路之興建不分規模；道路興建位於非都市土地長度十公里以上；位於山坡地長度二．五公里以上，同時位於自來水水質水量保護區者一．五公里以上
column14: Which road developments must undergo EIA?
column15: Freeway or expressway construction only if 5 km or longer; road construction 20 km or more on non-urban land; 5 km or more on slopeland, or 3 km if also in a water quality protection area
column16: Freeway or expressway construction only if 10 km or longer; road construction 30 km or more on non-urban land; 1 km or more on slopeland, or 0.5 km if also in a water quality protection area
column17: Any freeway or expressway widening regardless of scale; road construction 5 km or more on non-urban land; 2 km or more on slopeland, or 1 km if also inside a reservoir catchment area
column18: Any freeway or expressway construction regardless of scale; road construction 10 km or more on non-urban land; 2.5 km or more on slopeland, or 1.5 km if also in a water quality protection area
column20: 第5條第1項第1款：高速公路或快速道（公）路之興建，不論規模一律應實施環境影響評估。第2款：道（公）路興建或延伸工程位於山坡地或一般保護區長度二．五公里以上，其同時位於自來水水質水量保護區者長度一．五公里以上；位於非都市土地長度十公里以上；位於國家公園、水庫集水區等區位者不分規模。

column4: 開發行為應實施環境影響評估細目及範圍認定標準
column9: 道（公）路興建或延伸工程，其附屬隧道、地下化工程及高架路橋、橋梁、立體交叉工程之長度門檻為何？
column10: 位於山坡地、一般保護區、都市土地或非都市土地，附屬隧道或地下化工程長度合計二公里以上；位於都市或非都市土地，附屬高架路橋、橋梁工程長度合計二．五公里以上
column11: 位於山坡地、一般保護區、都市土地或非都市土地，附屬隧道或地下化工程長度合計一公里以上；位於都市或非都市土地，附屬高架路橋、橋梁或立體交叉工程長度合計五公里以上
column12: 位於山坡地、一般保護區、都市土地或非都市土地，附屬隧道或地下化工程長度合計五百公尺以上；位於都市或非都市土地，附屬高架路橋或立體交叉工程長度合計二公里以上
column13: 位於山坡地、一般保護區、都市土地或非都市土地，附屬隧道或地下化工程長度合計三公里以上；位於都市或非都市土地，附屬高架路橋、橋梁或立體交叉工程長度合計十公里以上
column14: What length thresholds apply to attached tunnels and elevated structures for road construction or extension?
column15: Attached tunnels or underground works totalling 2 km or more on slopeland, general protection areas, urban or non-urban land; attached elevated roads and bridges totalling 2.5 km or more
column16: Attached tunnels or underground works totalling 1 km or more on slopeland, general protection areas, urban or non-urban land; attached elevated roads, bridges or grade separations totalling 5 km or more
column17: Attached tunnels or underground works totalling 500 m or more on slopeland, general protection areas, urban or non-urban land; attached elevated roads or grade separations totalling 2 km or more
column18: Attached tunnels or underground works totalling 3 km or more on slopeland, general protection areas, urban or non-urban land; attached elevated roads, bridges or grade separations totalling 10 km or more
column20: 第5條第1項第2款第9目：位於山坡地、臺灣沿海地區一般保護區、都市土地或非都市土地，其附屬隧道或地下化工程長度合計一公里以上者應實施環評。第10目：位於都市土地或非都市土地，其附屬高架路橋、橋梁或立體交叉工程長度合計五公里以上。第2項：長度應將高架路橋、橋梁、立體交叉工程、隧道、地下化工程、匝道或引道合併計算。
column21: Article 5, paragraph 1, subparagraph 2, items 9 and 10, and paragraph 2.

column4: 開發行為應實施環境影響評估細目及範圍認定標準
column9: 蓄水工程之興建，其堰壩高度、蓄水容量及蓄水範圍面積達多少應實施環境影響評估？
column10: 堰壩高度三十公尺以上或蓄水容量一千萬立方公尺以上；位於自來水水質水量保護區者為十五公尺或五百萬立方公尺；申請蓄水範圍面積二百公頃以上者始應實施
column11: 堰壩高度十五公尺以上或蓄水容量五百萬立方公尺以上；位於自來水水質水量保護區者為七．五公尺或二百五十萬立方公尺；申請蓄水範圍面積一百公頃以上
column12: 堰壩高度十公尺以上或蓄水容量二百萬立方公尺以上；位於自來水水質水量保護區者為五公尺或一百萬立方公尺；申請蓄水範圍面積五十公頃以上者始應實施
column13: 堰壩高度二十公尺以上或蓄水容量八百萬立方公尺以上；位於自來水水質水量保護區者為十公尺或四百萬立方公尺；申請蓄水範圍面積三百公頃以上者始實施
column14: What dam height, storage volume and inundation area trigger EIA for impoundment works?
column15: Dam height 30 m or more or storage 10 million m3 or more; 15 m or 5 million m3 in a water quality and quantity protection area; inundation area 200 hectares or more
column16: Dam height 15 m or more or storage 5 million m3 or more; 7.5 m or 2.5 million m3 in a water quality and quantity protection area; inundation area 100 hectares or more
column17: Dam height 10 m or more or storage 2 million m3 or more; 5 m or 1 million m3 in a water quality and quantity protection area; inundation area 50 hectares or more
column18: Dam height 20 m or more or storage 8 million m3 or more; 10 m or 4 million m3 in a water quality and quantity protection area; inundation area 300 hectares or more
column20: 第12條第1款第7目：堰壩高度十五公尺以上或蓄水容量五百萬立方公尺以上；其位於自來水水質水量保護區者，堰壩高度七．五公尺以上或蓄水容量二百五十萬立方公尺以上。第8目：申請蓄水範圍面積一百公頃以上。第2款：堰壩或洩洪道加高高度二公尺以上者亦應實施；第3款：越域引水工程不分規模應實施環評。

column4: 開發行為應實施環境影響評估細目及範圍認定標準
column9: 抽水、引水工程及海水淡化廠，達何種規模應實施環境影響評估？
column10: 抽引地面水或伏流水每秒一立方公尺以上；抽取地下水每秒○．一立方公尺以上；抽取溫泉每秒○．○一立方公尺以上；海水淡化廠每日設計出水量五百公噸以上者
column11: 抽引地面水或伏流水每秒二立方公尺以上；抽取地下水每秒○．二立方公尺以上；抽取溫泉每秒○．○二立方公尺以上；海水淡化廠每日設計出水量一千公噸以上
column12: 抽引地面水或伏流水每秒十立方公尺以上；抽取地下水每秒二立方公尺以上；抽取溫泉每秒○．二立方公尺以上；海水淡化廠每日設計出水量二萬公噸以上者始須實施
column13: 抽引地面水或伏流水每秒五立方公尺以上；抽取地下水每秒○．五立方公尺以上；抽取溫泉每秒○．○五立方公尺以上；海水淡化廠每日設計出水量五千公噸以上者
column14: What scale of water abstraction or desalination triggers EIA?
column15: Surface or subsurface water 1 m3/s or more; groundwater 0.1 m3/s or more; hot spring water 0.01 m3/s or more; desalination plant design output 500 tonnes per day or more
